We further design Differential Guidance (DG), an efficient inference strategy that refines facial and body motion separately while avoiding cross-region interference. To enable large-scale evaluation, we construct the Chinese Announcer Speech (CAS) dataset, the first comprehensive Chinese benchmark for co-speech gesture portrait video generation. Compared with the widely used PATS dataset, CAS includes substantially more identities, video clips, and scene diversity. Extensive experiments on both PATS and CAS demonstrate that PAGE achieves state-of-the-art performance in perceptual quality, gesture diversity, and audio-visual alignment. Project page: https://aigc-explorer.github.io/PAGE/.

</details>


### [76] [NovaSplat: Model-Free 6D Object Pose Estimation via 3D Gaussian Splatting Onboarding and Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13309)
*Georgios Floros,Evangelos Sartinas,Orestis Vangelis,Maria Pateraki*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: NovaSplat是一个无CAD模型的6D位姿估计流程，利用手机视频训练3D Gaussian Splatting模型作为检测、粗位姿估计模板和可微细化骨干，在精度和速度上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新物体的无模型6D位姿估计需从头构建物体表示，性能长期落后于基于模型的方法，亟需缩小这一差距。

Method: 从拍照手机视频训练3DGS模型，作为检测与粗位姿估计的模板来源，并作为可微骨干；细化器在无梯度奇异的连续旋转参数化下，用光度与几何联合损失优化物体到相机的位姿。

Result: 在家庭物品基准上超越所有基于模型的方法；在纹理缺失和镜面反射的工业基准上优于所有无模型竞品并大幅缩小与基于模型的差距；NovaSplat-Lite推理速度快3.1倍且精度损失可忽略。

Conclusion: NovaSplat证明无模型方法可达到甚至超越基于模型的6D位姿估计性能，并提供了高效的推理变体。

Abstract: 6D pose estimation of novel objects without CAD models remains an open challenge: model-free methods must build the object representation from scratch during onboarding and have long trailed their model-based counterparts. We present NovaSplat, a model-free pipeline that closes this gap. From a short smartphone video captured at onboarding, we train a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) model that serves both as a template source for detection and coarse pose estimation and as a differentiable backbone for pose refinement. Our refiner optimizes the object-to-camera pose with combined photometric and geometric losses under a continuous rotation parametrization free of gradient singularities. On a household-object benchmark, NovaSplat surpasses all model-based methods. On a challenging industrial benchmark with textureless and specular surfaces, it outperforms all model-free competitors while substantially narrowing the gap to model-based ones. We further introduce NovaSplat-Lite, an inference variant that is $3.1\times$ faster at negligible accuracy cost. Code will be made available at \href{https://github.com/POSE-Lab/novasplat}{https://github.com/POSE-Lab/novasplat}.

</details>


### [77] [ThinkDrag: Semantic Drag-Based Image Editing with Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13316)
*Armando Fortes,Tianyi Wei,Chindanai Trakantannarong,Shangchen Zhou,Xingang Pan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ThinkDrag：带视觉推理的统一多模态拖拽图像编辑框架，将拖拽约束与语义变换关联，并可选生成推理轨迹，达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有拖拽式图像编辑（基于优化、单步、前馈）多将拖拽指令视为几何位移，当编辑依赖内容理解、需从稀疏点约束推断合理语义变换时效果受限。

Method: 提出ThinkDrag统一多模态框架：训练将点约束关联到对象级/场景级语义变换，可选生成显式推理轨迹（生成前解释意图）；引入Drag Endpoint Markers，基于跨图像注意力分析提供显式对应信号，将拖拽锚定在图像空间；构建带推理轨迹的语义拖拽变换监督数据集及DragBench++基准。

Result: 实验显示ThinkDrag达到SOTA，在提升生成质量与合理性的同时保持有竞争力的点跟随精度；推理轨迹增强可解释性，尤其对模糊拖拽。

Conclusion: 将拖拽编辑从几何位移范式转向语义推理范式，通过推理轨迹与对应信号提升编辑的合理性、可解释性与挑战场景表现。

Abstract: Drag-based image editing provides an intuitive interface for spatially controlled image manipulation by allowing users to specify handle and target points. Existing methods have made substantial progress through optimization-based, one-step, and feed-forward formulations, but they often interpret drag instructions as geometric displacements. This limits their effectiveness when the desired edit depends on interpreting image content and inferring a plausible semantic transformation from sparse point constraints. We introduce ThinkDrag, a unified multimodal framework for drag-based image editing with visual reasoning. ThinkDrag is trained to associate point constraints with meaningful object- and scene-level transformations, and can optionally produce an explicit reasoning trace that interprets the intended edit before image generation. This reasoning trace improves interpretability, particularly for ambiguous drags. Drag Endpoint Markers, motivated by an analysis of cross-image attention, provide an explicit correspondence signal that grounds each drag in image space. To support this framework, we construct a supervised dataset of semantic drag transformations paired with reasoning traces and introduce DragBench++, a benchmark targeting challenging drag-based editing scenarios with reference edit solutions. Experiments show that ThinkDrag achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving generation quality and plausibility while maintaining competitive point-following precision.

</details>


### [78] [CoVA: Composing VAE Representations for Generative Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13322)
*Zhaowei Chen,Yikai Ge,Linze Li,Yao Tang,Xiang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CoVA，用生成模型自身VAE特征在线组合成阶段式引导，改进SiT/flow-matching训练，无需辅助编码器与推理开销，ImageNet 256×256上FID从17.2降至7.4，400 epoch达2.03。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用预训练视觉编码器做表示对齐可提升diffusion transformer训练，但需辅助编码器与额外开销；改用自身VAE特征又因面向重建、缺乏语义判别性与空间结构而不理想。此外软标签条件存在幅度衰减的隐藏混杂。

Method: CoVA训练一个小型latent composer，联合类别监督、掩码latent重建与水平翻转一致性，将VAE特征在线组合为语义判别且具空间结构的密集特征及样本相关类后验；早期对齐SiT中间特征，随后移除对齐并复用detached后验做样本相关软标签条件；通过恢复硬标签幅度修正软标签幅度衰减混杂。仅增8.5M训练参数，无推理开销。

Result: ImageNet 256×256上SiT-XL/2 FID由17.2降至7.4（400K步，降57%）；加CFG后400 epoch FID 2.03，而vanilla SiT-XL/2需1400 epoch才2.06。

Conclusion: CoVA以极低训练成本实现VAE表示的有效利用与阶段式对齐，并揭示并修正软标签条件中的幅度衰减混杂，显著加速并提升生成质量。

Abstract: Representation alignment with pretrained visual encoders improves diffusion transformer training but requires auxiliary encoders and extra training overhead. Recent approaches instead exploit representations from the generative model's own variational autoencoder (VAE). However, reconstruction-oriented VAE features are not optimized for the semantic discrimination and spatial structure needed for generative learning. We introduce \textbf{CoVA} (\textbf{Co}mposed \textbf{VA}E Representations), a lightweight framework that composes VAE features online into stage-wise guidance for flow-matching training. A small latent composer is jointly trained with class supervision, masked latent reconstruction, and horizontal-flip consistency, yielding semantically discriminative, spatially structured dense features and sample-dependent class posteriors. CoVA aligns intermediate SiT features with the composed representations early in training, then removes the increasingly detrimental alignment and reuses detached composer posteriors for sample-dependent soft label conditioning. We further uncover a hidden confound in soft label conditioning: averaging class embeddings attenuates their magnitude, coupling semantic interpolation with conditioning strength. This attenuation alone can substantially improve FID while degrading Recall, revealing a non-semantic source of the apparent gain. CoVA corrects this confound by restoring the hard-label magnitude, isolating posterior-dependent directional semantics. CoVA adds only 8.5M training-only auxiliary parameters (1.3\% of SiT-XL/2) and introduces no inference-time overhead. On ImageNet 256$\times$256, CoVA reduces SiT-XL/2 FID from 17.2 to 7.4 (\textbf{57\%}) in 400K steps. With classifier-free guidance, it achieves an FID of \textbf{2.03} in only 400 epochs, versus 2.06 after 1,400 epochs for vanilla SiT-XL/2.

</details>


### [79] [LETHE: Defending against Unauthorized Image-to-Video Generation via Value Diversity Collapse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13333)
*Boheng Li,Yueming Xing,Yiming Li,Jie Zhang,Tianwei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文揭示I2V扩散模型中参考图像的"读取机制"，提出LETHE保护方法，通过破坏参考价值向量的分布来生成失真的视频。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: I2V扩散模型可将单张照片生成主体一致的视频，存在滥用威胁（未经同意伪造视频）。现有防御方法因对"后续帧如何读取参考图像"理解不足，在常规扰动预算下保护效果有限。

Method: 通过凸几何分析，理论识别出"参考价值向量散布度"是控制读取过程的关键因素。据此提出LETHE，包含两个互补目标：(1)价值坍缩目标，驱动参考价值向量趋于一致；(2)注意力吸引目标，将后续帧拉向这些坍缩token以放大破坏。

Result: 构建两个以人为中心的I2V保护基准，在多种现代I2V模型上实验，证明LETHE达到最先进的保护性能与通用性。

Conclusion: 即使是轻微的参考价值向量散布压缩也能严重破坏生成视频，为图像主动保护提供了高效杠杆，LETHE显著优于现有方法。

Abstract: Image-to-video (I2V) diffusion models can animate a single reference image into high-quality, subject-consistent videos, posing threats of misuse as anyone can turn personal photos into fabricated videos without consent. A promising solution is to proactively add an adversarial perturbation to the image before release, such that videos generated from it would be unfaithful or visually corrupted. However, due to an insufficient understanding of what governs how subsequent frames read the reference image in modern I2V models, existing protections struggle to offer strong protection under common perturbation budgets. In this paper, we approach the problem by exploring this underlying reading mechanism. Through a convex geometric analysis, we theoretically identify the spread of the reference value vectors as a key factor governing this reading process, and empirically find that even a mild contraction of this spread can severely degrade the generated video, making it an efficient lever for protection. Guided by this insight, we propose LETHE, a novel protection method that directly disrupts this reading process. LETHE pairs two complementary objectives, where a value collapse objective drives the reference value vectors toward uniformity, while an attention attraction objective draws subsequent frames toward these collapsed tokens to amplify corruption. We further construct two human-centric I2V protection benchmarks and conduct extensive experiments with multiple modern I2V models, which demonstrate the state-of-the-art protection performance and versatility of LETHE.

</details>


### [80] [Exploring Attention Sinks in Text-to-Image Transformers from Diffusion and Autoregressive Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13337)
*Binglei Li,Mengping Yang,Zhiyu Tan,Wenxu Qian,Junping Zhang,Hao Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究text-to-image Transformer中的attention sinks现象，发现其在双向扩散模型和自回归模型中普遍存在但模式不同，且功能影响因架构而异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Attention sinks在LLM中已被广泛研究，但在text-to-image Transformer中的行为与功能意义尚不清楚，需填补这一空白以理解T2I Transformer的attention路由机制。

Method: 对双向扩散模型和因果自回归模型进行系统性attention分析与定向干预，定位sink出现的位置与层/头分布，并通过扰动sink相关头和位置、引入register tokens来评估其功能作用。

Result: Attention sinks在两类模型中均存在但模式不同：自回归模型集中于首token和全局token，双向模型出现在模态边界、文本区域和空间角落；模式随生成阶段变化且局限于稀疏的层和头。扰动sink头带来更大变化，而部分sink位置扰动影响有限；register tokens可重新分配sink并保持或略微提升生成性能。

Conclusion: Attention sinks是架构、推理阶段和组件依赖的现象，为T2I Transformer的机制分析和注意力设计提供了基础。

Abstract: Attention sinks are tokens or positions that consistently receive disproportionate attention mass, often beyond what their semantic content would suggest. Despite extensive study in large language models, their behavior and functional relevance in text-to-image (T2I) Transformers remain largely unexplored. To fill this gap and better understand how text-to-image Transformers allocate and route attention, we explore this phenomenon of text-to-image transformers across bidirectional diffusion models and causal autoregressive models. Specifically, we explore whether attention sinks exist, where they emerge, and how they functionally influence generation. Through systematic attention analysis and targeted interventions, we identify that attention sinks emerge in both bidirectional diffusion and autoregressive models but exhibit distinct patterns. The autoregressive model concentrates attention on the first and global-scale tokens, whereas the bidirectional models develop sinks near modality boundaries, within text regions, and at spatial corners. Moreover, these patterns vary across generation stages and are localized to a sparse subset of layers and heads. To assess their functional relevance, we perturb sink-related heads and token positions. It turns out that perturbing sink-ranked heads produces larger average changes than non-sink comparisons, while some sink-position perturbations have limited effects on bidirectional model scores. We further introduce register tokens to redistribute attention sinks and find that several configurations preserve or modestly improve generation performance. Overall, attention sinks are architecture-, inference-stage-, and component-dependent phenomena, providing a basis for mechanistic analysis and principled attention design in text-to-image transformers.

</details>


### [81] [VideoAWR: Reinforcing Video Flow Models with Decoupled-Timestep Advantage-Weighted Rectification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13338)
*Zheming Fu,Wenbin Ning,Ruizhe He,Wei Shang,Xiaoxiao Ma,Lianrui Mu,Chang Liu,Lei Wang,Siming Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VideoAWR通过解耦采样与优化锚点，解决视频flow模型RL中的冷启动与guidance blow-up问题，实现无CFG推理下的稳定优化与优质生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于回归的flow模型RL要求采样时不用CFG以对齐rectification目标与参考边缘速度。将AWR扩展到视频生成时出现冷启动病态：无引导rollout坍缩到低保真区域，组内奖励差距虽大但不再反映感知质量。若改用引导rollout同时保持回归目标绑定引导分布，在EMA更新下会引发几何guidance blow-up。

Method: 提出VideoAWR，解耦采样与优化锚点：用EMA参考策略生成引导rollout以恢复奖励可分性，而可训练策略对无引导条件锚点进行rectification。证明该解耦目标数学精确，centered advantage在期望中抵消锚点，滤除奖励中性guidance偏移，仅保留奖励相关协方差增量。另引入Decoupled Timestep Rectification，对每个rollout在独立采样时间步上无偏监督以提升样本效率。

Result: 在Wan2.1-1.3B和14B上的实验表明优化稳定，在无CFG和有CFG两种模式下均获得更优的视觉与运动质量。

Conclusion: VideoAWR可在推理时单分支、无需CFG运行，同时推理时CFG仍保持原有语义，成功调和了保真恢复与几何稳定性的矛盾。

Abstract: Regression-based RL for flow models mandates sampling \emph{without} classifier-free guidance (CFG) to align the rectification target with the reference marginal velocity. Extending Advantage-Weighted Rectification (AWR), which dynamically scales this regression target based on reward, to video generation encounters a cold-start pathology: unguided rollouts collapse into low-fidelity regions where intra-group reward gaps remain wide but no longer track perceptual quality, rendering the optimization target arbitrary. Conversely, utilizing guided rollouts to restore fidelity, while keeping the regression target tied to the guided sampling distribution, provably triggers a geometric guidance blow-up under exponential-moving-average (EMA) updates. We propose \textbf{VideoAWR}, which resolves this tension by untying sampling from the optimization anchor. An EMA reference policy generates \emph{guided} rollouts to restore reward separability, while the trainable policy is rectified against the \emph{unguided} conditional anchor. We prove this decoupled objective is mathematically exact: the centered advantage cancels the anchor in expectation, filtering out the reward-neutral guidance offset and retaining only the reward-correlated covariance increment. Consequently, inference runs single-branch and CFG-free, yet inference-time CFG preserves its original semantics. Furthermore, we introduce \emph{Decoupled Timestep Rectification}, supervising each rollout at an independently sampled timestep without bias to improve sample efficiency. Experiments on Wan2.1-1.3B and 14B demonstrate stable optimization and superior visual and motion quality in \emph{both} CFG-free and CFG-enabled regimes. Code is available at \pdfstartlink attr{/Border [0 0 0]} user{/Subtype /Link /A << /S /URI /URI (https://github.com/Fuzm7/FlowAWR) >>}% \textcolor{pearDark}{VideoAWR}\pdfendlink.

</details>


### [82] [Why DiT Models Underperform as Representation Learners without Long Skip Connections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13344)
*Benyuan Meng,Yiliang Zhang,Jin-Wen Wu,Qianqian Xu,Qingming Huang,Longtao Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DiT中长跳连接(LSC)能提升扩散特征质量，因其将扩散噪声直接短路传输，减少主骨干被噪声"污染"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散特征可统一生成与视觉理解，但DiT虽生成能力更强，其特征质量却较弱，威胁生成-理解统一。

Method: 通过从头训练的控制实验，对比有无长跳连接(LSC)的DiT特征质量，并诊断其作用机制。

Result: 带LSC的DiT产生更好特征；机制为LSC将扩散噪声直接短路至需要处，使主骨干中噪声信号更弱，提升特征质量。

Conclusion: LSC并非单纯技巧，而与扩散目标密切相关；代码已开源。

Abstract: Diffusion feature, i.e., intermediate activations extracted from diffusion model backbones, has emerged as a promising approach for unifying generation and vision understanding (discrimination). Despite the advancement of diffusion backbones into Diffusion Transformers (DiT), it has been found in previous literature that DiT models tend to yield weaker features despite their stronger generation capability. This poses a threat to good generation-understanding unification. In this work, we show via controlled from-scratch training that long skip connections (LSCs) affect feature quality: a DiT with LSCs can produce better features. Furthermore, through detailed diagnosis, we reveal the mechanism causing this effect. Specifically, the input to a diffusion backbone contains both the latent image and the diffusion noise, where the diffusion noise, though appearing in the form of noises, actually reflects the information of the diffusion trajectory. To make the final prediction of a noisy variable ($v$ or $ε$), the diffusion backbone needs both signals. However, carrying both signals through the main backbone effectively "pollutes" the image signal with noises, leading to poor feature quality. In comparison, LSCs can shortcut diffusion noises directly to where they are needed, leaving much weaker noise signals in the main backbone, thus improving feature quality. To name the broader impact, this reveals that LSCs are not a mere trick but closely related to the diffusion objective. The code is at https://github.com/Darkbblue/dit-lsc.

</details>


### [83] [TextVBench: Evaluating Text Rendering and Preservation in Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13412)
*Ruiqiang Zhang,Hengyi Wang,Chang Liu,Guanjie Wang,Zehua Ma,Weiming Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出TextVBench基准，将视频文本评估建模为多目标、多实例的时空对应问题，包含T2V与Ref2V两条评测轨道。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频生成模型常在文本渲染上出错（字符错误、遗漏文本、跨帧不一致），而逐帧OCR评估难以解决多文本目标与多噪声OCR区域的归属匹配问题。

Method: 构建TextVBench：采用目标条件化的候选选择替代无约束VLM转录，支持一个目标对应多个OCR区域，分离帧级空间保真度与跨帧时间保真度，并用长度加权调和分数汇总，附加额外文本诊断；按文本、布局、载体、运动属性组织基准。

Result: MiniMax-H3在T2V上取得TextVScore 68.32，最强Ref2V得分为56.51；属性切片显示随同时参考文本区域数量增加，性能显著下降。

Conclusion: TextVBench提供了可追溯至具体能力瓶颈的视觉文本评估框架，并揭示多文本场景下的显著性能退化。

Abstract: Modern video generators can synthesize convincing scenes while rendering a few characters incorrectly, omitting requested text, or changing it across frames. Measuring these failures is harder than applying OCR independently to each frame: when a scene contains multiple text targets and multiple noisy OCR regions, the evaluator must first determine which observation belongs to which intended text. We introduce TextVBench, a benchmark and evaluation framework that formulates visual-text evaluation as a multi-target, multi-instance spatiotemporal correspondence problem. TextVBench contains two complementary tracks: TextVBench-T2V measures the creation and maintenance of prompt-specified text, while TextVBench-Ref2V measures preservation of text from reference images. Both tracks use target-conditioned candidate selection rather than unconstrained VLM transcription, support one target mapping to multiple OCR regions, and separate frame-level spatial fidelity from cross-frame temporal fidelity. A length-weighted harmonic score summarizes these factors, while extra-text diagnostics expose failure modes hidden by a single OCR score. The benchmark is organized around controlled text, layout, carrier, and motion attributes so that aggregate scores can be traced back to specific capability limits. Across the evaluated model runs, MiniMax-H3 reaches a T2V TextVScore of 68.32, while the strongest Ref2V score is 56.51; attribute slices reveal a pronounced drop as the number of simultaneous reference text regions increases.

</details>


### [84] [SADL: A Size-Adaptive Decision Layer for Chronic Stroke Lesion Segmentation in ISLES 2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13422)
*Marek Wodzinski,Gniewosz Drwiega,Wojciech Szymanski*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个十一成员nnU-Net集成(SADL决策层)用于慢性缺血性卒中病灶分割,在site-disjoint测试集上Dice 0.7322、lesion-F1 0.7461、PR-AUC 0.8430。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 慢性缺血性卒中病灶在T1加权MRI上难以分割:其外观与健康组织重叠,且体积跨越四个数量级,导致体素级与病灶级指标常不一致。

Method: 构建覆盖五个设计轴的十一成员nnU-Net集成(baseline dice+top-K损失、强增强、按病灶体积损失重加权、随机权重平均、采样与架构块)。加权软图融合后输入调优决策层SADL:估计病灶体积、自适应按尺寸阈值、按体素数与峰值概率剪枝、never-empty挽救。所有融合权重与分桶参数在OOF预测上拟合。

Result: 在site-disjoint 91例留出集上用官方评估代码评分:Dice 0.7322、lesion-F1 0.7461、PR-AUC 0.8430。配对非参数bootstrap对参考单集成成员显示lesion-F1增益显著(p=0.024),增益在小病灶区最大。

Conclusion: 集成+SADL决策层有效提升慢性卒中病灶分割,尤其在小病灶上never-empty挽救可挽回固定阈值会丢弃的病例。

Abstract: Chronic ischemic stroke lesions are difficult to segment on T1-weighted MRI. Their appearance overlaps with healthy tissue, and their volumes span four orders of magnitude, so voxel-level and lesion level metrics often disagree. We build an eleven-member nnU-Net ensemble that covers five design axes: a baseline dice + top-K loss, heavy augmentation, per-lesion volume loss re-weighting, stochastic weight averaging, and a sampling-and-architecture block that pairs cohort-balanced sampling with a residual-encoder backbone. Weighted soft-map fusion of the members feeds a tuned decision layer, SADL, that estimates lesion volume, applies an adaptive per-lesion-size threshold, prunes components by voxel count and peak probability, and adds a never-empty rescue. All fusion weights and per-bucket parameters are fitted on out-of-fold (OOF) predictions, so tuning never touches the held-out test set. On a site-disjoint 91-case holdout, SADL reaches Dice 0.7322, lesion-F1 0.7461 and PR-AUC 0.8430 when scored online with the challenge's released evaluation code. A paired non-parametric bootstrap against a reference single ensemble member confirms the lesion-F1 gain at p=0.024, and the gain is largest in the small-lesion regime, where the rescue step recovers cases that a fixed threshold would silently discard.

</details>


### [85] [When MLLMs miss what humans read: diagnosing and learning to read squint text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13465)
*Chen Peng,Shan Huang,Jianbo Huang,Linrui Qin,Qibo Sun,Mengwei Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出"Squint Text"现象——多模态LLM无法识别图像粗结构中嵌入的文字，构建了SquintBench数据集并揭示空间选择是主要瓶颈，提出Squint OPSD方法大幅提升识别效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态LLM在识别图像粗结构中的文字（人类眯眼即可读出）时会失败并报告无文字，这类问题在内容审核等生产场景中真实存在，亟需系统性研究。

Method: 构建SquintBench（1076张生产审核图像）与SquintCtrl合成数据集进行机制诊断；冷冻权重分析揭示空间选择瓶颈；提出Squint OPSD——冻结教师模型接收降采样视图与真值转写作为特权上下文，沿on-policy轨迹用token级分布监督学生模型，推理时学生仅用原图。

Result: Squint OPSD在SquintBench上达到88.61 ANLS，远超未适配主干模型的26.50、原视图最佳通用模型的24.44，以及降采样视图下现成模型最佳的68.60。

Conclusion: 该方法在不依赖推理时辅助视图的情况下，显著缩小了可用视觉证据与模型生成读出之间的差距。

Abstract: Multimodal LLMs can fail to read text embedded in an image's coarse structure (text a human recovers by squinting) and report that no text is present. We name this class Squint Text and study it as a recognition deficiency, motivated by cases from a production moderation pipeline. We introduce SquintBench, comprising 1076 production-derived moderation images, and SquintCtrl, a controlled synthetic suite for mechanism diagnosis. Frozen-weight analysis shows that hidden text leaves a coarse signal while glyph identity is weakly represented; identity becomes substantially more accessible when the correct spatial regions are supplied, implicating spatial selection as a major bottleneck. Suppressing high-frequency content also improves reading at a fixed visual-token budget, while visual token count may also contribute. These findings motivate Squint OPSD: a frozen teacher receives a downscaled view and the ground-truth transcription as privileged context, and its token-level distributions supervise a student along on-policy trajectories. At inference, the student reads the original image alone. Squint OPSD reaches 88.61 ANLS on SquintBench, versus 26.50 for the unadapted backbone, 24.44 for the best general-purpose model on the original view, and 68.60 at best for an off-the-shelf model under a downscaled view. These results substantially narrow the gap between available visual evidence and its generated read-out without auxiliary views at inference.

</details>


### [86] [A Real-World CAD Segmentation Benchmark: Comparing Rule-Based and Learning-Based Approaches through Hole Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13466)
*Kai Schütte,Edgar Heinert,Matthias Rottmann*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文针对CAD分割中真实工程数据缺乏的问题，聚焦紧固件孔检测任务，提出两种规则方法并构建人工标注基准，系统比较规则法与学习方法的表现与权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CAD分割数据集多为合成或自动标注，难以反映真实工程任务的迁移效果；紧固件孔检测需人工标注且几何复杂度高于常用基准，存在研究空白。

Method: 开发两种任务专用的规则方法（graph-wire-search与multi-view），并构建源自工程CAD数据的人工标注基准数据集，同时支持训练UV-Net和AAGNet等B-Rep分割学习方法；开展参数优化、基准评测、合成数据跨域泛化及不同数据规模与IoU阈值下的可行性实验。

Result: 规则方法无需训练数据即可良好泛化，graph-wire-search偏向召回、multi-view偏向精确率；学习方法在标注充足时表现强，但在域偏移下鲁棒性下降。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了数据需求与鲁棒性之间的权衡，为孔检测及更广泛的真实CAD分割任务提供实践指导。

Abstract: CAD segmentation datasets are predominantly synthetic or automatically labelled, leaving it unclear how well existing methods transfer to real-world engineering tasks. Fastener-relevant hole detection represents one such task, requiring human annotation and exhibiting greater geometric complexity than commonly used benchmarks. We address this gap through three main contributions. First, we develop two task-specific rule-based methods, one graph-wire-search and one multi-view based, and complement them with a human-annotated benchmark dataset derived from engineering CAD data that also enables training of UV-Net and AAGNet, representative learning-based approaches for B-Rep segmentation. Second, we conduct an extensive experimental study including parameter optimisation, evaluation on our benchmark dataset, cross-domain generalisation on a synthetic dataset, and an assessment of the feasibility of the approaches at varying dataset sizes and IoU thresholds. Third, we provide evidence-based insights into the strengths and limitations of different approaches: rule-based methods generalise well without training data, with the graph-wire-search method favouring recall and the multi-view method favouring precision, whereas learning-based methods achieve strong performance with sufficient annotations but exhibit reduced robustness under domain shift. These findings highlight trade-offs between data requirements, and robustness, and provide guidance not only for hole detection, but more broadly for real-world CAD segmentation tasks.

</details>


### [87] [GraftOOD: Grafting Out-of-Distribution Exemplars into Advantage-Weighted Rectification for Video Reward Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13470)
*Zheming Fu,Ruizhe He,Wenbin Ning,Xiaoxiao Ma,Xuan Yang,Lianrui Mu,Haoyang Huang,Chang Liu,Lei Wang,Siming Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 视频奖励优化会导致"运动崩塌"（代理奖励上升但视频动态下降）。作者提出 GraftOOD，用分布外视频范例替换部分在线 rollout，并结合共享速度回归目标实现奖励与范例监督，同时构建 GraftSet-Video 数据集。在 Wan2.1-1.3B 上大幅提升 Dynamic Degree。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频奖励优化虽然能提高代理奖励，却会降低视频动态性，作者将这一现象命名为"运动崩塌"（motion collapse），即使使用视频级运动质量奖励也存在。因此需要引入外部监督来补充标量奖励反馈。

Method: 提出 GraftOOD：在选定 prompt 组中用分布外视频范例替换部分在线 rollout。采用共享速度回归目标，结合组相对奖励矫正与序列级范例监督，无需范例生成轨迹也无需额外监督损失系数。理论上刻画其逐点最优场为两种源特定目标场的源后验加权组合。并构建 GraftSet-Video（9,588 个格式匹配范例，覆盖 2,397 个 prompt）提供外部监督。

Result: 在 Wan2.1-1.3B 上，GraftOOD 相对仅用奖励的 FlowAWR 将 Dynamic Degree 从 4.86 提升至 44.41，HPSv3 从 8.10 降至 7.32，VisionReward 保持接近。主设置下，GraftOOD 在三种范例增强方法中十项指标领先九项。对范例频率和组内数量的消融显示动态—奖励存在权衡，而非增加范例使用即均匀获益。

Conclusion: 外部范例监督可作为标量奖励反馈的补充。作者强调不能将更高的测量动态性等同于生成视频中连贯、视觉上合理的运动。代码已开源。

Abstract: Video reward optimization can increase proxy rewards while reducing video dynamics, a mismatch we identify as \emph{motion collapse}, including under a video-level motion-quality reward. We propose \textbf{GraftOOD}, which replaces part of the online rollouts in selected prompt groups with out-of-distribution video exemplars. A shared velocity-regression objective combines group-relative reward rectification with sequence-level exemplar supervision, requiring neither exemplar generation trajectories nor an additional supervised-loss coefficient. We characterize its pointwise optimal field as a source-posterior-weighted combination of the two source-specific target fields. We construct \textbf{GraftSet-Video}, containing 9,588 format-matched exemplars for 2,397 prompts, to supply external supervision. On Wan2.1-1.3B, GraftOOD raises Dynamic Degree from 4.86 to 44.41 relative to reward-only FlowAWR, while HPSv3 decreases from 8.10 to 7.32 and VisionReward remains close. At the main setting, GraftOOD leads nine of ten metrics among three exemplar-augmented methods. Ablations of exemplar frequency and within-group count reveal dynamics--reward trade-offs rather than uniform gains from increasing exemplar usage. These results support external exemplar supervision as a complement to scalar reward feedback, without equating higher measured dynamics with coherent, visually plausible motion in the generated videos. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/Fuzm7/FlowAWR}{GraftOOD}.

</details>


### [88] [Stride: Scale-Aware Multi-Agent Evolutionary Refinement for Infographic Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13502)
*Yan Zhou,Yang Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Stride：一种约束驱动的多智能体框架，把信息图生成中的迭代精炼视为历史感知的进化策略，通过“尺度感知路由+单步冗余+单调接受”在冻结生成器上稳定提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 信息图生成要求单张图同时满足多种视觉、文本和语义约束。现有多模态验证器+迭代精炼方法存在尺度错配：局部编辑无法修复全局构图错误，而完全重生成又会破坏已正确的区域。

Method: Stride 将约束评估（是否满足）与视觉定位（何处、如何违反）分离；把全局修改路由给 composer 子智能体，把局部修正路由给 retoucher 子智能体；每个子智能体内部规划并生成多个候选，仅当验证器分数提升时才接受候选，从而减少迭代退化。

Result: 在完全开源的生成器-验证器系统上，Stride 在 BizGenEval 上超过 Nano-Banana-2.0 和 Seedream-5.0-Pro；在 IGenBench 上追平 GPT-Image-2.0 并超过 Seedream-5.0-Pro；在 WISE 上取得新 SOTA，并在所有评测基准上显著优于现有智能体方法。

Conclusion: 尺度感知路由、单步冗余与单调接受的结合，使迭代精炼在随机生成器和不完美验证器下仍能获得稳定改进，并让开源系统在多个信息图基准上达到或超越专有系统。

Abstract: Infographic generation challenges text-to-image models because a single image must satisfy numerous visual, textual, and semantic constraints. Iterative agentic refinement with a multimodal verifier is a natural remedy, but existing methods face a scale mismatch: local edits cannot correct global composition errors, while full regeneration may destroy already-correct regions. We introduce Stride, a constraint-grounded multi-agent framework that treats refinement over any frozen generator as a history-aware evolution strategy. Stride separates constraint evaluation - whether each requirement is satisfied - from visual grounding - where and how it is violated. It then routes global revisions to a composer subagent and local corrections to a retoucher subagent. Each subagent conducts internal planning and generates multiple candidates, while Stride accepts a candidate only when it improves the verifier score, reducing regression across iterations. Because stochastic generators and imperfect verifiers make any single step unreliable, it is this combination of scale-aware routing, per-step redundancy, and monotonic acceptance that yields stable improvement across iterations. With fully open-weight generator-verifier systems, Stride outperforms proprietary systems including Nano-Banana-2.0 and Seedream-5.0-Pro on BizGenEval, matches GPT-Image-2.0 and surpasses Seedream-5.0-Pro on IGenBench, and achieves a new state-of-the-art score on WISE, while substantially outperforming existing agentic methods across all evaluated benchmarks.

</details>


### [89] [SplatQ: Interaction-Aware Pruning of 3D Gaussian Splatting via Quadratic Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13503)
*Hongbin Ye,Haixu Liu,Shenwei Kang,Wenxiu Wei,Tinglan Wang,Hongdong Zhu,Fan Tang,Qi Gao,Yin Ma,Kai Wen,Hai Wei,Nuo Qian,Wei-Shi Zheng,Shaobo Chen,Fa-Ting Hong,Jingke Meng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SplatQ 是一种组合式 3DGS 剪枝算法，通过区域预算分配与联合高斯选择的协同优化，在固定预算下提升重建质量与空间均衡性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 3DGS 剪枝依赖独立重要性得分的全局 Top-K 选择，缺乏区域预算控制且忽略高斯的联合删除效应，导致场景内重建质量不均衡。

Method: 将高斯按空间邻近与外观相似性划分为受限大小的块，把全局选择分解为子问题；平滑基于重要性的块保留配额；用代表性像素颜色对高斯不透明度变化的响应构建联合删除的二次近似，并将个体响应、成对交互与配额惩罚纳入 QUBO 目标，用模拟退火或相干伊辛机求解。

Result: 在 5 个基准上，SplatQ 在整体重建质量、空间质量均衡性和渲染速度上优于最先进剪枝方法。消融实验表明预算平滑改善局部细节重建，交互建模提升固定预算下的高斯选择质量。

Conclusion: 通过协调区域预算分配与联合选择，SplatQ 在固定预算下实现更均衡、更高质量的 3DGS 剪枝。

Abstract: Existing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) pruning methods primarily rely on global Top-K selection based on independent importance scores, lacking regional budget control and ignoring joint deletion effects. Consequently, they cannot ensure balanced reconstruction quality across a scene. We propose SplatQ, a combinatorial pruning algorithm that coordinates regional budget allocation and joint Gaussian selection under a fixed budget. SplatQ partitions Gaussians by spatial proximity and appearance similarity into size-limited blocks, decomposing global selection into subproblems of a specific size. It then smooths importance-based block retention quotas to prevent excessive budget concentration. Finally, it constructs a quadratic approximation of joint deletion effects using the responses of representative pixel colors to changes in Gaussian opacity. Individual responses, pairwise interactions, and quota penalties are incorporated into a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) objective, solved using simulated annealing (SA) or a coherent Ising machine (CIM) to jointly select Gaussians. Experiments on 5 benchmarks demonstrate that SplatQ outperforms state-of-the-art pruning methods in aggregate reconstruction quality, spatial quality balance, and rendering speed. Ablations confirm that budget smoothing improves local detail reconstruction, while interaction modeling improves Gaussian selection quality under a fixed budget.

</details>


### [90] [S-Space: Exploring Spatial Workspace in Multimodal Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13527)
*Zhiyuan Shi,Xiang Li,Xingzhuo Guo,Shangchen Miao,Weiliang Chen,Qiyu Dai,Jinshan Ren,Jiangran Lyu,Fangfu Liu,Mingsheng Long,Jialong Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文发现多模态大模型(MLLM)中对象token的表征存在一个线性子空间S-Space，编码水平、垂直和距离坐标，充当内部空间工作区，并用作诊断空间推理失败的工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM展现出空间推理能力，但其内部机制尚不清楚，论文旨在揭示支撑空间推理的内部表征结构。

Method: 通过将空间答案分数对对象token激活求导识别出三条轴；用因果干预验证S-Space对空间判断的影响；将感知与计算分解进行诊断分析。

Result: S-Space是内在而非数据/提示诱导的线性子空间；感知将位置编码其中且可直接读出；内部推理可变换视角；言语回答选择性访问它；诊断发现基数和图像相对参考系存在系统性耦合，且MLLM在跨视角变换上存在瓶颈。

Conclusion: MLLM具备形成空间表征的能力但在跨视角的空间变换上不足；S-Space可作为诊断空间推理失败的有效工具。

Abstract: Multimodal language models (MLLMs) exhibit promising spatial reasoning capabilities, yet the internal mechanisms supporting them remain poorly understood. We uncover S-Space, a linear representation subspace in which object-token representations encode continuous coordinates along horizontal, vertical, and distance axes. Although we identify these axes by differentiating spatial-answer scores with respect to object-token activations, S-Space is intrinsic rather than induced by specific data or prompts, remaining readable under non-spatial questions. We show that S-Space functions as an internal spatial workspace of MLLMs. Perception encodes object locations into it, forming spatial representations that can be directly read out to support accurate spatial judgments. Internal reasoning transforms it for changing viewpoints. Verbal responses selectively access it, evidenced by causal interventions that alter spatial judgments while largely preserving non-spatial responses. Case studies further show that S-Space assigns locations to unseen entities and the observer, and connects physical directions with abstract linguistic meanings, suggesting both the capabilities and limitations of large-scale language training. Finally, we use S-Space as a diagnostic tool for spatial reasoning failures. Direction-word readouts reveal systematic coupling between cardinal and image-relative reference frames. More importantly, a perception-computation decomposition exposes a key bottleneck: MLLMs can form capable spatial representations, yet fall short in the spatial transformations required to reason reliably across viewpoint changes.

</details>


### [91] [Knowing Whether, Not Just Where: Anchor-Probing Distillation for Open-Set Remote Sensing Visual Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13535)
*Zhihao Chang,Lei Zhai,Shuyuan Yang,Zhixi Feng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: APD将开放集遥感视觉定位重构为"视觉支持"学习，通过教师-学生框架统一定位与拒绝。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放集遥感视觉定位需判断目标位置及图像是否有足够证据支持查询，而现有闭集模型对缺失目标仍返回看似合理的框，混淆了定位置信度与真实视觉支持。

Method: 提出AnchorProbe-Distill (APD) 师生框架。基于"被支持查询应产生连贯空间锚点"的洞察，APD-T以原始查询为参考锚点，通过语义保持查询、近类别歧义查询、远类别反事实查询进行参考感知推理；再将该推理蒸馏到APD-S，实现单图-查询对的统一定位与拒绝。

Result: 实验表明APD使模型能拒绝缺失目标，同时提升对存在目标的定位性能。

Conclusion: 将开放集定位建模为视觉支持学习，并借助参考锚点与查询扰动蒸馏，可有效兼顾拒绝与定位。

Abstract: Open-set visual grounding in remote sensing requires models to determine not only where a queried object is located, but also whether the image provides sufficient evidence for the query at all. Existing closed-set grounding models, however, tend to return plausible boxes even for absent objects, blurring localization confidence with genuine Visual Support. We introduce AnchorProbe-Distill (APD), a teacher-student framework that recasts open-set grounding as Visual Support learning. APD builds on the insight that supported queries should induce coherent spatial anchors, whereas unsupported or mismatched queries tend to produce unstable or misleading localization patterns. APD-T therefore uses the Original Query as a Reference Anchor to interpret query perturbations: Semantic-Preserving Queries retain the annotated target, Near-Category Ambiguous Queries are resolved according to whether they form a reliable alternative anchor or collapse onto the Reference Anchor, and Far-Category Counterfactual Queries provide rejection supervision. This reference-aware reasoning is distilled into APD-S, enabling unified localization and rejection from a single image--query pair. Experiments show that APD enables the resulting model to reject absent targets while also improving its localization of present targets.

</details>


### [92] [Efficient Confidence-Aware Densification for 3DGS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13541)
*Manuel Hofer,Thomas Köhler,Felix Windisch,Bernhard Kerbl,Markus Steinberger,Lukas Radl*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种置信度感知的致密化方法，在固定预算MCMC框架下用图像误差而非不透明度来放置新基元，实现无先验背景重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS-MCMC用基于不透明度的采样与重定位替代梯度驱动密度控制，成为固定预算下无先验致密化的事实标准。但由于不透明度在已重建良好的区域保持高值，采样将大多数新基元送往前景，导致背景重建不足。低预算下，基于先验的方法（如ConeGS、EDGS）虽优于它，却需预训练辐射场或稠密图像匹配及额外初始化阶段。

Method: 作者主张在固定预算MCMC框架内回归误差驱动的致密化。其置信度感知致密化保留3DGS-MCMC的固定预算与渐进增长，但依据图像误差而非不透明度放置基元：新基元主要绘制在屏幕空间梯度大的地方；偏向学习置信度低的基元（标记重建仍解释不佳的区域）；将对渲染图像贡献最小的基元重定位到这些位置。

Result: 在24个场景上平均，该方法在100k至2M基元的每个预算下，PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS均优于3DGS-MCMC。100k时无需先验或初始化阶段，即恢复了ConeGS领先3DGS-MCMC的1.05dB PSNR中的0.84dB；500k起，其PSNR与SSIM在所比较的固定预算方法中最高，包括ConeGS和EDGS。

Conclusion: 该方法本质上无需先验，但也能利用先验：从ConeGS或EDGS初始化出发，在100k时PSNR和SSIM可匹配ConeGS，500k时三项指标均最优。

Abstract: 3DGS-MCMC has replaced the gradient-driven density control of 3D Gaussian Splatting with opacity-based sampling and relocation, and is now the de facto standard for prior-free densification under a fixed primitive budget. Because opacity stays high where the scene is already well reconstructed, this sampling sends most new primitives to the foreground and leaves the background under-reconstructed. At low budgets, prior-based methods such as ConeGS and EDGS outperform it, at the cost of a pre-trained radiance field or dense image matches and a separate initialization stage. We argue for a comeback of error-driven densification within the fixed-budget MCMC framework. Our confidence-aware densification keeps the fixed budget and gradual growth of 3DGS-MCMC, but places primitives by the image error instead of the opacity. New primitives are drawn mostly where screen-space gradients are large. We favor primitives with a low learned confidence, which marks regions the reconstruction still explains poorly, and relocate the primitives that contribute least to the rendered images to these places. Averaged over 24 scenes, our method outperforms 3DGS-MCMC in PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS at every budget from 100k to 2M primitives. At 100k, without a prior or an initialization stage, it recovers 0.84dB of the 1.05dB PSNR by which ConeGS leads 3DGS-MCMC, and from 500k on, it has the highest PSNR and SSIM of all fixed-budget methods we compare with, including ConeGS and EDGS. While inherently prior-free, our densification can also exploit priors: from the ConeGS or EDGS initialization, it matches ConeGS in PSNR and SSIM at 100k and is best in all three metrics at 500k.

</details>


### [93] [MOSAIC: Multi-Scale Object-Centric Slot Adaptation with Image-Guided Prototype Conditioning for Remote Sensing Image Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13547)
*Liuqian Wang,Hanyu Xie,Rongzhen Zhao,Qi Ming,Chunjie Ma,Wentao Chao,Yufei Gao,Chengming Liu,Lei Shi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MOSAIC是一个以对象为中心的表示学习框架，为预训练扩散Transformer学习紧凑的结构性条件，用于遥感图像超分辨率等结构敏感任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练扩散Transformer虽提供强生成先验，但适配到结构敏感任务仍困难：现有方法依赖密集低分辨率特征作为条件，常将显著目标与主导背景纠缠，且对跨尺度、跨样本的重复结构缺乏抽象。

Method: 将退化观测组织为结构性slots，捕获对象级与布局级的互补证据；跨分辨率整合，并从共享原型记忆中检索重复先验以补全不完整信息；以轻量残差调制注入冻结扩散Transformer的选定层，保留预训练先验。在遥感超分任务上实例化。

Result: 在UCMerced、AID、RSSCN7上，×2与×4设置下PSNR一致提升，×4下LPIPS表现良好；定性结果显示小目标、结构边界与重复空间模式保持更好。

Conclusion: 以对象为中心的结构性条件表示能有效适配冻结扩散Transformer，提升结构敏感的图像恢复任务性能。

Abstract: Pretrained diffusion Transformers provide powerful generative priors for image restoration, yet adapting them to structure-sensitive tasks remains challenging. Existing methods mainly rely on dense low-resolution features as conditions, which often entangle salient objects with dominant backgrounds and provide limited abstraction for recurring structures across scales and samples. We propose MOSAIC, an object-centric representation learning framework that learns compact structural conditions for generative model adaptation. MOSAIC organizes degraded observations into structural slots that capture complementary object-level and layout-level evidence, integrates them across resolutions, and retrieves recurring priors from a shared prototype memory to complement incomplete image-specific information. The resulting representations are injected into selected layers of a frozen diffusion Transformer through lightweight residual modulation, preserving its pretrained generative prior. We instantiate MOSAIC for remote sensing image super-resolution, where small objects, repetitive structures, and large-scale variation provide a challenging testbed. Experiments on UCMerced, AID, and RSSCN7 show consistent PSNR improvements across $\times 2$ and $\times 4$ settings and favorable LPIPS results at $\times 4$. Qualitative results further demonstrate improved preservation of small objects, structural boundaries, and repetitive spatial patterns.

</details>


### [94] [Auditing VLM Benchmarks from Existing Evaluation Runs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13548)
*Denis Degtiarev,Anna Gromova,Sergey Katkov,Artem Mikhailin,Safina Mukhamedshina,Albert Nasybullin,Karina Shaikhutdinova,Artem Tuzov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出在VLMEvalKit中加入审计层，复用已保存的VLM评测输出，通过六个检测器和一次去除图像输入的纯文本重跑，对基准本身进行审计并生成逐题报告。审计MMStar发现20.2%题目图像无增益，剔除置换零假设后仍有+3.2pp超额，集中于数学与科学类；同时标记134个所有模型一致选错非金标选项的题目。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM评测每次运行都产生大量逐题artifact，但排行榜只压缩为单一分数后丢弃，未用于检验基准质量。作者希望复用这些输出审计基准自身，识别图像是否真正必要、题目是否存在问题。

Method: 在VLMEvalKit上添加审计层：六个检测器对已保存输出做后处理，并额外做一次移除视觉输入的纯文本重跑；输出逐题报告和聚合统计。关键量附加置换零假设超额、区间估计和模型池敏感性分析。

Result: 审计MMStar（三模型）：20.2%题目图像无聚合准确率增益；项目匹配置换零假设解释17.0%，剩余+3.2pp超额（校正置换p=0.001），集中于数学和科学类，粗感知类无此现象。另一检测器标记134题所有可解析回答的模型都选同一非金标选项，峰值在感知类。用精确字符串匹配替换LLM judge结论不变；评分差异均追溯到一个模型。二值yes/no基准上检测器失准，作为范围边界报告。

Conclusion: 该审计层可复用现有评测artifact低成本审计基准，揭示图像必要性问题与可疑题目，并提供统计校正和敏感性检验；但检测器在二值基准上会失准，需报告适用范围，机制确认仍需逐题人工审查。审计层、预测artifact和生成报告随投稿提供。

Abstract: Every evaluation run of a vision-language model (VLM) already produces per-question artifacts (predictions, judged correctness, metadata) that leaderboards reduce to a single score and then discard. We reuse those artifacts to audit the benchmark itself, and add an audit layer to VLMEvalKit: six detectors that run as post-processing over saved outputs, plus one additional text-only rerun with visual inputs removed, emitting a per-question report. The layer reports per-question findings together with aggregate audit statistics; for the headline quantities, it attaches permutation-null excess where applicable, interval estimates for proportions, and sensitivity to the model pool. Auditing MMStar, a benchmark curated specifically so that the image is indispensable, with three models, we find zero aggregate accuracy gain from the image on 20.2% of its questions. An item-matched permutation null accounts for 17.0%, leaving a +3.2 pp excess (corrected permutation p = 0.001). This excess is concentrated in the mathematics and science categories and is absent from coarse perception, a localization consistent with knowledge substituting for visual evidence; confirming that mechanism would require item-level review. A second detector flags 134 questions on which every model that answered in parseable form picked the same non-gold option, and these candidates peak in the perception categories, whereas the zero-gain excess is largest in mathematics and science & technology. Replacing the LLM judge with exact string matching changes no conclusion, and every scoring discrepancy between the two traces to one model whose free-form answers a parser cannot read. On a binary yes/no benchmark the detectors measurably fall out of calibration, a scope boundary that we measure and report. The audit layer, the prediction artifacts and the generated reports accompany this submission.

</details>


### [95] [ELMA: Benchmarking Anaphoric Compositions for Long-Term Text-to-Motion Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13549)
*Shun Kato,Dixin Yang,Kotaro Amaya,Yuiga Wada,Kazumi Fukuda,Takashi Shibuya,Yuki Mitsufuji,Mariko Isogawa*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出新任务：从含指代的多段指令生成长期人体运动，并发布ELMA数据集以提升长时运动合成的物理真实性与语义一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时人体运动生成对持续运行的数字化身至关重要。现有模型虽在短片段上取得进展，但难以处理涉及指代的多段指令——早期段建立的约束需在后续时段持续保持，即跨段依赖问题。

Method: 提出ELMA：一个带密集段级标注、保留跨段依赖的episodic长期运动数据集，通过全自动收集与过滤流程，从真实视频中提取30秒高质量连续片段；并基于该数据集微调最先进的运动生成模型以引入长程上下文。

Result: 大量实验揭示了当前模型在处理上下文依赖指令时的根本缺陷；ELMA使模型在全局物理真实性与语义对齐两方面均显著提升。

Conclusion: ELMA为长期运动合成建立了新的鲁棒基线，推动了跨段依赖建模的研究方向。

Abstract: Text-guided long-term human motion generation is essential for applications such as continuously operating digital avatars. Despite recent progress on short clips, existing models struggle with multi-segment instructions that involve anaphora, where constraints established in earlier segments must be preserved over time. In this paper, we introduce a novel task of long-term motion generation from such anaphoric compositions. To mitigate this, we present ELMA, an episodic long-term motion dataset with dense segment-level annotations that preserve cross-segment dependencies. Built via a fully automated collection and filtering pipeline, ELMA extracts high-quality, continuous 30-second clips from in-the-wild videos, capturing the episodic narratives necessary for long-range state modeling. Leveraging this dataset, we fine-tune state-of-the-art motion generation models to incorporate long-range context. Extensive experiments reveal fundamental shortcomings in current models when handling context-dependent instructions. We demonstrate that ELMA enables significant improvements in both global physical realism and semantic alignment, setting a robust new baseline for long-term motion synthesis.

</details>


### [96] [Learning Holistic Scene Layout against View Shifts in Cross-View Geo-Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13553)
*Chao Yang,Songlian Li,Zhigang Tu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SCM与HFIG模块，通过空间上下文建模与高频信息引导提升跨视角地理定位的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨视角地理定位受视角变化导致的外观差异和几何畸变影响严重。现有方法多依赖判别性特征学习或显式几何对齐，却忽视了人类匹配场景时依赖多地标空间上下文整合的观察。

Method: 提出空间上下文建模（SCM）模块，沿四个正交方向遍历特征图，并在每个空间位置建模方向表征间的交互，聚合互补方向信息构建场景布局表征；同时引入高频信息引导（HFIG）模块，从频域提取对表观变化不敏感的边缘和轮廓等稳定结构线索，引导模型学习更鲁棒的特征。

Result: 在标准跨视角地理定位基准上取得有竞争力的性能，并在未知朝向和有限视场（FoV）等更具挑战的场景下展现出强鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 通过融合空间上下文与高频结构线索，可有效提升跨视角地理定位的鲁棒性与实用性。

Abstract: Cross-view geo-localization remains challenging due to drastic appearance variations and geometric distortions caused by viewpoint changes. Existing methods primarily rely on discriminative feature learning or explicit geometric alignment, yet often overlook an important observation: humans tend to match scenes by integrating the spatial context of multiple landmarks rather than relying solely on isolated local visual cues. Inspired by this, we propose a Spatial Context Modeling (SCM) module, which traverses feature maps along four orthogonal directions and models interactions among the resulting directional representations at each spatial position. By aggregating complementary directional observations, SCM constructs richer scene layout representations. Since reliable spatial context depends on robust visual features, we introduce a High-Frequency Information Guidance (HFIG) module that extracts stable structural cues from the frequency domain. By emphasizing edges and contours that are less sensitive to appearance variations, HFIG encourages the model to learn more robust representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves competitive performance on standard cross-view geo-localization benchmarks while exhibiting strong robustness under more challenging scenarios with unknown orientations and limited fields of view (FoVs).

</details>


### [97] [What We Talk About When We Talk About Emotion Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13558)
*Xingzu Zhan,Lin Gu,Ruogu Fang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ROI-ReFT，利用fMRI编码模型TRIBE v2的神经表征作为参考，将源图像视觉响应作为内容参考、预测情感响应变化作为编辑方向，指导冻结编辑器实现情感图像编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 情感图像编辑需在保留内容的同时改变情感，而同一场景可有多种情感解读，因此编辑决策必须基于源上下文。受Component Process Model启发，作者探索用神经表征为这些编辑决策提供依据。

Method: 用TRIBE v2分析400对源-目标图像（8类情感）。发现EmoEdit等模型隐藏状态更多对应视觉区域而非情感区域响应。据此提出ROI-ReFT：将源视觉响应作为内容参考、预测情感响应变化作为编辑方向，两个交互分支用这两个条件在生成过程中引导冻结编辑器；生成图像的预测响应用于监督情感变化并约束视觉漂移。

Result: 在后验选取的400个编辑请求子集上，ROI-ReFT达到91.75%的目标情感准确率和83.25%的联合成功率（同时匹配目标情感且源-输出DINO-I≥0.80）。

Conclusion: 神经表征（尤其是视觉与情感区域响应的区分）可为情感图像编辑提供有效参考，ROI-ReFT在情感准确性和内容保持上取得良好效果，代码与数据集将公开。

Abstract: Emotional image editing aims to change the emotion a scene conveys while preserving its essential content. Because the same scene can support different emotional interpretations, achieving an emotional goal requires visual changes grounded in the source context. Motivated by the Component Process Model, which links emotional responses to event appraisal, we investigate neural representations as a reference for these editing decisions. Using TRIBE v2, an fMRI encoding model, we analyze 400 source-target pairs across eight emotion categories. Hidden states from EmoEdit, EmoEditor, and AffectDelta correspond more strongly to predicted target-image responses in visual regions than in affect-related regions. This imbalance motivates ROI-ReFT, which combines source visual responses as a content reference with a predicted affective response change as an editing direction. Two interacting branches use both conditions to guide a frozen editor throughout generation. Predicted responses of the generated image supervise affective change and constrain visual drift. On a post hoc selected subset of 400 editing requests, ROI-ReFT achieves 91.75% target-emotion accuracy and 83.25% joint success, with the same output both matching the target emotion and reaching source-output DINO-I of at least 0.80. Our code and dataset will be publicly released.

</details>


### [98] [Thyroid Nodule Segmentation in Ultrasound Images with Conformal Uncertainty Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13604)
*Francesco Teodori,Pierpaolo Brutti,Umberto Ferraro Petrillo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出整合DeepLabV3+、通道注意力与保形预测的甲状腺结节分割框架，同时输出精确掩膜与像素级不确定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 甲状腺结节在人群中普遍，多数良性但恶性比例不可忽略；超声是主要诊断手段，精确分割是CAD系统进行恶性分类与转移风险评估的前提。

Method: 以DeepLabV3+（ASPP捕获多尺度上下文）搭配EfficientNet-B5为骨干；测试三种通道注意力模块（SE、CBAM、GCA）与两种损失（Dice-BCE、Boundary）；用分裂保形预测层生成具统计覆盖率保证的像素级不确定性图。该分割作为含恶性分类与转移风险预测流水线的第一阶段。

Result: 在TN3K公开基准上以固定划分评估所有配置并与SOTA比较：仅骨干即已超越此前报告结果，CBAM+Dice-BCE为整体最佳配置。

Conclusion: 该框架在保证分割精度的同时提供像素级不确定性，CBAM+Dice-BCE为最优配置，验证通道注意力与保形预测的有效性。

Abstract: Thyroid nodules affect a large proportion of the general population. Although most are benign, a non-negligible fraction is malignant. Ultrasound imaging is the primary diagnostic modality, and accurate nodule segmentation is a prerequisite for CAD systems to classify malignancy and assess metastatic risk.\\ In this work, we propose a thyroid nodule segmentation framework that integrates a DeepLabV3+, channel-attention modules and post-hoc conformal prediction, providing both accurate mask and pixel-level uncertainty estimates. We address thyroid ultrasound nodule segmentation as the first stage of a pipeline that also includes malignancy classification and metastatic risk prediction. We adopt DeepLabV3+, whose Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling (ASPP) captures multi-scale context, with an EfficientNet-B5 backbone for its accuracy-efficiency trade-off. Additionally, we test three channel-attention modules: Squeeze-and-Excitation, CBAM and Grouped Channel Attention (GCA), paired with two loss formulations (Dice-BCE and Boundary).\\ Since binary masks do not indicate prediction confidence, we wrap the trained model with a split conformal prediction layer that produces pixel-level uncertainty maps with statistical coverage guarantees.\\ We evaluate all configurations on the TN3K public benchmark using a fixed split and directly compare them with state-of-the-art methods. The plain backbone already improves upon previously reported results, with CBAM + Dice-BCE emerging as the best overall configuration.

</details>


### [99] [CUBE: Class-conditioned Unknown Boundary Evidence for Open-Set Insect Species Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13610)
*Hao Tan,Qimin Zhang,Zhe Xiao,Zekai Zuo,Wanting Liu,Jinghui Qin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CUBE框架，用类别条件边界证据建模细粒度未知昆虫，实现局部拒识并保持闭集精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实生物多样性场景中，未知昆虫常视觉上接近已知训练类，不像通用OOD样本那样明显异常，而是靠近特定已知物种的决策边界，导致闭集预测不可靠。

Method: CUBE为每个已知物种建模未知性而非单一全局未知类：相对最相似的已知物种评估测试样本，从辅助物种学习类别条件边界证据，推理时保留辅助物种作为影子参考，并加入分类学候选校准验证生物合理性。CUBE-E在可用生态元数据时加轻量位置一致性项，不修改视觉主干。

Result: 在Open-Insect C-America基准上，CUBE在local、non-local、non-moth未知划分上AUROC达95.8%、98.7%、99.1%，闭集精度94.9%；CUBE-E提升至96.0%、99.7%、99.5%，闭集精度95.2%。

Conclusion: CUBE通过类别条件边界证据有效应对细粒度未知昆虫识别，CUBE-E借助生态元数据进一步改进，均优于现有方法。

Abstract: Open-set insect species recognition faces significant challenges when deployed in real-world biodiversity scenarios, particularly when encountering unknown species that are visually close to known training classes. Unlike generic out-of-distribution samples, fine-grained unknown insects are often not visually anomalous. They instead tend to appear near the decision boundary of specific known species, leading to unreliable closed-set predictions. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{Class-conditioned Unknown Boundary Evidence (CUBE)}, a novel evidence-based framework that models unknownness around each known species rather than as a single global unknown class. Our key idea is to evaluate a test sample relative to the known species it most closely resembles, enabling local rejection for visually confusable unknown insects. CUBE learns class-conditioned boundary evidence from auxiliary species, preserves auxiliary species as shadow references during inference, and incorporates taxonomic candidate calibration to verify biological plausibility. When ecological metadata is available, we further introduce CUBE-E, which adds a lightweight location-consistency term without modifying the visual backbone. Experiments on the Open-Insect C-America benchmark show that CUBE achieves superior performance, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines with 95.8\%, 98.7\%, and 99.1\% AUROC on local, non-local, and non-moth unknown splits, respectively, while maintaining 94.9\% closed-set accuracy. With ecological metadata, CUBE-E further improves the results to 96.0\%, 99.7\%, and 99.5\% AUROC with 95.2\% closed-set accuracy.

</details>


### [100] [Benchmarking Answer-Grounding Consistency in Remote Sensing Visual Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13636)
*Ping Guo,Zhiqi Huang,Xinran Li,Linkun Yu,Jingyin Pei,Kamata Seiichiro*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出AESP协议评估遥感VQA中答案与定位证据的一致性，并构建G-RSVQA基准，发现现有模型普遍存在证据支持失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有遥感VQA评测只衡量答案正确性和定位质量，未直接评估答案与定位证据是否一致。

Method: 提出Answer-Evidence Support Protocol (AESP)，针对存在、计数、比较三类问题应用特定规则判断证据是否支持答案；并构建G-RSVQA基准（15,027样本）。

Result: 在七个grounded视觉-语言模型上测试，三类问题均出现证据支持失败；证据评估子集中高达50.82%的正确答案缺乏定位证据支持。

Conclusion: 答案正确不等同于答案-证据一致，AESP和G-RSVQA揭示了grounded RSVQA中的关键缺陷。

Abstract: In grounded remote sensing visual question answering, a model produces a textual answer and identifies relevant objects in the image as grounding evidence. Existing evaluations measure answer correctness and localization quality, but do not directly assess answer-grounding consistency. We propose the Answer-Evidence Support Protocol (AESP) to assess this consistency through evidence support: whether the grounding evidence supports the model's own answer. AESP applies task-specific rules to existence, counting, and comparison questions. We further construct the Grounded Remote Sensing Visual Question Answering (G-RSVQA) benchmark, containing 15,027 samples with questions, reference answers, and all related object-level annotations. Experiments on seven grounded vision--language models reveal failures of evidence support across all three question types. Up to 50.82% of correct answers in the evidence evaluation subset are not supported by the provided grounding evidence.

</details>


### [101] [PhysForge: Material-Controllable 3D Reconstruction with Separable Components](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13681)
*Yuchen Wang,Yanqi Bao,Zheng Gu,Zhengqing Chen,Jieqi Shi,Jing Huo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PhysForge 是一个基于视频扩散模型的框架，通过 PhysFit 和 PhysComp 两个模块实现材料可控的物理拟合与部件级交互建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有物理3D生成方法对材料行为控制有限，仅依赖外观推断，且难以从物体间复杂交互和语义部件中估计物理属性。

Method: 包含两个模块：PhysFit 利用材料条件化的VDM动态作为参考进行物理属性拟合，引入窗口拟合聚焦材料揭示性交互，并用幻觉强制（Hallucinated Forcing）分离VDM的非物理运动幻觉与材料响应；PhysComp 将复杂交互分解为单独物体和语义部件，实现物理参数独立优化与灵活组合。

Result: 在 PhysAssets 和 Google Scanned Objects 上，相比现有方法，PhysForge 对材料依赖的物理响应控制更强，支持部件级物理建模；在常见和罕见材料上均获得最佳 CLIP 与物理可控性分数，定性比较、部件级消融和用户研究均支持该改进。

Conclusion: PhysForge 有效提升了物理3D生成中的材料可控性与部件级交互建模能力。

Abstract: Recent advances in physical 3D generation have enabled visually faithful assets with simulatable mechanical behavior. However, existing methods provide limited control over material behavior beyond appearance-based inference and struggle to estimate physical properties from complex interactions between objects and semantic parts. Therefore, we present PhysForge, a Video Diffusion Model (VDM)-based framework for addressing these challenges, comprising two complementary modules for material-controllable physical fitting and componentlevel interaction modeling. The first, PhysFit, leverages material-conditioned VDM dynamics as references for physical-property fitting, introducing windowed fitting to focus on material-revealing interactions and Hallucinated Forcing to disentangle nonphysical motion hallucinated by the VDM from material responses. The second, PhysComp decomposes complex interactions into individual objects and semantic components, enabling their physical parameters to be optimized independently and flexibly composed for joint simulation. Experiments on PhysAssets and Google Scanned Objects demonstrate that, compared with existing methods, PhysForge provides stronger control over material-dependent physical responses while supporting component-level physical modeling for complex interactions. It achieves the best CLIP and physical controllability scores on both common and uncommon materials, with qualitative comparisons, component-level ablations, and a user study further supporting these improvements. Our project page is available at https://masterwanna.github.io/PhysForge.html .

</details>


### [102] [X-AVDD: Cross-Attentive Audio-Visual Dataset Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13687)
*Saumyaranjan Mohanty,Aravind Reddy,Konda Reddy Mopuri*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 X-AVDD，一种基于交叉注意力的音视频数据集蒸馏方法，通过解耦跨模态对齐与联合优化，大幅降低显存与合成成本，并显著提升性能与泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音视频数据集蒸馏方法（如 DM、AVDD）存在两个关键缺陷：1）显存占用高，难以扩展到复杂架构和更高 SPC 设置；2）难以保留强跨模态语义对应关系。

Method: 提出 X-AVDD，一种基于交叉注意力的蒸馏方法，在合成过程中显式捕获模态间关系；通过将跨模态对齐与联合优化解耦，提高显存效率。

Result: 端到端合成成本降低约 8 倍 GPU 小时。VGGSound 上 SPC=10 时 top-1 从 8.2%提升至 24.0%，SPC=20 时从 9.8%提升至 26.5%；AVE 上 SPC=50 对 ViT 目标的跨架构泛化从 25.5%提升至 35.3%；可扩展至 AudioCLIP，仅用 5.65% 数据达到 62.3% 准确率（全数据为 72.4%），训练时间降低 9 倍。

Conclusion: X-AVDD 在内存效率、合成数据质量、跨架构泛化及大规模复杂架构扩展性方面均优于现有音视频蒸馏方法。

Abstract: Audio-visual dataset distillation aims to synthesize a small dataset from a large paired audio-visual dataset, while nearly preserving the training utility for neural networks. Existing approaches such as DM and AVDD face two critical limitations: 1) they are memory-intensive, making them difficult to scale to complex architectures and higher samples-per-class (SPC) settings, and 2) they often fail to preserve strong cross-modal semantic correspondence. To tackle these issues, we propose X-AVDD, a cross-attention-based distillation method that explicitly captures inter-modal relationships during synthesis. By decoupling cross-modal alignment from joint optimization, X-AVDD is substantially more memory-efficient, reducing end-to-end synthesis cost by $\sim 8\times$ GPU-hours, while producing highly aligned synthetic data. Empirically, X-AVDD significantly outperforms other audio-visual distillation methods. On VGGSound, an audio-visual dataset of short YouTube clips, X-AVDD improves top-1 test accuracy from $8.2\%\rightarrow24.0\%$ at SPC=$10$ and $9.8\%\rightarrow26.5\%$ at SPC=$20$. Furthermore, X-AVDD improves cross-architecture generalization (e.g., $25.5\%\rightarrow35.3\%$ for a ViT target on AVE dataset at SPC $=50$) and successfully scales to complex architectures such as AudioCLIP, achieving $62.3\%$ accuracy using only $5.65\%$ of the full dataset, against the full dataset accuracy of $72.4\%$ while completing in $9\times$ lower training time compared to the full dataset.

</details>


### [103] [OccludeBench: Can VLMs Find What's Missing?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13790)
*Jasin Cekinmez,Addison J. Wu,Ryo Mitsuhashi,Linrong Cai,Xingyu Fu,Zhuang Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 OccludeBench 基准与 OccludeTrace 诊断框架，研究视觉语言模型对图像中被完全遮挡物体的推理能力。发现模型在"直接线索"（如阴影、反光）案例上准确率（42.7%）显著低于"推断性"案例（62.7%），差距达 20 点，而人类无此差距；瓶颈在于从整图中提取相关物体信息。inpaint-then-confront 干预可消除该差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究 VLMs 能否依据图像中残留的视觉证据（阴影、反光等物理线索或场景上下文）推理出被完全遮挡的物体，并定位其失败环节。

Method: 构建人工标注基准 OccludeBench，区分"直接"案例（依赖具体物理线索）与"推断性"案例（依赖场景上下文）；提出四阶段诊断框架 OccludeTrace 定位推理崩溃点；测试扩展推理、工具使用、少样本提示及 inpaint-then-confront 干预。

Result: 五个 VLM 在直接案例平均准确率 42.7%，推断性案例 62.7%，差距 20.0 点；人类分别为 63.4% 和 68.5%，无显著差距。失败瓶颈出现在从整图中恢复相关物体的投影阶段：失败案例仅 50% 成功，而答对案例达 91%。扩展推理、工具使用、少样本提示效果不稳定。inpaint-then-confront 干预（先生成候选隐藏物体再对照可见物理线索验证）将差距降至统计不显著，对两个具备图像生成能力的模型均有效。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个可控、可诊断的框架，用于隔离并分析 VLMs 在图像缺失内容推理上的失败机制，并表明针对性的生成-验证干预能有效消除直接与推断案例间的性能差距。

Abstract: How well can vision-language models (VLMs) reason about what is missing from an image? We study this question with OccludeBench, a manually curated benchmark for recovering fully occluded objects from the visual evidence that remains. OccludeBench distinguishes direct cases, where the hidden object must be recovered from a specific physical cue such as a shadow or reflection, from inferential cases, where it can be inferred from broader scene context. Across five VLMs, accuracy averages 42.7% on direct cases versus 62.7% on inferential cases, exhibiting a 20.0-point gap. Humans attain higher accuracies of 63.4% versus 68.5% for direct and inferential images, respectively, with no significant gap. To locate this failure, we introduce OccludeTrace, a four-stage diagnostic that isolates where the visual reasoning process breaks down. The bottleneck emerges when models must recover the relevant object from the projection within the full image: they succeed on only 50% of failed examples, compared with 91% of examples they answer correctly. Extended reasoning, tool use, and few-shot prompting yield inconsistent improvements and do not reliably eliminate the gap. In contrast, an inpaint-then-confront intervention, which prompts models to first generate a candidate hidden object and then evaluate that hypothesis against the visible physical cue, reduces the gap to a statistically non-significant difference for both models with image-generation capabilities. Together, our results establish a tractable, controlled diagnostic for isolating how VLMs reason about visual content that is missing from an image.

</details>


### [104] [Improving Semantic Coverage in AI Test & Evaluation through Generative Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13697)
*Connor Hashemi,Bharadwaj Ravichandran,Connor Anderson,Shitij Govil,Brandon RichardWebster,Brian Hu,Keith Fieldhouse*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出三阶段生成式AI流水线，无需语义标签即可检测并填补测试集语义覆盖缺口，仅用于测试集增强而不重训练模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI模型的测试与评估通常只有留出测试集，若关键输入条件（如时段、天气、场景位置）在测试集中欠代表，会产生误导性的T&E结论。

Method: 三阶段：1) VLM零样本二值标注语义因子，嵌入空间聚类识别影响模型行为最大的语义；2) 扩散图像到图像模型将已覆盖图像转换到欠代表语义域，保留场景内容并增强高层外观；3) 统计分析增强图像嵌入以验证覆盖率提升。

Result: 在图像分类和目标检测的昼夜语义缺口上验证，增强测试集能更好区分接触与未接触缺失语义的模型，T&E结论更接近理想全覆盖数据集。

Conclusion: 该流水线无需真值语义标签即可有效填补测试集语义缺口，合成数据仅用于丰富测试集，提升T&E可信度。

Abstract: In test and evaluation (T&E) of AI models, evaluators typically have access only to a held-out test dataset and no knowledge of the training data or its semantic composition. If critical input conditions---such as time-of-day, weather, or scene location---are underrepresented in this test dataset, T&E results can be misleadingly due to this semantic coverage gap. We propose a three-stage generative AI pipeline to detect and fill such semantic gaps without requiring ground-truth labels of these semantics. First, vision-language models (VLMs) perform zero-shot binary labeling of semantic factors, and an embedding-space clustering step identifies which semantics most affect downstream model behavior. Second, diffusion-based image-to-image models transform existing covered images into the underrepresented semantic domain, preserving scene content while augmenting high-level appearance. Third, statistical analysis of the augmented image embeddings verifies that the synthetic imagery improves dataset coverage before it is incorporated. Crucially, the synthetic data is used only to enrich the test set and no model retraining is performed for T&E. We validate the full pipeline on both image classification and object detection under day/night semantic gaps, showing that the augmented test datasets better distinguish models with and without exposure to the missing semantic, thereby yielding T&E conclusions that more closely match those of an ideal, fully covered dataset. Code available at https://github.com/Hashe037/DEDUCE

</details>


### [105] [GLIMPSE: Global-Local Indexing with Multi-Precision Spectral Encoding for Explorable Video World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13706)
*Zhufeng Xu,Henglei Lv,Bailin Deng,Yikang Ding,Xiaoqiang Liu,Guoxin Zhang,Hongbo Fu,Lin Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GLIMPSE提出一种全局-局部记忆接口，通过分带多精度坐标与几何条件频谱衰减，降低对不准确投影地址的敏感性，提升相机可控视频世界模型的一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相机返回同一场景时，视频世界模型需保持场景一致。将特征渲染到目标帧的记忆方法会把深度和位姿误差转化为重影或重复结构；位置传输虽避免重采样，但对不准确投影仍赋予完整位置精度，导致敏感性问题。

Method: GLIMPSE采用全局-局部记忆接口，含分带多精度坐标（band-wise multi-precision coordinates）和几何条件频谱衰减（geometry-conditioned spectral attenuation）。局部块记忆提供视角相关外观，循环全局记忆提供场景上下文；并用足迹引导检索（footprint-guided retrieval）在固定局部读取预算下选取历史块。

Result: 在匹配的检索与读取预算下，GLIMPSE在几何对应和光度一致性上优于确定性的位置传输方法。

Conclusion: GLIMPSE通过多精度坐标与频谱衰减提升了对投影误差的鲁棒性，改善了视频世界模型的场景一致性与几何、光度表现。

Abstract: A camera-controlled video world model must keep a scene consistent when the camera returns to it. Memories that render stored features into the target frame can turn depth and pose errors into ghosting or duplicated structure. Positional transport avoids that resampling by relocating a historical patch's address rather than its content, but assigns full positional precision even to inaccurate projections. We present GLIMPSE, a global-local memory interface with band-wise multi-precision coordinates and geometry-conditioned spectral attenuation to reduce sensitivity to inaccurate projected addresses. Local patch memory supplies view-specific appearance, while recurrent global memory provides scene context. Footprint-guided retrieval selects historical patches under a fixed local read budget. Under matched retrieval and read budgets, GLIMPSE improves geometric correspondence and photometric consistency over deterministic positional transport.

</details>


### [106] [State-Isolated Vision Mamba via Update-Tendency Routing for Underwater Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13720)
*Yan Luo,Laibin Chang,Zefan Feng,Yi'ang Chen,Kui Jiang,Zhengguo Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出"状态争用"问题，并引入"状态隔离"原则与IsoMamba架构，在水下图像增强任务上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Vision Mamba研究主要关注token序列化、扫描策略或专家路由，却忽视了状态层面的问题：将具有异质更新行为的token强制共享同一隐状态，会导致持续的跨内容干扰（状态争用）。论文主张应根据token兼容性而非顺序来组织状态演化。

Method: 提出"状态隔离"原则，让更新倾向兼容的token在独立循环状态流中演化。实例化为IsoMamba：基于Δ引导构建模型内在更新表示，通过无标签聚类发现更新兼容的token组，并按"聚类-路由-隔离"范式将其路由到独立的Mamba专家。此外设计动态通道重加权目标，补偿水下图像中依赖波长的重建难度。

Result: 在多个水下图像增强基准上持续取得SOTA性能，同时产生更干净的隐状态响应，验证了状态隔离循环建模的有效性。

Conclusion: 状态隔离为Vision Mamba提供了一种按token兼容性组织状态演化的新范式，能有效缓解状态争用，提升异构视觉复原任务表现。

Abstract: Vision Mamba has recently emerged as an efficient alternative to convolutional and Transformer-based architectures by modeling long-range spatial dependencies through recurrent state evolution. Existing studies primarily improve token serialization, scanning strategies, or expert routing, yet largely overlook a state level question question: how should recurrent states be organized for spatially heterogeneous visual restoration? In this paper, we show that forcing tokens with heterogeneous update behaviors to recurrently modify a shared hidden state leads to persistent cross-content interference, which we term \textbf{State Contention}. We further argue that effective recurrent modeling should organize state evolution according to token compatibility rather than token ordering. Based on this observation, we introduce \textbf{State Isolation}, a new recurrent state organization principle for Vision Mamba,tokens with compatible state-update tendencies evolve within independent recurrent state streams. To instantiate this principle, we propose \textbf{IsoMamba}, a $Δ$-guided architecture that constructs model-intrinsic update representations, discovers update-compatible token groups through label-free clustering, and routes them to isolated Mamba experts following a \textbf{cluster--route--isolate} paradigm. In addition, we develop a dynamic channel-wise reweighting objective to compensate for wavelength-dependent reconstruction difficulty in underwater images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that IsoMamba consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple underwater image enhancement benchmarks while providing cleaner hidden state responses, validating the effectiveness of state isolated recurrent modeling.

</details>


### [107] [LAPT-Scale: Scaling Embodied Policies with Latent Action Pre-Training on Human Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13732)
*Zhiyuan Xiang,Peidong Liu,Mingyang Li,Jiawei Li,Wenhow Li,Wenbo Ding,Xiang Deng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出LAPT-Scale，一种可扩展的潜在动作预训练范式，利用大规模自我中心人类视频为VLA机器人策略提供隐式动作监督，显著提升真实机器人任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用机器人策略的扩展受限于具身交互数据的高昂采集成本。大规模人类自我中心视频是丰富替代品，但缺乏机器人动作标签，且现有动作标注方法在真实视觉复杂度和多样操作动态下往往噪声大。

Method: LAPT-Scale包含两部分：LAPT-Scale-LAM通过在人类视频中解释帧间视觉转换学习连续潜在动作，作为人类监督信号，并采用连续潜在空间（而非向量量化）保留细粒度运动动态，结合感知、语义和光流对齐信号改进转换级监督；LAPT-Scale-Policy则通过人类视频潜在动作预训练、目标机器人具身对齐和任务特定后训练来训练VLA策略。

Result: 在23.3K小时自我中心视频上训练，提供隐式动作监督用于策略预训练，获得一致的扩展增益，当标注人类视频从1K扩展到5K小时时，真实机器人成功率从63.3%提升至85.0%，且策略能泛化到未见过的视觉条件。

Conclusion: 连续潜在动作预训练结合多信号对齐与具身对齐，可有效利用大规模人类视频扩展机器人策略，实现显著的性能提升与视觉泛化能力。

Abstract: Scaling generalist robotic policies is limited by the high cost of collecting embodied interaction data. Large-scale egocentric human videos offer a rich alternative, but they lack robot action labels, and existing action annotation methods are often noisy under real-world visual complexity and diverse manipulation dynamics. We introduce LAPT-Scale, a scalable latent action pre-training paradigm with two components: LAPT-Scale-LAM learns continuous latent actions by explaining frame-to-frame visual transitions in human videos and uses them as human-derived supervision, while LAPT-Scale-Policy trains a VLA policy through human-video latent-action pre-training, target-robot embodiment alignment, and task-specific post-training. Unlike prior vector-quantized LAMs, LAPT-Scale-LAM uses a continuous latent space to preserve fine-grained motion and interaction dynamics. We further combine perceptual, semantic, and optical-flow alignment signals to improve transition-level supervision beyond pixel reconstruction. Trained on 23.3K hours of egocentric video, LAPT-Scale-LAM provides implicit action supervision for policy pre-training, yielding consistent scaling gains and improving real-robot success from 63.3% to 85.0% as annotated human video scales from 1K to 5K hours. The learned policy also generalizes to unseen visual conditions.

</details>


### [108] [KVeil: First-Place Solution to ECCV 2026 LifeGenIP Challenge on Unlearnable Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13733)
*Boheng Li,Yueming Xing,Yiming Li,Jie Zhang,Han Qiu,Tianwei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ECCV 2026 LifeGenIP 挑战赛（不可学习视频）第一名的两种方案：Phase 1 用参考容量崩溃损失+运动引导 EOT 破坏参考条件；Phase 2 设计双层框架分别保护人脸与背景区域以应对微调与未见模型。白盒下近乎完美防护，其他范式也有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化视频生成使少数人脸视频即可复制身份，引发严重身份隐私担忧，需在有限且不可察觉的扰动预算下防止面部视频被未授权定制。

Method: Phase 1：参考容量崩溃（一对互补损失，降低参考条件所携带信息，同时保持后续视频表示依赖它）+ 运动引导 EOT 提升对未知推理条件的鲁棒性。Phase 2：双层框架，分别保护人脸和背景区域；人脸区域用合成目标身份构造结构对齐扰动，背景区域强化 Phase 1 的白盒破坏。均基于 LETHE。

Result: 在白盒基于参考的定制下实现近乎完美的防护；在其他定制范式、多种模型和时间攻击下仍然有效。两个阶段均获 LifeGenIP 挑战赛第一名。

Conclusion: 两种方案有效保护面部视频免受未授权定制，希望启发后续研究。代码已开源。

Abstract: The rapid development of personalized video generation has raised serious concerns over identity privacy, as a few facial videos of a person now suffice to reproduce their identity in synthetic videos. This report presents the first-place solutions to both phases of the ECCV 2026 LifeGenIP Challenge on Unlearnable Videos, which aims to protect facial videos from unauthorized customization under a limited and imperceptible perturbation budget. For Phase 1, we introduce Reference Capacity Collapse, a pair of complementary losses that degrade the information carried by the reference condition while keeping subsequent video representations dependent on it, together with a Motion-Guided EOT mechanism that improves robustness across unknown inference conditions. Phase 2 further considers tuning-based customization and unseen generative models. To address both threats within a single perturbation, we design a two-layer framework that protects the facial and background regions separately, constructing structure-aligned perturbations from a synthetic target identity in the former and strengthening the white-box disruption of Phase 1 in the latter. Our method achieves nearly perfect protection under white-box reference-based customization, and remains effective under other customization paradigms, various models, and temporal attacks. Both solutions are built upon our recent work LETHE. We hope our solutions can inspire future work on protecting facial videos against unauthorized customization. Our code is available at https://github.com/AntigoneRandy/KVeil.

</details>


### [109] [Gaussian Splatting with Reflections Guided by What is Seen](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13757)
*Yiming Liang,Tianyu Xiao,Hiroshi Ishikawa*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于2DGS的框架，利用输入图像中直接可观测的环境信息并结合混合反射外观表示与视角相关高光建模，在近场反射场景中实现更优的渲染质量与几何精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NeRF与3DGS在常见场景表现优异，但难以捕捉视角相关的高光效果，尤其是近场反射。现有方法用环境贴图（仅表示无穷远光源）或环境高斯（仅靠反射间接监督），不足以精确建模近场反射。

Method: 基于2D高斯散射（2DGS）的框架，直接利用输入图像中可观测的环境信息；引入混合反射外观表示与视角相关高光建模。

Result: 在公开基准和新建的近场反射数据集上，渲染质量与几何精度均优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 利用直接可观测的环境信息可有效提升近场反射的建模能力，为视角相关高光与反射的新视角合成提供了更优方案。

Abstract: While novel view synthesis methods like Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have shown impressive performance on common scenes, they often struggle with capturing view-dependent specular effects, particularly near-field reflections. Existing methods utilize environment maps, which only represent lights from infinity, or environment Gaussians, which rely solely on indirect supervision from reflections, are insufficient for accurately modeling such effects. Here, we propose a framework based on 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) that leverages directly observable environment information in input images. Our approach also integrates a hybrid reflection appearance representation and view-dependent specular modeling. Experiments on public benchmarks and a newly curated near-field reflection dataset demonstrate that our method achieves superior rendering quality and geometric accuracy.

</details>


### [110] [Neurons++: A Unified Visual-Stream Framework for Image and Video Reconstruction from fMRI with Neural-to-Visual Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13763)
*Haonan Wang,Yuchen Wang,Jingyu Lu,Qixiang Zhang,Lehan Wang,Xuanqi Huang,Xiaomeng Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Neurons++ 是一个视觉流 fMRI 重建框架，可同时用于静态图像和动态视频重建，并实现 SOTA 视频重建效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式解码方法虽能重建出看似逼真的图像和视频，但视觉合理性并不能保证输出忠实于大脑活动，因此需要更忠实于神经信号的重建方法。

Method: 采用串行、受皮层启发的解码替代并行任务条件；先进行图像-fMRI 预训练获得稳定的空间-语义初始化，再分别针对图像和视频进行被试特异微调，将 fMRI 表示组织为空间、语义、语言级和时间线索。

Result: 在标准基准上实现 SOTA 视频重建和有竞争力的图像重建；神经-视觉分析显示神经扰动下具有方向可控性、fMRI 编码器读出的皮层特征敏感性，以及支持 ROI 引导的语义调制。

Conclusion: Neurons++ 从仅视频重建扩展到图像与视频的视觉流重建，兼顾重建保真度与神经忠实性，并具备神经扰动可控性。

Abstract: Decoding visual experience from fMRI is important for understanding human perception and developing brain-computer interfaces. Recent generative decoding methods can reconstruct plausible images and videos, but visual plausibility alone does not ensure that the output is faithfully grounded in brain activity. In this work, we propose Neurons++, a visual-stream fMRI reconstruction framework for both static image and dynamic video reconstruction. Compared with our conference version Neurons, Neurons++ extends the paradigm from video-only reconstruction to visual-stream reconstruction for both images and videos, and replaces parallel task conditioning with serial cortex-inspired decoding. The model first uses image-fMRI pretraining to obtain a stable spatial-semantic initialization, and then performs subject-specific fine-tuning for image and video reconstruction separately. The serial design organizes fMRI-derived representations into explicit spatial, semantic, language-level, and temporal cues.
