Our analysis reveals four key issues: (1) LZW's compression algorithm creates an implicit conflict between the input embedding and the output embedding, a tension that a single shared embedding cannot resolve; (2) naively applying RoPE to LZW-compressed sequences ignores that merged tokens can span multiple tokens; (3) merging certain tokens (notably digits) disproportionately hurts downstream accuracy; and (4) dynamic vocabularies introduce an inherent segmentation ambiguity that confounds standard evaluation. We address these through decoupled input/output dynamic embedding layer, size-aware RoPE positioning, and a modified LZW codec supporting selective merges and multi-view segmentations. Across four models, our recipe improves perplexity on every corpus we evaluated as well as mathematical reasoning accuracy, closing roughly half the quality gap between zip2zip and the uncompressed baseline at a similar compression ratio on general text. This represents a significant step toward lossless adaptive-vocabulary compression for language models.

</details>


### [184] [BLiMPPI: Benchmark of Linguistic Minimal Pairs for Polarity Items](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13607)
*Arzu Burcu Güven,Anna Rogers,Leonie Weissweiler,Joakim Nivre,Rob van der Goot*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 BLiMPPI，一个涵盖33种语言、超过12000个负极性项（NPI）最小对立对的多语言评测套件，用于评估语言模型对NPI的语法知识。结果显示多语言模型在低资源语言和无法用n-gram解决的对立对上表现最差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 负极性项（如"anymore"、"ever"）的语法性依赖句法与语义，在理论语言学中有丰富的多语言研究，但语言模型中的NPI研究几乎只限于英语，缺乏多语言评测资源。

Method: 构建BLiMPPI：通过流水线在通用依存（UD）树库中发现NPI、标注其允准环境，并将其扰动为最小对立对，最终形成33种语言、超12000个NPI最小对立对的评测集。评估12个多语言模型、2个单语模型及n-gram基线，并分析NPI类型学、语系、允准变异性和NPI-允准语距离的影响。

Result: 多语言模型在低资源语言以及无法用n-gram解决的对立对上表现最差；同时考察了NPI类型学、语系、允准变异性和NPI-允准语距离等因素的影响。

Conclusion: BLiMPPI为NPI的多语言模型评测提供了新资源，揭示了多语言模型在低资源语言和复杂句法语义依赖上的不足，并公开了数据。

Abstract: Negative polarity items (NPIs), such as "anymore" and "ever", are grammatical only in select environments, predominantly in the context of negation. Because their grammaticality depends on both syntax and semantics, they have a rich, multilingual literature in theoretical linguistics, yet work on NPIs in language models is almost entirely confined to English. We introduce BLiMPPI, a multilingual evaluation suite of over 12,000 NPI minimal pairs in 33 languages, built by a pipeline that discovers NPIs in Universal Dependencies (UD) treebanks, labels their licensing environments, and perturbs these into minimal pairs. Evaluating 12 multilingual and 2 monolingual models alongside n-gram baselines, we find that multilingual models struggle most with lower-resource languages and with pairs that are not n-gram solvable. We further examine the effects of NPI typology, language family, licensing variability, and NPI-licenser distance. Data: https://github.com/arzuburcuguven/blimppi-data

</details>


### [185] [Training User Simulators with Latent Intrinsic Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13617)
*Tarek Naous,Craig Boutilier,Wei Xu,Ofer Meshi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"内在反馈"用户模拟器——在每轮对话中携带潜在评估状态（内心想法、反应、评分），从第一人称视角评估助手。训练后可用于提升模拟真实性与批判行为，提供轮级评估，并作为多轮RL的高效奖励信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有用户模拟器侧重生成真实用户话语，忽略了其作为助手回复直接反馈来源的潜力；而评估信号常隐藏在用户潜在推理中，未显式表达于语言。

Method: 为模拟器配备内在评估状态（内心想法、反应、标量评分），用真实用户与助手的交互日志训练LLM模拟器，使其每轮从用户视角评估助手。

Result: 内在反馈模拟器相比提示式基线，模拟真实性和批判能力更强，并具备现有微调模拟器缺乏的轮级评估；其评估与人类判断相关性更高；作为多轮RL奖励信号，效果媲美外部评判LLM，且RL计算量减少一半以上。

Conclusion: 内在反馈用户模拟器既能提升模拟质量，又能提供有效的轮级评估与高效奖励信号，为多轮对话训练开辟新方向。

Abstract: User simulators are gaining attention as environments to train LLM assistants that can better cope with the nuances of multi-turn conversations with real users. Prior work on user simulation has emphasized generating realistic user utterances, leaving unexplored their potential as a source of direct feedback on the assistant's responses. Such evaluation signals may not be explicitly communicated in language, but can instead reside in the latent reasoning of users. In this work, we introduce user simulators with intrinsic feedback, namely, models equipped with latent evaluation states: internal thoughts, reactions, and scalar ratings that evaluate the assistant from a first-person user perspective at each conversation turn. We train LLM-based simulators using interaction logs between real users and assistants and demonstrate that intrinsic feedback improves simulation realism and critiquing behaviors versus prompted simulator baselines, while also providing turn-level evaluations that existing fine-tuned simulators lack. Further, evaluations generated by our trained simulators correlate better with human judgments than those of prompted simulators of the same size. Lastly, our experiments reveal that simulators with intrinsic feedback provide effective reward signals for multi-turn RL training, matching setups that rely on external judge LLMs for rewards while cutting RL compute by more than half.

</details>


### [186] [AMLworld-Compact: Importance-Weighted Downsampling for Cost-Effective LLM Evaluation and Error Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13627)
*Natapong Nitarach,Phume Ngampornsukswadi,Pittawat Taveekitworachai,Surapon Nonesung,Warit Sirichotedumrong,Kunat Pipatanakul*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 AMLworld-Compact 评测集，通过 HT-Coreset 采样与 Horvitz-Thompson 加权，在显著降低评测成本的同时无偏估计混淆计数，并审计了 LLM 在 AML 任务上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在 AMLworld 最小测试集上评测 LLM 成本极高：超百万目标每个都需单独图提示。采样虽可降本，但小型平衡子集会改变无加权 precision 和 F1，需更可靠的降本评测方案。

Method: 构建 AMLworld-Compact：保留所有非法交易，按监督分数分层采样良性交易；HT-Coreset 协议减少评测目标 271x（HI-Small）与 611x（LI-Small）；用 Horvitz-Thompson 权重给出全测试集混淆计数的无偏估计；以 GFP 特征的提升树定义分层，另一样本族用于评估，每配置 500 次抽取。

Result: 发布规模下 F1 RMSE 为 0.00–2.58 个百分点，优于均匀采样的 4.44–7.41；保守区间仍较宽。所评测的图提示下，七个开放权重 LLM 的加权 precision 接近"全预测非法"基线。1,000 条 HI-Small few-shot 输出审计中，正确判定的词法检查通过率 84.5%、错误判定 56.2%，说明词法标记无法确证正确性。

Conclusion: AMLworld-Compact 在保持 recall 精确、precision/F1 为比率估计的前提下，大幅降低评测成本并给出更可靠的精度估计；公开了评测集、构建代码与审计工具。词法检查不足以判断 LLM 二元判定正确性。

Abstract: Evaluating large language models (LLMs) on AMLworld's smallest test splits is costly because each of over a million targets requires a separate graph prompt. Sampling reduces this cost, but small balanced subsets change unweighted precision and F1. We introduce AMLworld-Compact, an evaluation set that retains every illicit test transaction and samples benign transactions from supervised-score strata. Its HT-Coreset protocol reduces evaluation targets by 271x and 611x on HI-Small and LI-Small. Horvitz-Thompson weights give unbiased full-test confusion-count estimates for fixed predictions; recall is exact, while precision and F1 are ratio estimates. In a held-out study using Graph Feature Preprocessor (GFP) features, one boosted-tree family defines strata for evaluating the other over 500 draws per configuration. At the released sizes, F1 RMSE is 0.00-2.58 percentage points versus 4.44-7.41 for uniform sampling with HT weights; conservative intervals remain broad. Under the evaluated graph prompts, seven open-weight LLMs have weighted precision near the predict-all-illicit baseline. In an outcome-stratified audit of 1,000 HI-Small few-shot outputs from one run per model, lexical checks pass for 84.5% of correct and 56.2% of incorrect binary verdicts, so these markers do not establish correctness. We release the evaluation sets, construction code, and audit tools at https://huggingface.co/datasets/typhoon-ai/AMLworldCompactEval and https://github.com/nat-nischw/AMLworld-Compact.

</details>


### [187] [Multi-Stream Attention Residuals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13630)
*Xiaohan Qin,Xiangdong Zhang,Tuo Dai,Sunan Zou,Huaijin Wu,Yebin Yang,Zhuo Xia,Lin Yao,Yuliang Liu,Junchi Yan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出多流注意力残差(MSAR)，将深度轴注意力扩展为多头形式，以极小开销显著提升大模型预训练效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AttnRes可视为沿网络深度轴的单流softmax注意力。受序列轴多头注意力成功的启发，希望将深度注意力推广到多头，以增强内容依赖的检索能力。

Method: MSAR通过多尺度因果卷积从序列上下文提取流多样性，使不同头以不同上下文视角检索历史表示；检索到的流经轻量自适应混合生成单流层输入。保留单流源并按需扩展，实现多流计算且无需持久化多流存储或通信。

Result: 在18B和28B MoE规模的全部12个下游基准上稳定优于标准残差、mHC和AttnRes。缩放律实验中，相对标准残差达到1.58×等损失计算加速，高于AttnRes的1.35×和mHC的1.30×。

Conclusion: MSAR是大规模预训练中有前景的残差架构。

Abstract: Attention Residuals (AttnRes) enables content-dependent retrieval over network depth, which can be viewed as single-stream softmax attention along the depth axis. Inspired by the success of multi-head attention along the sequence axis, we introduce Multi-Stream Attention Residuals (MSAR), an extension of AttnRes that generalizes this mechanism to multi-head depth attention, yielding substantial performance gains with minimal additional overhead. MSAR draws stream diversity from sequence context through multi-scale causal convolutions, allowing different heads to retrieve historical representations through distinct contextual views while preserving the integrity of the hidden representation. The retrieved streams are combined through lightweight adaptive mixing to generate the single-stream layer input. By retaining single-stream sources and expanding them on demand, MSAR supports multi-stream computation without requiring persistent multi-stream storage or communication. Across all 12 downstream benchmarks at the 18B and 28B MoE scales, MSAR consistently outperforms prior residual variants, including standard residual connections, manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC), and AttnRes. Scaling-law experiments yield an iso-loss compute speedup of $1.58\times$ over the standard residual baseline, compared with $1.35\times$ for AttnRes and $1.30\times$ for mHC. These results make MSAR a promising residual architecture for large-scale pre-training.

</details>


### [188] [Inject a Turn, Not a Token: Learning Where to Redirect LLM Reasoning for Self-Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13672)
*Jiwon Jeon,Myungsik Cho,Jeonghye Kim,Youngchul Sung*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出UPTURN框架，通过训练小型MLP检测失败位置并以新用户轮次注入指令来重定向LLM推理，无需微调LLM即可提升准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM难以可靠识别并纠正自身推理中的错误；现有方法依赖微调LLM生成修订或反馈，成本高。

Method: 在冻结编码器上训练130K参数MLP头，仅用最终答案正确性定位干预位置；发现固定生成预算下内联注入不可靠，改为将指令作为新用户轮次注入，保留前缀重新生成后缀。

Result: 在4种推理器和6个数学基准上，UPTURN相较32次采样基线均提升平均准确率；在匹配纠正预算下优于自纠正与reflection-token注入基线；可跨推理器迁移并泛化到GPQA-Diamond，无需重训；与GRPO和自纠正方法互补。

Conclusion: 无需LLM微调，通过定位干预位置和新用户轮次注入即可有效纠正推理，具备良好迁移性和通用性。

Abstract: Large language models struggle to reliably identify and correct errors in their own reasoning. Unlike prior training-based approaches that fine-tune an LLM to generate revisions or feedback, we learn where to intervene in failed rollouts and determine how to redirect them. To choose where to intervene, we train a 130K-parameter MLP head on a frozen encoder using only final-answer correctness. For redirection, we find that under a fixed generation budget, the tested inline injections fail to reliably redirect reasoning, whereas presenting the same instruction in a new user turn changes the model's course. The resulting correction framework, UPTURN (User-Prompt TURN injection at a learned position), requires no LLM fine-tuning: it retains a selected prefix, injects an instruction as a new user turn, and regenerates the suffix. Across four reasoners and six math benchmarks, UPTURN improves average accuracy in every setting over a 32-rollout baseline. It outperforms self-correction and reflection-token injection baselines under matched correction budgets, transfers across reasoners and to GPQA-Diamond without retraining, and complements GRPO and self-correction methods.

</details>


### [189] [Retractions Revisited: A Replication, Extension, and Mechanistic Evaluation of Linguistic Obfuscation Effects in Fraudulent Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13678)
*David M. Markowitz*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究复制并扩展了"欺诈论文语言更模糊"的假设，对比800篇欺诈论文与800篇真实论文，发现欺诈论文确实更模糊，且"现实监控"（形容词减少）是最佳解释机制，检测准确率高于随机水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前研究认为欺诈科学家语言模糊度更高，可能因模糊增加读者分析成本，但该结论在开放科学时代缺乏额外实证检验，其他心理机制也未被评估。

Method: 对比800篇欺诈论文与800篇真实对照论文（2013-2025）；采用平行中介模型评估三种竞争机制；使用模糊特征及100+语言维度的弹性网进行交叉验证检测。

Result: 支持语言模糊假设，欺诈论文更模糊；现实监控（形容词减少）最能解释欺诈与模糊之间的联系；检测准确率分别为60.7%（模糊特征）和71.6%（弹性网），均显著高于随机。

Conclusion: 研究为科学欺诈与语言心理学提供启示，现实监控机制在识别欺诈性语言中起关键作用。

Abstract: Prior work suggests fraudulent scientists write their articles with higher rates of linguistic obfuscation than genuine scientists, with a possible mechanism suggesting obfuscation makes research more costly for a reader to analyze. This result has not undergone additional empirical scrutiny in the open science era, nor have other psychological mechanisms been evaluated. The current replication and extension addressed this opportunity by comparing 800 fraudulent and 800 genuine control papers (2013-2025). The results supported the linguistic obfuscation hypothesis, suggesting fraudulent papers were more obfuscated than genuine ones. A parallel mediation model evaluated three competing mechanisms, finding that reality monitoring, as measured through decreased rates of adjectives, best explained the link between fraudulent science and linguistic obfuscation. Cross-validated detection accuracy using obfuscation features (60.7%) and an elastic net of over 100 language dimensions (71.6%) were significantly greater than chance. Implications for scientific fraud and psychology of language research are discussed.

</details>


### [190] [Verifiable Retrieval for Legal Reasoning through Structure-driven Knowledge Graph](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13695)
*Ibrahim Siddig,Sviatoslav Tugeev,Munir Georges*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对检索增强生成（RAG）在可靠关键领域（如德国法律）中面临的检索效率问题，提出利用结构驱动的解析构建知识图谱（KG）来改进文档分块与检索，并评估其对引用准确性的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学、法律等可靠性关键领域的自动化必须透明可验证，但当前基于LLM的系统因黑箱特性不满足要求。RAG通过将生成过程锚定在可解释文档上可缓解幻觉，但当潜在来源数量和规模增大时，朴素检索方法性能下降，忽略关键上下文元素。

Method: 以德国法律法典为背景，使用结构驱动的解析（structure-driven parsing）构建知识图谱用于源文档导航与检索，并比较多种KG引导的分块与检索策略。

Result: 评估了不同KG引导的分块与检索策略对检索引用准确性的影响。

Conclusion: 通过知识图谱引导的分块与检索策略，可提升法律领域中RAG检索引用的准确性，为透明可验证的自动化提供方案。

Abstract: Any automation within reliability-critical contexts such as medicine or law has to be transparent and verifiable. Despite their advantages, current LLM-based systems do not meet these requirements due to their inherent black-box nature. Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) attempts to ground the generative process in the relevant interpretable documents, thereby reducing the risk of AI 'hallucinations' and potentially enabling verification of the initial generation context. However, as the number and size of potential sources increases, naive retrieval approaches tend to perform worse, ignoring critical context elements. In this paper we aim to tackle this problem in the context of German Legal Code. Using structure-driven parsing to create a Knowledge Graph (KG) for the source document navigation and retrieval, we compare several KG-informed chunking and retrieval strategies and evaluate their effect on the accuracy of retrieved citations.

</details>


### [191] [Enhancing Legal Reasoning in Pre-trained Language Models via Knowledge Graph-Guided Multi-Task Pre-training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13722)
*Ibrahim Siddig,Munir Georges*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出面向德国交通法（StVO）的多任务预训练方法，通过NSP、知识图谱引导聚类和知识图谱感知段落分类三个目标，将结构化法律知识编码进模型权重，实现零样本法律推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法律语言理解需要对半结构化法规文档进行推理，但现有法律语言模型仅依赖掩码语言建模，将法条文本视为扁平token序列，忽略了其层级结构约束，导致结构推理能力不足。

Method: 提出多任务预训练方法，结合三个互补目标：下一句预测（NSP）、知识图谱引导聚类（CLU）和知识图谱感知段落分类（CLS），将结构化法律知识直接编码到模型权重中，从而在推理时支持零样本法律推理，无需离散图遍历。在9种Transformer编码器和324次实验上进行评估。

Result: 在合成StVO问答任务上，模型相对基线提升10.3%至155.0%；相比LexGLUE基线，在7个法律基准中的4个上取得提升；在奥地利驾驶法规上实现3.4%至15.8%的零样本迁移增益。

Conclusion: 实验结果表明该训练方法能够成功泛化到初始训练法律领域之外，验证了显式编码结构化法律知识的有效性。

Abstract: Legal language understanding requires reasoning over semi-structured regulatory documents, yet standard pre-training objectives do not explicitly target this structural capability. Because current legal language models rely solely on masked language modeling, they treat statutory text as flat token sequences and ignore the underlying hierarchical constraints. To bridge this gap, we present a multi-task pre-training approach for German traffic law (StVO). Our approach combines three complementary objectives: Next Sentence Prediction (NSP), Knowledge Graph (KG) Guided Clustering (CLU), and Knowledge Graph (KG) Aware Paragraph Classification (CLS). This approach explicitly encodes structured legal knowledge directly into the model weights. This encoding enables zero-shot legal reasoning at inference time and removes the need for discrete graph traversal. We evaluate our approach across nine Transformer-based encoders and 324 experimental runs. On synthetic StVO question answering, our models demonstrate consistent relative improvements between 10.3% and 155.0% over baselines. Furthermore, relative to the established LexGLUE baselines (Chalkidis et al., 2022), our models improve over prior results on four of seven legal benchmarks. It also achieves consistent zero-shot transfer gains between 3.4% and 15.8% on Austrian driving regulations. These experimental results indicate that our training approach generalizes successfully beyond the initial training legal domain.

</details>


### [192] [Not Just an Evaluation: A Case Study of Discourse Particle Sensitivity in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13794)
*William Sheffield,Jiahui Chen,Amy Zhang,Alex Warstadt,Junyi Jessy Li,Kanishka Misra*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过行为与机制分析研究LLM对"just"和"only"等语篇助词的敏感度，发现LLM与人类偏好一致、指令微调增强敏感度，且助词表征按语义部分组织。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语篇助词微妙影响话语流，具多功能性且语义重叠，但因效应细微而研究不足；作者希望探究LLM对"just/only"的敏感度及其内部表征。

Method: 采用行为分析与机制分析：比较LLM与人类对助词出现偏好的差异；在有无助词条件下对LLM采样并评估生成概率；定位LLM中对助词敏感的单元并分析"just"与"only"表征重叠。

Result: LLM与人类均偏好助词出现且对"just"更敏感；LLM对含助词语境生成的概率评分更高，指令微调提升敏感度；敏感单元的迁移呈不对称性——"only"单元选择性迁移到排他性"just"，而"just"单元无论语义均能等量迁移到"only"。

Conclusion: LLM的词汇层助词表征部分按语义组织；研究揭示了LLM对细微语篇助词的敏感机制，并公开代码、语义标注对话刺激与人类偏好标注。

Abstract: Discourse particles subtly shape the flow of discourse by reflecting conversational context and interlocutor attitudes, often leaving the truth-conditional meaning untouched. They are also often polyfunctional, with distinct senses which partially overlap with other particles; for example, the exclusive use of English "just" and "only" ("John only/just drinks water"). Despite the frequency of these words in natural language, they have gone largely unstudied due to the subtle nature of their effects. We investigate LLM sensitivity to "just" and "only" in natural conversations using behavioral and mechanistic analyses. First, we find that LLMs and humans similarly prefer the presence of these particles in context, and both are more sensitive to "just" compared to "only". Second, when sampling from LLMs with and without these particles, we find LLMs consistently rate generations as more likely, given their source context, demonstrating their particle sensitivity. In both experiments, instruction tuning increases sensitivity. Finally, we localize particle-sensitive units within LLMs and find the overlap between "just" and "only" is asymmetric: "only" units transfer selectively to exclusive "just", while all "just" units transfer to "only" equally well regardless of sense, suggesting LLM lexical-level particle representations are partially organized by sense. We release our code, sense-labeled dialogue stimuli, and human preference annotations at https://github.com/JiahuiKChen/Not_Just_an_Evaluation.

</details>


### [193] [REFLECT: Role-Aware Detection of Sentiment, Emotion, Politeness, and Formality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13797)
*Sangpil Youm,Annabel Stocks Natalias,Hayden Heninger,Leah Jones,Xiaoyang Jin,Xiaoya Zhang,Bonnie Dorr*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种角色感知的Transformer架构，将情感、情绪、礼貌、正式性（SEPF）四个维度映射到理论驱动的语义角色标注（SRL）配置，并融入自注意力机制以提升对话中交际意义的检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检测对话中的交际意义不仅需要词汇内容，还需要建模参与者的角色结构（表达情感、情绪、礼貌、正式性）。现有方法依赖上下文语言表示，但语义角色仍是隐式的，未显式建模参与角色。

Method: 设计角色感知注意力：非方向性角色注意力建模内部状态（情感、情绪），方向性角色注意力捕捉发起者到接收者的关系（礼貌、正式性）；将角色表示通过可学习门控与上下文嵌入自适应融合，而非作为辅助特征拼接。

Result: 在四个基准数据集上，情绪、礼貌、正式性相比强BERT基线获得统计显著提升，且提升集中于理论预测情形（如低频复杂情绪、高礼貌表达）；情感提升微弱且不显著；额外真实数据评估显示预测性能与模型可追溯性均有改善。

Conclusion: 基于语言学基础的Transformer自注意力修改能提升交际意义检测，可泛化到真实心理健康数据，并提供角色支撑的可追溯解释，兼顾预测性能与可解释性。

Abstract: Detecting communicative meaning in dialogue requires modeling not only lexical content but also the participant-role structures through which sentiment, emotion, politeness, and formality (SEPF) are expressed. Existing approaches rely on contextual language representations while leaving semantic roles implicit. We introduce a role-aware transformer architecture that maps the four SEPF dimensions to theory-grounded Semantic Role Labeling (SRL) configurations, incorporating these configurations directly into the transformer's self-attention mechanism. Role-aware attention models non-directional internal states (sentiment and emotion), while directional role-aware attention captures initiator-to-recipient relations for external cues (politeness and formality). The resulting role-aware representations are fused with contextual embeddings through a learned gate that adaptively weights how much role information each input contributes, rather than appending semantic roles as an auxiliary feature vector. Across four benchmark datasets, the framework yields statistically reliable gains over strong BERT-based baselines for emotion, politeness, and formality, with gains concentrated in theoretically predicted cases such as low-frequency, complex emotions and highly polite expressions; sentiment improvements are marginal and non-significant, suggesting that sentiment is conveyed more through lexical choice than participant-role structure. Additional evaluation on real-world data demonstrates that the framework improves both predictive performance and model traceability. These results demonstrate that linguistically grounded modifications to transformer self-attention improve the detection of communicative meaning, generalize beyond benchmark datasets to real-world mental-health data, and yield traceable, role-grounded explanations that extend beyond predictive performance to interpretability.

</details>


### [194] [Error Rate is Not Enough: Costs of Augmentation in Low-Resource ASR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13807)
*Katsumi Ibaraki,David Chiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文通过音素级错误分析揭示低资源ASR中数据增强为何有效，发现音频增强与文本增强互补，且互补性可由训练暴露度与声学属性预测，但仅在低资源区间（<100小时）成立。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低资源ASR常用数据增强，但现有研究仅报告总体错误率，缺乏对其为何以及何时有帮助的解释。作者希望从音素级错误类型出发，理解不同增强方法的机制与适用条件。

Method: 在四种低资源语言和英语、五种数据规模上，交叉两类增强：修改音频的（speed perturbation、SpecAugment）与修改文本并据此合成音频的（text-based）。进行音素级错误分析，并单独测量训练暴露度和声学属性。

Result: SpecAugment总体改善最稳定，但增加声调和腭化错误；文本方法引入辅音插入；两者结合可互相减少对方引入的错误。声调和腭化由单一声学属性信号表示且训练中出现最少，文本方法（平滑词频）将其频率提高37–38%，从而逆转这些错误。组合方法的改进超过各自改进之和（超加性），但到100小时后超加性消失。

Conclusion: 当特定错误类型重要时，可依据训练暴露度和声学属性选择增强方法，且这两者在训练前即可测量。该互补性仅限于低资源区间，为低资源ASR的增强选择提供了可解释、可预测的依据。

Abstract: Data augmentation is standard practice for low-resource automatic speech recognition (ASR), but its benefits are almost always reported as aggregate error rates, leaving open why and when a method helps. On four low-resource languages and English at five data sizes, we cross two augmentations that modify existing audio (speed perturbation and SpecAugment) with two that modify text transcriptions and synthesize audio from it. We analyze errors at the phoneme level and find that they help for complementary reasons. SpecAugment has the most reliable aggregate improvements, but increases tone and palatalization errors, whereas text-based methods introduce consonant insertions; in combination, each reduces the errors the other introduces. This complementarity is predictable. Tone and palatalization are each signaled by a single acoustic property and occur least frequently in training (lowest training exposure), and text-based methods that flatten word frequency raise their frequency by 37--38%, reversing those errors while further improving aggregate error. The improvement from combining the methods exceeds the sum of their individual improvements; the superadditivity vanishes by 100 hours, limiting the complementarity to the low-resource regime. Where specific error types matter, we recommend selecting augmentation by training exposure and acoustic properties, both measurable before any training.

</details>


### [195] [Can Language Models Learn When to Abstain? Policy Learning and Calibrated Answer Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13821)
*Juan Terven,Diana-Margarita Córdova-Esparza,Ruben Gomez,Carlos Miranda Rocha,Julio-Alejandro Romero-González,Edgar Chavez-Urbiola*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究语言模型何时回答、何时弃答的问题，比较"训练模型自身"与"训练独立选择器"两种方案。在Qwen3-14B上，学习式答案选择器优于原始模型的置信度过滤，但仍无法跨数据集实现可靠弃答。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 好的语言模型应知道何时回答、何时说"我不知道"。作者希望探索能否通过训练模型本身或训练独立组件来校验答案，从而改进弃答决策。

Method: 在Qwen3-14B上针对事实性问题，使用奖励正确答案、惩罚错误并允许弃答的评分指标，比较两种方案：直接训练模型（强化学习）与训练独立的答案选择器。采用3个训练种子和2个留出置信度阈值进行评估。

Result: 学习式答案选择器在阈值平均效用上优于原始模型的校准置信度过滤：TriviaQA平均覆盖率从20.2%升至30.9%，已打分答案的错误率从23.0%降至14.5%（精确匹配）。所测试的强化学习改动未显示一致增益。NQ-Open上选择器虽优于过滤但仍不如全部弃答。人工复核部分审计支持TriviaQA结论。

Conclusion: 结果支持在该设定下"学习选择答案"，但跨数据集的可靠弃答仍是未解决问题。

Abstract: A useful language model should know when to answer and when to say "I don't know." Can we improve that decision by training the model itself or by training a separate component to check its answers? We study both approaches on Qwen3-14B for factual questions, using a score that rewards correct answers, penalizes mistakes, and allows abstention. Across three training seeds and two held-out confidence thresholds, a learned answer selector improves threshold-averaged utility over the original model's calibrated confidence filter. On TriviaQA, mean coverage increases from 20.2% to 30.9%, while the pooled error rate among scored answers decreases from 23.0% to 14.5% under exact-match grading. The tested reinforcement-learning changes do not establish consistent gains. On NQ-Open, the selector improves threshold-averaged utility over the filter but still performs worse than always abstaining. A partial human-reviewed audit preserves the TriviaQA finding. Our results support learning to select answers in this setting while showing that reliable abstention across datasets remains unresolved.

</details>


### [196] [Task Context Shapes Component Roles in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13895)
*Sovesh Mohapatra,Dani S Bassett*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究语言模型共享注意力头在不同任务中的差异。作者用相同图事实对比固定组件，测量干预对后续层的影响(influence)和答案重要性(importance)。发现任务改变重分配影响；激活编辑可改变内部向量并切换模型读取的事实，同一头响应不同事实并不同影响后续组件。线性响应图能预测后期头的响应，MSE较平均降低53.6%(Gemma)和5.0%(Qwen)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型跨任务复用相同注意力头，但识别共享头无法解释其在不同任务中做什么。受共享脑区任务依赖交互启发，作者提出语言模型计算的网络视角，探究共享组件如何在不同任务上下文中参与不同计算。

Method: 用相同图事实(指定有向连接是否存在的陈述)比较固定模型组件的跨任务行为；通过干预量化对注意力头及后续层激活状态的影响(influence)与对答案的重要性(importance)；在4个家族、1.5-14B的5个开源模型中分析；为每个prompt构建编辑前/后的线性响应图，用早期头测量变化预测后期头响应。

Result: 任务改变会重分配影响。在Gemma-2-9B和Qwen3-14B中，激活编辑改变早期内部激活向量，在指令不变时切换模型读取的事实；同一头随后响应不同图事实并不同影响后续组件。对单独的事实干预，对应条件的响应图相比两图平均，将均方预测误差在Gemma降低53.6%、Qwen降低5.0%。

Conclusion: 任务上下文既改变共享组件响应的图事实，也改变其输出对后续计算的影响。网络视角有助于解释模型如何用共享参数执行不同计算；任务依赖影响的测量还可指导只改变某一行为而保留其他行为的干预。

Abstract: Large language models reuse the same attention heads across tasks, but identifying these shared heads does not explain what they do differently in each task. A natural source of inspiration is task-dependent interactions among shared brain regions, which motivate a network view of language-model computation. Here, we compare fixed model components across tasks using identical graph facts, statements specifying which directed connections are present. We measure how interventions affect attention heads and the activation state in later layers (influence), as well as the answer (importance). Task changes redistribute the influence in five open-weight models spanning four families and 1.5-14 billion parameters. In Gemma-2-9B and Qwen3-14B, an activation edit changes an early internal activation vector and switches which fact the model reads while the written instruction stays fixed. The same heads then respond to different graph facts and influence later components differently. For each prompt, we construct two linear response maps, one before the edit and one after it. Each map predicts a later head's response from a measured change in an earlier head. For a separate factual intervention, the map for the corresponding condition reduces mean squared prediction error by 53.6% in Gemma and 5.0% in Qwen compared with the average of the two maps. These findings show that task context changes both which graph facts the shared components respond to and how their outputs affect later computation. A network account may help explain how models use shared parameters to perform different computations. Measurements of task-dependent influence could also guide interventions intended to alter one behavior while preserving others.

</details>


### [197] [Structural Automata for Neural Semantic Parsing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13896)
*Xiao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究DRS/AMR语义解析中的结构自动机，提出接受路径解码（APD），在长度限制下保证有效输出，无需回退token，并分析后处理与训练阶段的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经语义解析器逐token生成，良构性依赖生成过程中的引用、作用域和图关系；局部约束解码虽能防止无效token，但不能保证有效前缀能在固定输出长度内完成。

Method: 在DRS解析的解码、后处理、训练三阶段引入结构自动机，并在AMR上评估解码。提出APD：在剩余长度限制内维护已验证的完成路径，当模型偏好的token可完成时优先采用，保证输出被接受且不撤回token。

Result: 紧长度限制下，APD较局部掩码在DRS上Smatch++提升5.1和2.4分，在AMR上提升6.4和3.2分，与同限制下需回退的rollback相当。后处理中无效输出集中在相同输入：有限数据下8个无约束样本对10.2%输入无有效输出，全数据下为0.4%，过滤接近APD（差0.2分）。训练中惩罚自动机拒绝token在10%训练后提升开发集Smatch++ 3.6-11.0分，但该优势随训练衰减。

Conclusion: 结构自动机在解码阶段最有效，APD能在固定长度下保证有效输出；后处理过滤在数据充足时接近APD；训练惩罚的优势随交叉熵本身降低拒绝token概率（从14%降至2%以下）而减弱。

Abstract: Neural semantic parsers generate meaning representations token by token, yet well-formedness depends on references, scope, and graph relations that unfold during generation. Constrained decoding prevents locally invalid tokens but does not guarantee that a valid prefix can be completed within a fixed output-length limit. We investigate structural automata at three stages of DRS parsing (decoding, post hoc processing, and training) and additionally evaluate decoding on AMR. For decoding, we introduce accepting-path decoding (APD), which maintains a verified completion within the remaining length limit and follows the model's preferred token whenever that token can also be completed. APD guarantees an accepted output without retracting tokens. Under tight length limits, it improves Smatch++ over local masking by 5.1 and 2.4 points on DRS and by 6.4 and 3.2 points on AMR, comparable to rollback under the same limit, which retracts tokens. For post hoc processing, invalid outputs concentrate on the same inputs: eight unconstrained samples yield no valid output for 10.2% of inputs with limited training data, compared with 0.4% with full data, where filtering comes within 0.2 Smatch++ points of APD. For training, penalizing automaton-rejected tokens improves development Smatch++ by 3.6-11.0 points after 10% of training, but this advantage diminishes as cross-entropy alone reduces the probability assigned to rejected tokens from 14% to below 2% within the first sixth of training with limited data.

</details>


### [198] [When VLMs Destroy What They Know: Spatial Representations Fall Below Lexical Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13910)
*Shubh Garg,Chen Shani*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出EICS指标与CASP-VL基准，检验VLM内部表征是否忠实编码结构化关系，发现空间关系编码远差于词汇信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM越来越多地分析推理图像，但其内部表征是否忠实编码此类推理所需的结构化关系尚不清楚；基于输出的评测无法揭示这一问题。

Method: 提出EICS（Evaluation-Invariant Concept Stability），在受控单概念干预下测试表征是否一致编码概念；并构建CASP-VL基准，基于Visual Genome场景图生成因果控制的空间扰动。

Result: 在多种VLM架构上，空间关系的编码忠实度显著低于词汇信息，即使模型在组合基准上远超随机；关系在谓词自身token上可识别，但在句子聚合为全局表征（EOS token或均值池化）时丢失。

Conclusion: 揭示了一种基于输出评测不可见的系统性失败：VLM在下游使用的表征中并未保留其自身输入中已有的关系信息。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) increasingly analyze and reason about images, yet it remains unclear whether their internal representations faithfully encode the structured relations required for such reasoning. We introduce EICS (Evaluation-Invariant Concept Stability), a metric for testing whether representations consistently encode concepts under controlled one-concept interventions, and CASP-VL (Causally controlled Spatial Perturbations for Vision-Language models), a benchmark of causally controlled spatial perturbations derived from Visual Genome scene graphs. Across multiple VLM architectures, we find that spatial relations are represented substantially less faithfully than lexical information, even when the same models score well above chance on compositional benchmarks. Further analysis shows that the relation is identifiable at the predicate's own tokens but is lost when the sentence is aggregated into a global representation, whether through the (EOS) token or by mean pooling. These findings reveal a systematic failure invisible to output-based evaluation: VLMs do not preserve, in the representation used downstream, relational information that is present in their own input.

</details>


### [199] [RSI-Anything: Unlocking Recursive Self-Improvement with World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13912)
*Taoyong Cui,Pinxian Zeng,Wanghan Xu,Hao Xiao,Shuhan Xue,Qiang Gao,Wanli Ouyang,Pheng Ann Heng,Zhenfei Yin,Yingcheng Wu,Ling Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: RSI-Anything 是基于预测世界模型实现领域通用递归自我改进的框架，在代码修复、GUI、实验室规划、反应优化与免疫科学等多领域取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归自我改进需将交互经验转化为持续提升，但外部反馈成本高，且随策略演化世界模型预测可能不可靠。

Method: 基于 JEPA-Anything 构建领域通用框架，用预测世界模型指导动作与学习数据选择；观测反馈驱动策略/工作流改进与条件式世界模型自适应，并通过组件与兼容性检查管理更新的策略-模型对保留。

Result: 代码修复成功率由静态验证器 26.3% 升至预测选择 29.2%、世界模型自适应后 31.2%（测试用量相当）；GUI 任务完成率更高且平均动作减少 39.4%；五个连续策略版本实验室规划得分由 21.80% 翻倍至 46.01%；反应优化同等 40 次实验预算下平均最佳产率 96.15%（贝叶斯优化 82.16%）；免疫科学端到端应用连接工作流演化、预测建模与治疗假设生成。

Conclusion: 预测世界模型与保留系统更新可在多样环境中实现递归改进。

Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to transform interaction experience into persistent improvements, yet external feedback is costly and world-model predictions may become unreliable as policies evolve. We introduce RSI-Anything, a domain-general framework built on JEPA-Anything that uses predictive world models to guide action and learning-data selection. Observed feedback drives policy or workflow improvement and conditional world-model adaptation, while component and compatibility checks govern the retention of updated policy-model pairs. Across diverse computational and scientific domains, RSI-Anything demonstrates substantial gains. In code repair, with the coder fixed, success increases from 26.3% with a static verifier to 29.2% through predictive selection and 31.2% after world-model adaptation, at comparable test usage. Graphical user interface (GUI) evaluations showed higher task completion, while average actions decrease by 39.4%. Across five successive policy versions, laboratory-planning scores more than double from 21.80% to 46.01%. In reaction optimization, RSI-Anything achieves 96.15% mean best observed yield versus 82.16% for Bayesian optimization under the same 40-experiment budget. An end-to-end immune-science application further connects workflow evolution and predictive modeling with therapeutic hypothesis generation. These results demonstrate how predictive world models and retained system updates enable recursive improvement across diverse environments.

</details>


<div id='cs.NE'></div>

# cs.NE [[Back]](#toc)

### [200] [Neuromorphic Satellite Intelligence: A Formal Framework for Event-Driven Architectures, Spike-Based Algorithms, and Quantitative Energy-Accuracy Trade-offs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12471)
*Suresh Kumar TP,Vikas Agnihotri*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文提出卫星星载脉冲神经网络计算的数学建模、三种原创算法、能耗-精度-延迟(EAL)权衡面及抗辐射架构分类，分析表明神经形态实现相比GPU基线可实现8-47倍能耗降低，精度损失在2.1%以内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 卫星星载计算存在根本矛盾：任务智能需求持续增长，而功率、质量与辐射预算固定不变。需要探索神经形态计算以突破该限制。

Method: 1) 建立脉冲神经计算的数学模型，推导能耗关于网络稀疏度、放电率和突触扇出的闭式表达式；2) 提出三种算法：SKCF姿态估计、TCAD航天器健康监测、SAMC认知卫星链路自适应调制编码，均含伪代码与复杂度界；3) 构建EAL权衡面并用Loihi、SpiNNaker硅实测数据填充，与FPGA、GPU对比；4) 细化四类抗辐射神经形态架构分类及故障率模型；5) 用受限STDP规则形式化在轨持续学习并证明权重漂移有界。

Result: 针对12U CubeSat地球观测、GEO通信载荷和深空探测器三个案例研究给出量化设计点。神经形态实现相比GPU基线可实现8-47倍能耗降低，推理精度保持在2.1%以内。

Conclusion: 神经形态计算是卫星星载计算中缓解能耗与智能需求矛盾的有效路径，在保证精度的同时显著降低能耗，并通过受限STDP支持可证明有界的在轨学习。

Abstract: Satellite onboard computing faces an irreducible tension: mission intelligence requirements grow monotonically while power, mass, and radiation budgets remain fixed. This paper advances the state of the art on three fronts. First, we develop a formal mathematical model of spiking neural computation for satellite workloads, deriving closed-form expressions for energy consumption as a function of network sparsity, firing rate, and synaptic fan-out. Second, we propose three original algorithms -- a Spiking Kalman-Complementary Filter (SKCF) for attitude estimation, a Temporal Contrast Anomaly Detector (TCAD) for spacecraft health monitoring, and a Spike-Based Adaptive Modulation and Coding (SAMC) scheme for cognitive satellite links -- each with pseudocode and analytical complexity bounds. Third, we introduce a quantitative Energy-Accuracy-Latency (EAL) trade-off surface and populate it with numerical estimates derived from published silicon measurements of Loihi and SpiNNaker, enabling direct comparison with FPGA and GPU baselines. A taxonomy of four radiation-aware neuromorphic architecture classes is refined with fault-rate models. Continual on-orbit learning is formalized through a constrained Spike-Timing Dependent Plasticity (STDP) rule that provably bounds weight drift. Case studies for a 12U CubeSat Earth observation mission, a GEO communications payload, and an autonomous deep-space probe provide concrete, quantified design points. Our analysis shows that neuromorphic implementations can achieve 8 to 47 times energy reduction over GPU baselines while maintaining inference accuracy within 2.1\% for representative satellite workloads.

</details>


### [201] [Energy-Efficient Spiking Neural Networks for Sensing-Aided Beam Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12507)
*Nhan Thanh Nguyen,Phuong Nam Tran,Mengyuan Ma,Huy T. Nguyen,Ahmed Alkhateeb,Markku Juntti*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 该论文开发并系统比较了脉冲神经网络(SNN)与人工神经网络(ANN)在感知辅助波束预测中的表现，发现SNN在视觉和多模态感知下更节能，但在纯位置感知下ANN占优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 感知辅助波束预测可利用视觉、位置等互补模态降低毫米波系统的波束训练开销，但传感与推理流程能耗高，因此需要引入能效更高的脉冲神经网络(SNN)替代传统人工神经网络(ANN)。

Method: 为波束预测开发SNN架构，并与ANN在纯位置、纯视觉及多模态输入三种设置下进行系统对比，同时在不同能耗与精度条件下评估两者表现，并分析SNN精度的限制因素。

Result: 纯位置感知下紧凑ANN始终优于SNN；视觉与多模态感知下，SNN在相近能耗下精度更高，在相近精度下能耗最多降低一个数量级。多模态SNN达到58.08%的top-1精度，比能耗最接近的ANN高18.11个百分点。SNN精度受限于层间二值通信而非模型规模。

Conclusion: SNN在节能的感知辅助波束预测中具有潜力，但其精度受限，主要瓶颈为层间二值通信。

Abstract: Sensing-aided beam prediction can reduce the beam-training overhead of millimeter-wave (mmWave) systems by leveraging environmental information from complementary modalities such as vision and position. However, the resulting sensing and inference pipeline can be energy-intensive, motivating the use of energy-efficient spiking neural networks (SNNs) as an alternative to conventional artificial neural networks (ANNs). In this work, we develop SNN architectures for beam prediction and systematically compare them with ANNs using position-only, vision-only, and multimodal inputs. Our results show that compact ANNs consistently outperform SNNs for position-only sensing. In contrast, for vision and multimodal sensing, SNNs achieve higher accuracy than ANNs at similar energy costs and require up to an order of magnitude less energy at a comparable accuracy. For example, the multimodal SNN achieves 58.08% top-1 accuracy, outperforming the closest-energy ANN by 18.11 percentage points. We further show that SNN accuracy is limited by the binary communication between layers rather than by model size. These results demonstrate the potential of SNNs for energy-efficient sensing-aided beam prediction while highlighting their accuracy limitation.

</details>


### [202] [REMBGO for Evaluation-Limited Optimization: CEC2022 Benchmarking and EAF-STATCOM Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13471)
*Vikram Chekuri,Narapareddy Ramarao,Prashanth N A*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文提出 REMBGO，一种预算感知的 EMBGO 改进算法，强调在受限函数评估预算下的集成式贡献，而非单一算子优势，并将其应用于 EAF-STATCOM 控制器调参。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 元启发式算法通常在远高于昂贵工程仿真可承受的评估预算下进行比较，导致结论与实际应用场景脱节，因此需要一个评估预算感知的算法。

Method: REMBGO 集成种群保持、尺度归一化探索与恢复机制；在 CEC2022 上以 1040 次函数评估为主预算进行评估，并给出预算梯度描述性分析，同时开展组件移除研究。随后应用于 EAF-STATCOM 控制器调参，将冻结增益向量无重调地迁移到 20 个预先指定的未见随机电弧实现上（210 次固定增益仿真）。

Result: 组件移除研究中无单一机制在多重校正后显著；增益向量主效应仅解释 3.6%–5.8% 的交叉验证变异，而交互加残差约 61.4%；REMBGO 与 EMBGO 的配对差异符号依控制器而异且统计上不显著。

Conclusion: REMBGO 应被视为一种资源感知的改进，其收益必须与评估预算一并陈述，而非普遍优越的优化器。

Abstract: Metaheuristic comparisons are often reported at evaluation budgets far larger than an expensive engineering simulation can afford. This paper presents REMBGO, an evaluation-budget-aware refinement of EMBGO. Its contribution is not any single operator: it is the integration of population preservation, scale-normalized exploration and recovery mechanisms whose parent-relative benefit is concentrated under restricted function-evaluation budgets. REMBGO is evaluated on CEC2022 at a primary, application-aligned budget of 1040 function evaluations, with a surrounding budget ladder reported descriptively to characterise budget dependence rather than as a family of controlled hypotheses. A component-removal study finds no individual mechanism whose removal survives multiplicity correction, consistent with an integrated rather than a single-operator contribution. The algorithm is then applied to EAF--STATCOM controller tuning, and the resulting frozen gain vectors are transferred without retuning to twenty pre-specified unseen stochastic arc realizations ($210$ fixed-gain simulations, all feasible). The selected gain-vector main effect accounts for only $3.6$--$5.8\%$ of the crossed validation variation, against approximately $61.4\%$ for interaction plus residual, and the matched REMBGO--EMBGO paired differences are controller-dependent in sign and not statistically significant. REMBGO is therefore presented as a resource-aware refinement whose benefit must be stated together with the evaluation budget, not as a universally superior optimizer.

</details>


### [203] [DyssomniaNN: Multi-Scale Spiking Neural Modeling of Human Sleep Disorders and Perceived Restedness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13918)
*Daniel Szelogowski*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 该论文提出DyssomniaNN，一个多尺度生物物理计算框架，耦合睡眠稳态/昼夜节律、下丘脑flip-flop回路与皮质丘脑脉冲神经网络，用于在五种临床队列中模拟睡眠并揭示客观睡眠时长与主观恢复效果的解离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床睡眠医学中客观睡眠时长与主观日间功能损伤之间存在显著分歧（如矛盾性失眠的睡眠状态误感知、1型发作性睡病的边界不稳定），但缺乏统一的机制性计算平台来解释这些现象。

Method: 构建DyssomniaNN多尺度框架：整合Borbély双过程睡眠稳态与昼夜驱动模型、Saper下丘脑互抑flip-flop回路，以及递归皮质丘脑泄漏积分放电脉冲神经网络；在统一72小时光周期下形式化五类队列（健康对照、昼夜节律睡眠-觉醒障碍延迟型、慢性失眠、矛盾性失眠、1型发作性睡病），并将合成LFP与PhysioNet Sleep-EDF经验EEG对比，引入Well-Rested Index量化恢复效果。

Result: 合成局部场电位在所有标准频段上与PhysioNet Sleep-EDF人类EEG谱高度吻合（谱平均绝对误差0.33–0.35）。模拟显示睡眠时长无法预测恢复效果：矛盾性失眠总睡眠时间正常（21.15 h）但恢复率仅37.6%，源于未受抑制的皮质β波段侵入；发作性睡病因下丘脑分泌素缺乏出现严重夜间碎片化（入睡后觉醒781 min）和35次睡眠起始REM期。

Conclusion: DyssomniaNN可作为机制性睡眠研究与虚拟神经药理学的in silico平台，强调恢复效果不应由睡眠时长单一衡量。

Abstract: Clinical sleep medicine repeatedly documents profound divergences between objective sleep duration and subjective daytime impairment, notably exemplified by sleep state misperception in paradoxical insomnia and boundary instability in narcolepsy type 1. Here, we present DyssomniaNN: a multi-scale biophysical computational framework coupling Borbély's two-process regulation of sleep homeostasis and circadian drive with Saper's hypothalamic reciprocal flip-flop circuit and a recurrent corticothalamic leaky integrate-and-fire spiking neural network. We formalize five clinical cohorts across an identical 72-hour photoperiod: healthy control, circadian rhythm sleep-wake disorder (delayed-phase), chronic insomnia, paradoxical insomnia, and narcolepsy type 1. The synthetic local field potential converges closely with empirical human electroencephalography spectra from the PhysioNet Sleep-EDF database across all canonical frequency bands (spectral mean absolute error of 0.33--0.35). Furthermore, we introduce the Well-Rested Index to quantify restorative efficacy. Simulations reveal that sleep duration fails to predict restorative recovery: paradoxical insomnia achieves normal total sleep time (21.15 h) yet yields low restoration (37.6%) from unsuppressed cortical beta-band intrusion, whereas hypocretin deficiency in narcolepsy produces severe nocturnal fragmentation (781 min of wake after sleep onset) and 35 sleep-onset rapid eye movement periods. DyssomniaNN provides an in silico platform for mechanistic sleep research and virtual neuropharmacology.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [204] [Algebraic Integer Quantization for Machine Learning Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12494)
*Anthony Kostal-Vazquez,Vassil Dimitrov,Branden Butler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出代数整数数值格式(AINF)及量化方法(AIQ)，用于高精度压缩计算，并验证其在LLM推理中的竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 浮点与定点格式在数值优化上存在固有局限，需要一种可高度配置、精确压缩且能无损归约为整数运算的计算框架。

Method: 提出AINF框架，利用其可无损归约为纯整数运算的特性，实现无误差乘累加；开发矩阵乘法引擎；并基于此提出面向LLM推理的有损压缩格式AIQ，实验中采用二阶(二次)代数整数。

Result: 矩阵乘法引擎性能在现代硬件加速器上处于最高效数值方案的可预测倍数范围内；AIQ在等效bit-per-parameter预算下，于多模型多基准上取得与业界标准MX格式相当的精度。

Conclusion: AINF/AIQ提供了浮点与定点无法实现的优化空间。当前工作限于二次代数整数，向高阶及多维代数整数的推广有望带来更大计算优势，是未来方向。

Abstract: In this article, we propose algebraic integer number formats (AINF) as a framework for highly configurable and accurate compressed computation. A key property of AINF is its straightforward reduction to purely integer arithmetic, enabling error-free multiply-accumulate operations. We develop a matrix multiplication engine that exploits this property, obtaining performance within a predictable factor of the most efficient numerical counterparts on modern hardware accelerators. Another key advantage of AIQ is the freedom to select algebraic integers tailored to the numerical characteristics of a given use case, offering optimization opportunities that are fundamentally unavailable in floating-point or fixed-point formats. Motivated by these properties, we introduce algebraic integer quantization (AIQ), a lossy compression format for large language model (LLM) inference, and provide results demonstrating that AIQ achieves competitive accuracy compared to the industry-standard MX format across a diverse set of models and benchmarks at equivalent bit-per-parameter budgets. The experiments presented in this article employ algebraic integers of degree two (quadratic integers); generalizations to higher-order and, in particular, multidimensional algebraic integers promise even greater computational advantages and remain a promising direction for future work.

</details>


### [205] [Kairos: Toward a Byte-Level Foundation Model for Every Modality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12495)
*Fabien Furfaro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Kairos组合了双向门控DeltaNet线性注意力、滑窗注意力共享投影、块级Attention-Residual聚合、稀疏MoE前馈和多尺度字节级编解码器，用统一噪声去噪目标在单一字节空间训练；本文仅做收敛性检查，验证实现能优化，未涉及泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单机训练小语言模型留给架构试错的空间很小，因此需要先验证复杂架构组合是否能正常优化，再讨论其是否有用。

Method: 给出各组件的代码级算法（含跨会话循环状态记忆门），用单句440字节过拟合、1-15M参数、纯文本、3个随机种子做收敛检查；对编解码器和注意力选择用3种子，对另外7个因素做单次扫描。

Result: 两种注意力变体在3000步达到约1e-3的最小损失；600步后平均最小损失从0.018（patch编解码器）到0.354（深度可分离卷积编解码器），三种子排序一致；共享投影相对独立投影的优势随步数或数据多样性增加而消失，冻结投影时甚至反转，说明只是收敛速度效应而非容量效应。

Conclusion: 这些检查表明实现能够优化，但不说明泛化、多模态训练或与现有模型的比较；这些将由计划中的预训练运行来验证。Discussion以分析方式估算200M总量/25M激活的目标，吞吐量数字均未实测。

Abstract: Small language models trained on a single local machine leave little room for architectural trial and error. Kairos combines bidirectional gated-DeltaNet linear attention and sliding-window attention over shared projections (LiZAttention2), block-wise Attention-Residual aggregation, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) feed-forward layer and a multi-scale byte-level codec, trained with a uniform-noise denoising objective over one byte space shared by text, image, audio, video, lidar and control streams; this report asks whether the combination optimizes at all before asking whether it is useful. We give code-derived algorithms for each component, including a cross-session recurrent-state memory gate, then run convergence sanity checks: overfittinga single 440-byte sentence at 1--15M parameters, text only, with three seeds for codec and attention choices and single-run sweeps for seven further factors. The two attention variants tested at 3\,000 steps (LiZAttention2 and window attention alone) reach a minimum loss near $10^{-3}$. After 600 steps, the mean minimum loss ranges from 0.018 (patch codec) to 0.354 (depthwise convolutional codec) with an identical ranking on three seeds. An apparent advantage of shared over separate attention projections closes with more steps or more diverse data and reverses when the projections are frozen: it is a convergence-speed effect, not a capacity effect. These checks suggest that the implementation optimizes; they say nothing about generalization, multimodal training or comparison with existing models, which a planned pretraining run is meant to address. The Discussion sizes a 200M-total/25M-active target analytically; none of its throughput figures is measured. Code is available at https://github.com/fabienfrfr/Kairos . Python package at https://pypi.org/project/kairos-fm/ .

</details>


### [206] [An Input-Dependent Readout Phase for Resonant Sequence Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12496)
*Shivesh Rane*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ResonatorLM将固定读出相位改为输入依赖，仅增0.2%参数，在长序列上大幅降低困惑度（12.81→3.76），但相位追踪的是当前字符而非距离，检索能力未提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定状态序列模型避免注意力二次开销，但固定转移对所有输入用同一方式读取记忆，缺乏内容依赖性；而输入依赖转移又牺牲了FFT训练的O(T log T)卷积路径。作者希望在保持卷积精确性的前提下，仅通过读出阶段引入输入依赖。

Method: 在ResonatorLM基础上，将每个头固定的学习读出相位改为当前token的函数，使该相位输入依赖。这样只增加0.2%参数，保持卷积精确。并分析未训练振荡器库的相位编码能力，训练6M参数字符级模型（WikiText-2），对比原始模型。

Result: 未训练库中相位确实编码时间，但普通token在2-8步内低于背景，无论怎么调阻尼线性重建都难超约16个token。6M模型在WikiText-2上：训练长度256、测试1024时，困惑度从12.81降到3.76，与原模型在训练长度上持平。失败源于长记忆头积累过多历史。

Conclusion: 输入依赖读出相位是廉价有效的改进，解决了固定相位模型在超训练长度外推的失败，但相位实际追踪当前字符而非时间距离，因此并未提升检索能力。

Abstract: Sequence models with a fixed-size state avoid the quadratic cost of attention, but face a design choice. An input-dependent state transition gives content-dependent memory at the cost of FFT-based training, while a fixed transition keeps the O(T log T) convolutional path but reads memory the same way for every input. ResonatorLM, a recent model of the second kind, reads a bank of damped complex oscillators through a fixed learned phase per head. We make that readout phase a function of the current token, which adds input dependence to the read only, keeps the convolution exact, and costs 0.2 percent more parameters. An analysis of the untrained bank shows that phase does encode elapsed time, but an ordinary token falls below the background within 2-8 steps and no choice of damping extends linear reconstruction beyond about 16 tokens. In 6M-parameter character-level models on WikiText-2, the input-dependent phase matches the original at the training length and removes its failure beyond it: trained on 256 tokens and tested on 1024, perplexity falls from 12.81 to 3.76. We trace the failure to long-memory heads that accumulate more history than training exposed them to. The learned phase tracks the current character rather than distance and does not improve retrieval.

</details>


### [207] [CircuitTree: Composing Circuits into A Syllable Transcriber](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12520)
*Jiankun Wei,Ewan Dunbar,Gerald Penn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种将多个可解释子电路组合成单一模型的方法（density-scaled 贪心组合 + CircuitTree），并在语音任务中验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电路发现旨在将单体神经网络分解为可解释的模块化子网络。但已有组合电路的方法多采用朴素并集，存在明显局限，难以把任意多个电路有效合并为一个模型。

Method: 提出贪心、密度缩放的组合算法；进一步推广到 N 个电路，构建 CircuitTree，并采用 Θ(N log N) 的树形组合调度。将 HuBERT 中针对单个音素剪枝出的 39 个电路组合成音节分类器，并将多个 CircuitTree 串联为层次化电路流水线。

Result: 组合后的音节分类器具备单个音素电路不具备的能力。层次化流水线在开放音节转写上达到 64.8% 准确率，仅比完全无共享电路的 66.0% 上限低 1.2 个百分点，同时共享了 99.5% 的电路组件。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，通过密度缩放组合与 CircuitTree 调度，可以把大量独立可解释电路高效组合并串联，在保持高组件共享率的同时获得接近专用模型的表现。

Abstract: The goal of circuit discovery is to decompose a monolithic neural network into tiny modular subnetworks which are interpretable in the sense that each does an identifiable subtask. We develop a practical method for composing arbitrarily many circuits into a single model. We propose a greedy, density-scaled composition algorithm that overcomes limitations of previous attempts to compose circuits by naive union, then generalize it to $N$ circuits via CircuitTree, a new data structure built on a $Θ(N\log N)$ tree-compose schedule. We compose circuits pruned from HuBERT for classifying individual phonemes into a syllable classifier, a capability none of the 39 phoneme circuits has individually. Chaining CircuitTrees into a hierarchy-of-circuits pipeline, we transcribe open syllables at 64.8\% accuracy, within 1.2 points of a 66.0\% ceiling that shares no circuitry at all, with 99.5\% of circuit components shared.

</details>


### [208] [Behind-the-Meter Photovoltaic Visibility from Net Smart Meters: Deployment Regimes and Operational Insights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12527)
*Jack Zheng,Hao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文量化了深度PV分解模型在不同部署场景下的误差，发现部署场景比模型选择更决定性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 配电运营商需要掌握电表后光伏发电情况，但住宅用户仅有净智能电表观测数据。深度学习PV分解可恢复这种可见性，但其运营价值取决于模型服务于已知用户、新用户、未来时段还是新区域。论文旨在量化这一依赖关系。

Method: 使用四种部署场景（区分家庭迁移与时间外推），基于Ausgrid智能电表数据并跨数据集适配至Pecan Street数据。在固定训练协议下，对代表性深度序列架构进行PV分解基准测试，采用场景匹配评估，固定48小时上下文长度。

Result: 最佳模型白昼MAE从可见家庭未来测试期的0.104 kW升至同一时期未见家庭的0.185 kW。固定训练契约下，部署场景对误差变化的解释力远超模型选择。目标域归一化后，在5个目标区域家庭上微调可将源模型迁移误差降低28%–36%。长输入窗口有助于已知用户外推，但对新用户的收益因模型而异。

Conclusion: 建议采用场景匹配的误差预算、为新区域模型适配提供有限目标监督，以及面向用例的上下文选择进行能源数据分析。

Abstract: Distribution operators need visibility of behind-the-meter photovoltaic (PV) generation, yet most residential customers are observed only through net smart meters. Deep-learning-based PV disaggregation can restore this visibility, but its operational value depends on whether the model serves known customers, new customers, future periods, or new regions. We quantify this dependence using four deployment regimes that separate household transfer from temporal extrapolation, applied to Ausgrid smart-meter data with cross-dataset adaptation to the Pecan Street data. Using a fixed training protocol, we benchmark representative deep sequence architectures for PV disaggregation under regime-matched evaluation. At a fixed 48-hour context length, daylight mean absolute error (MAE) of the best model rises from 0.104~kW on seen households in the future test period to 0.185~kW on unseen households over the same period, and under a fixed training contract the deployment regime explains far more of the error variation than model choice. Under target-domain normalization, fine-tuning on five target-region households reduces source-model transfer error by 28\%--36\%. Long input windows help known-customer extrapolation, while their new-customer benefits vary by model. These findings suggest regime-matched error budgets, limited target supervision for model adaptation in new regions, and use-case-dependent context selection for energy data analytics.

</details>


### [209] [Beyond Temporal Proximity: Explanatory World Models for Credit Assignment in Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13504)
*Oriol Corcoll,Qiyao Wei,Ciarán Mark Gilligan-Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Explanatory World Models (EWM)，利用语言模型的解释作为学习信号，通过保守层级算子递归重分配奖励，显式建模远距离动作的因果相关性，从而缓解延迟奖励下的样本低效问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式推荐系统常用强化学习优化在决策后数百上千步才出现的长期结果。标准RL按时间邻近性而非显式相关性传播奖励，导致对遥远但重要动作的信号衰减，造成样本低效。

Method: EWM是一个归因框架：用前沿语言模型识别可能促成已实现结果的早期事件；采用保守层级算子递归重分配奖励，同时保持未折扣的回合回报不变。基于Halpern实际因果、Lombrozo解释简洁性和Deutsch难以变易解释，设计了三种互补的解释变体。

Result: 在Crafter和WordCraft上EWM显著优于PPO和LaRe，奖励延迟越大增益越明显；在KuaiRand上离线优于SFT和LaRe，在线优于A2C；在工业级生成式推荐器的离线评估中，Recall大幅提升并改善了行为代理指标。

Conclusion: 解释可为从延迟结果中学习提供结构化、可复用的信用分配信号，EWM在长时程强化学习与生成式推荐任务中均展现出有效性。

Abstract: Generative Recommenders increasingly use Reinforcement Learning (RL) to optimize outcomes that may appear hundreds or thousands of interactions after a decision. Standard RL propagates reward according to temporal proximity rather than explicit relevance, attenuating the signal assigned to distant but important actions and creating a source of sample inefficiency. We introduce Explanatory World Models (EWM), an attribution framework that uses explanations to identify the earlier events that plausibly contributed to a realized outcome. We instantiate EWM with a frontier language model and use its explanations as learning signals using a conservative hierarchical operator that recursively redistributes reward while preserving the undiscounted episode return. To investigate what constitutes a useful explanation, we operationalize three complementary variants inspired by Halpern's actual causation, Lombrozo's explanatory simplicity, and Deutsch's hard-to-vary explanations. We evaluate EWM on two controlled long-horizon RL benchmarks, a public sequential-recommendation benchmark, and an industry-scale generative recommender. On Crafter and WordCraft, EWM substantially outperforms PPO and LaRe, with its largest gains when rewards are most delayed. On KuaiRand, EWM outperforms SFT and LaRe offline and A2C online. Finally, in an offline evaluation of an industry generative recommender, EWM considerably improves Recall and increases behavioral proxies. These results suggest that explanations can provide structured and reusable credit for learning from delayed outcomes.

</details>


### [210] [GlucoPRISM: Protocol-Supervised Pretraining for Cross-Cohort Glucose Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12528)
*Adinath Madhavrao Dukre,Abdullah Mohammad,Yifan Lu,Eran Segal,Ahmed Metwally,Imran Razzak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GlucoPRISM 通过响应契约将 CGM 表征分解为 Trait/State/Sensor 三个带状子空间，部署时丢弃 Sensor 带即可提升跨队列迁移性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 CGM 基础模型将每天编码为单一向量，混合了个人特征、当日事件与传感器测量差异，导致测量偏差随表征迁移到新队列，损害跨队列部署。

Method: 在 GlucoFM 骨干上施加"响应契约"监督：64 维 Trait 带对人和天变化均不变，48 维 State 带只随天变化，16 维 Sensor 带跟踪设备。用基于 Dexcom/Libre 配对记录校准的合成传感器视图、跨天配对和血糖摘要目标提供监督，无需临床标签。

Result: 12 个跨队列方向上丢弃 Sensor 带使平均迁移 AUROC 从 68.75 升至 73.57（GlucoFM 为 69.3）；在双传感器的 CGMacros 上增益 11–19 点且跨被试可复现；其余 8 方向过滤中性且编码器本身超 GlucoFM 3.5 点；过滤后设备仍线性可解码；保留带在 14/15 个任务-队列单元提升窗口 AUROC，并在 9,303 人外部队列的 14/15 临床终点上提升相关性。

Conclusion: 测量分量可被放在已知坐标中，用固定投影、无目标数据即可剔除，从而在保留有用测量信息的同时提升跨队列迁移表现。

Abstract: Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) foundation models encode each day as one vector that mixes who the person is, what happened that day and how the sensor measured it, so measurement differences travel with the representation into new cohorts. We ask whether pretraining can place the measurement component that harms transfer in known coordinates, so that deployment drops them with a fixed projection and no target data. GlucoPRISM supervises a GlucoFM backbone with response contracts, rules for how each part of the representation should change when only the day or only the sensor changes: a 64-dimensional Trait band should change with neither, a 48-dimensional State band only across days, and a 16-dimensional Sensor band should track the device. Synthetic sensor views calibrated on paired Dexcom and Libre recordings, different-day pairs and glucose-summary targets supply this supervision without clinical labels. Across twelve cross-cohort directions, dropping the Sensor band from the same frozen encoder raises mean transfer AUROC from 68.75 to 73.57, against 69.3 for GlucoFM. The gain has two parts. Into CGMacros, the one target cohort recorded with two sensor types, filtering adds 11 to 19 points, and this holds when the generator is recalibrated on half of the participants and scored on the other half. On the other eight directions filtering is neutral and the encoder itself exceeds GlucoFM by 3.5 points. The device remains linearly decodable after filtering, so the filter removes a device-related component that harms transfer rather than all measurement information. The retained bands improve window AUROC on thirteen of fourteen public task--cohort cells (Holm-adjusted p=0.031) and correlation on fourteen of fifteen clinical endpoints in an external cohort of 9,303 participants.

</details>


### [211] [CacheScope: Exact-Compute Allocation for Training-Free Diffusion Acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12530)
*Qinhan Lyu,Jusheng Zhang,Zhixing Zhang,Hao Liu,Zijie Liang,Jin Jiang,Keze Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 CacheScope，通过归一化探针输出变化来在线识别高风险复用步，选择性回退全量去噪，无需训练即显著加速扩散 Transformer 推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有免训练特征复用方法主要改进跳过特征的重建质量，但发现一旦有稳定的一阶重建器，增加重建复杂度收益有限，而精确计算步的位置对保真度影响更大；同时绝对浅层探针变化受输入轨迹位移与网络响应强度共同影响，无法直接反映缓存风险。

Method: 用对应的输入位移对探针输出变化进行归一化，得到单位轨迹移动的方向性增益，作为风险信号；据此在线识别高风险复用步并选择性回退到全量去噪计算，同时保持原有缓存重建器不变，无需额外训练、梯度、辅助网络或特定提示的离线调度优化。

Result: 在 FLUX.1-dev、Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 和 Open-Sora 1.2 上，CacheScope 实现最高 3.57 倍加速，并将中位 LPIPS 相比最强探针基线降低最多 70.1%。

Conclusion: 精确计算步的位置比重建复杂度更关键；通过归一化探针信号可有效估计缓存风险，CacheScope 在无需训练的情况下实现了显著加速与保真度提升。

Abstract: Training-free feature reuse accelerates diffusion transformer inference by replacing full denoising computation at selected steps with cached approximations. Existing methods mainly improve the reconstruction of skipped features, but we find that once a stable first-order reconstructor is used, increasing reconstruction complexity brings limited gains, whereas the placement of exact-computation steps has a much larger effect on fidelity. More importantly, absolute shallow-probe variation is jointly affected by input-trajectory displacement and network response strength, and therefore does not directly reflect cache risk. We address this confounding by normalizing probe-output variation with the corresponding input displacement, yielding a directional gain per unit trajectory movement. Based on this signal, we propose CacheScope, which identifies high-risk reuse steps online and selectively falls back to full denoising computation while leaving the underlying cache reconstructor unchanged. CacheScope requires no additional training, gradients, auxiliary networks, or prompt-specific offline schedule optimization. Across FLUX.1-dev, Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, and Open-Sora 1.2, CacheScope achieves up to 3.57x acceleration and reduces median LPIPS by up to 70.1% over the strongest probe-based baseline.

</details>


### [212] [Market Impact Estimation via Causal Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12537)
*Dennis Thumm,Ying Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一个因果市场模拟器（连续时间因果PFN），在构造性混淆的合成市场上训练，以无偏估计市场冲击；并在ABIDES、加密永续与美股数据上验证其零样本因果迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 市场冲击本质是因果量（"若未交易价格会如何"），但经典模型（Almgren-Chriss、传播子模型）将价格回归到订单流，当知情流同时通过信息与交易影响价格时存在偏差。

Method: 构建连续时间因果先验数据拟合网络（PFN），在合成市场中按构造引入隐藏知情流作为混淆变量，混淆强度为每回合可调旋钮；训练PFN及去掉干预输入的"do消融孪生"模型，并将元订单编码为"新增流"而非钳制价格。

Result: 朴素估计器偏差有闭式解并经实证确认（高估达68%），PFN在高混淆下逼近无偏真参数oracle；do消融孪生坍缩到窗口前均值。ABIDES中零样本响应真值尺度（+0.38 SD）；在约2300个BTC/ETH/SOL永续与3800个Nasdaq股票流爆发上复现。off-prior可优雅退化，分裂共形重校准可修复区间。循环状态空间变体将冲击相关性从+0.68提升至+0.92~0.96。

Conclusion: 结果与因果迁移一致（但非证明）。迁移关键在于把元订单编码为新增流，而非更多训练；循环变体改善冲击形状但on-prior去混淆较弱，源于训练配方而非循环结构本身。

Abstract: When a trader executes a large order, the relevant question is not \emph{what will the price be?} but \emph{what would the price have been had I not traded?} Market impact is thus a causal quantity, yet classical models (Almgren--Chriss, propagators) regress price on flow, which is biased whenever informed flow moves prices through information as well as trading. We present a proof-of-concept \emph{Causal Market Simulator}: a continuous-time causal prior-data fitted network (PFN) trained on a synthetic market prior in which a hidden informational flow confounds the flow--price relation by construction, with confounding strength an exact per-episode knob. On this prior, the naive estimator's bias follows a closed form we confirm empirically (up to 68\% overestimation), while the PFN tracks the unbiased true-parameter oracle at high confounding. Its \emph{do-ablated twin}, the same model with the intervention inputs removed, collapses onto the pre-window mean. Zero-shot, the model responds at the ground-truth scale to metaorders in an ABIDES limit-order book ($+0.38$ pre-onset standard deviations against seed-replay counterfactuals), and its intervention response replicates on about 2,300 detected flow bursts in BTC/ETH/SOL perpetuals and 3,800 on Nasdaq equities, evidence consistent with, though not proof of, causal transfer. Off-prior the response degrades gracefully, and split-conformal recalibration repairs interval calibration. Transfer hinges on encoding the metaorder as added flow rather than a clamped price level, not on more training. A recurrent state-space variant closes the remaining shape gap: its impact accrues over execution duration where the transformer's stays flat, raising the correlation with measured metaorder impact from $+0.68$ to between $+0.92$ and $+0.96$, at the cost of weaker on-prior deconfounding that traces to the training recipe rather than to recurrence.

</details>


### [213] [Efficient Learning of Survival Analysis Models Under Outcome-Dependent Truncation and Censoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12538)
*Itai Zilberstein,Ioannis Anagnostides,Arman Kilic,Tuomas Sandholm*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究结果依赖的截断（outcome-dependent truncation）下的生存分析，证明在基线风险已知时Cox回归可用一阶优化高效学习，但在基线风险联合学习时存在严格次优局部极小值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际数据集常违反训练数据代表性的假设，存在结果依赖的截断（观测是否进入训练数据取决于其标签）。本文连接截断下的高效学习与生存分析这两个此前分离的文献领域。

Method: 论文对截断且右删失数据下的Cox回归进行优化景观分析：在基线风险已知时证明可用一阶优化求解（尽管非凸）；在基线风险联合学习时构造可识别且正确设定的模型，并分析其负对数似然的局部极小值结构。实验在四个生存数据集上进行，并与标准期望最大化（EM）方法比较。

Result: 证明基线风险已知时Cox回归可高效用一阶优化学习；当基线风险联合学习时，负对数似然存在严格次优局部极小值。实验显示考虑截断可减少朴素Cox回归的预测偏差，并可扩展到神经网络；相比标准EM方法有数量级的加速。

Conclusion: 本文填补了截断生存分析缺乏优化景观刻画的空白，表明基线风险已知与联合学习两种情形在优化性质上有本质区别，并在实验中验证了截断建模的有效性与效率优势。

Abstract: Modern machine learning models are typically trained on data assumed to be representative of the predictive tasks the model will face in the future, but practical datasets violate this assumption. We focus on outcome-dependent truncation in which an observation appears in the training data depending on its label. Our work connects two largely distinct literatures: efficient learning under truncation and survival analysis. Existing methods for truncated survival analysis do not characterize the optimization landscape and instead rely on iterative procedures such as expectation maximization. We address this gap and prove that Cox regression can be efficiently learned under truncated and right-censored data using first-order optimization when the baseline hazard is known (despite nonconvexity). In contrast, when the baseline hazard is learned jointly, we construct identifiable and correctly specified models whose negative log-likelihood contains strict suboptimal local minima. On experiments with four survival datasets, we show that accounting for truncation reduces the prediction bias induced by naive Cox regression and extends to neural networks. We also show orders of magnitude speedups compared to standard expectation maximization.

</details>


### [214] [Enriched Holomorphic Neural Networks for 2D and 3D Laplace Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12541)
*Kalp Shah,Andrei Vlad Nicula,Mihnea Andrei Bârsan,Robert-Stefan Sofroni,Agneya Bhardwaj,Jan Jelínek,Alejandro Valverde Mahou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将全纯神经网络与几何/边界条件导出的奇异函数结合，构造性地满足调和性，无需内部残差项，只需边界数据拟合光滑剩余部分，奇异项捕捉角落、边和连接处的奇异行为。奇异指数可训练，可扩展至三维，在多个问题上为最精确方法，优势可达数个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Laplace方程边值问题在角落、边和连接处出现奇异行为，光滑逼近器难以有效求解（分辨率差）。

Method: 结合全纯神经网络与由局部几何和边界条件导出的奇异函数。表示构造性调和，因此不需要内部残差；网络仅从边界数据拟合光滑剩余，富集项捕捉奇异。奇异指数设为可训练，适用于局部展开未知的情形。通过沿复零方向评估的独立网络扩展到三维。

Result: 富集模型在所有测试问题上都是最精确的方法；当富集精确捕捉奇异时领先数个数量级；在具有多奇异点的CdZnTe辐射探测器中，二维和三维均比次优方法好约1.7–2.1倍。

Conclusion: 该方法能高效、高精度地求解含奇异性的Laplace边值问题，兼具构造性调和与可训练奇异指数的优点，并可推广至三维。

Abstract: Boundary-value problems for the Laplace equation develop singular behaviour near corners, edges and junctions that smooth approximators resolve poorly. We combine holomorphic neural networks with singular functions derived from the local geometry and boundary conditions. The representation is harmonic by construction, so no interior residual is needed: the network fits the smooth remainder from boundary data alone, and the enrichment terms capture the singular behaviour. Singular exponents are trainable, so the construction also applies when the local expansion is not known in advance. We extend the approach to three dimensions using independent networks evaluated along complex null directions. The enriched model is the most accurate tested method on every problem. Its margin is several orders of magnitude where the enrichment captures the singularity exactly, and a factor of about 1.7-2.1 over the next-best method on a CdZnTe radiation detector with many singular sites, in both two and three dimensions.

</details>


### [215] [Transformer-Based Masked Diffusion Models Provably Learn Distributions with Latent Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12544)
*Jingda Wu,Changxiao Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为基于Transformer的掩码扩散模型(MDM)建立端到端统计保证，证明其样本复杂度由潜在结构决定，而非随$V^L$指数增长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MDM并行解掩码存在两类误差：并行化误差与有限样本估计误差。现有理论将二者分开处理，且统计界通常随长度$L$、词表$V$的总序列数$V^L$缩放，受维数灾难困扰，无法解释MDM在实际数据上的有效性。

Method: 用隐马尔可夫树混合模型刻画数据潜在结构（分量内潜在依赖+分量间异质性）。在该混合模型能良好近似数据分布时，分析带并行解掩码调度的Transformer-MDM，推导端到端KL散度采样精度保证，且网络与采样无需已知树拓扑或分量参数。

Result: 达到$\varepsilon$-精确采样（KL散度）仅需$\widetilde{O}(LK_{\mathrm{par}}/\varepsilon)$训练样本，其中$K_{\mathrm{par}}$为$L$、$V$、隐状态数与混合分量数的多项式，样本复杂度由潜在结构控制而非$V^L$。

Conclusion: 从理论上解释了MDM在真实数据上的经验有效性，表明其能自动适应未知潜在结构并以结构相关复杂度学习结构化分布。

Abstract: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) generate discrete data by iteratively unmasking multiple tokens in parallel using a learned mask predictor. Their output carries two errors: parallelization error due to parallel sampling, and estimation error from the mask predictor learned with finite samples. Existing theory treats these errors separately, and the available statistical bounds typically scale with the number $V^L$ of length-$L$ sequences over a vocabulary of size $V$, suffering from the curse of dimensionality. In this work, we establish end-to-end statistical guarantees showing that transformer-based MDMs learn structured distributions with a sample complexity governed by their latent structure. Specifically, we model this structure through mixtures of hidden Markov trees, which capture latent dependencies within components and heterogeneity across components. When the data distribution is well approximated by such a mixture, a transformer-based MDM with parallel unmasking schedules achieves $\varepsilon$-accurate sampling in KL divergence with $\widetilde{O}(LK_{\mathrm{par}}/\varepsilon)$ training samples, where $K_{\mathrm{par}}$ is polynomial in $L$, $V$, the number of hidden states, and the number of mixture components. The transformer network and sampling procedure require no knowledge of the tree topologies or component parameters, thereby adapting to the unknown latent structure automatically. Overall, our results provide theoretical justification for the empirical effectiveness of MDMs on real-world data.

</details>


### [216] [Sample-Adaptive Zeroth-Order Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12566)
*Haiyuan Wan,Yanyi Li,Weicheng Lin,Cong Fang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 SAZO，在线学习样本重要性并自适应分配查询，加速零阶优化的 LLM 微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有零阶方法均匀采样训练样本，忽略其动态重要性，导致可避免的估计方差。

Method: 从方向差分中提取梯度范数信息估计样本重要性，无需真实梯度；用逐样本指数移动平均聚合稀疏小批量反馈追踪动态重要性；无额外模型评估，仅 O(N) 标量开销。

Result: 理论上渐近匹配最小方差采样 oracle 的主收敛项，收敛率严格更快；在四类模型家族上提升下游平均性能，查询数上收敛至相同损失最快达 6 倍。

Conclusion: SAZO 以极低开销实现样本自适应零阶优化，兼顾理论与实证优势。

Abstract: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization offers a memory-efficient alternative to backpropagation for fine-tuning large language models. However, existing ZO methods typically sample training examples uniformly, overlooking their evolving importance and leaving avoidable estimation variance. To address this limitation, we propose Sample-Adaptive Zeroth-Order Optimization (SAZO), which learns sample importance online and adaptively allocates queries to accelerate convergence. SAZO extracts gradient-norm information from existing directional differences to estimate sample importance without access to true gradients. Furthermore, to track evolving importance from sparse minibatch feedback, SAZO maintains per-example exponential moving averages that aggregate observations across updates. The method requires no additional model evaluations and only $O(N)$ additional scalar state compared with MeZO. We prove that SAZO asymptotically matches the leading convergence term of the minimum-variance sampling oracle, and achieves a strictly faster convergence rate than standard methods. Extensive experiments across four model families demonstrate improved average downstream performance and up to $6\times$ faster convergence to the same training loss in terms of query count.

</details>


### [217] [An all-transistor physical-learning transformer can be trained to perform in-context learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12571)
*Michael C. Abbott,Benjamin B. Machta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过引入额外电路元件恢复双向信息流，构建基于亚阈值MOSFET指数电流律的注意力机制电路，并在仿真中实现简单上下文学习任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平衡传播（equilibrium propagation）或耦合学习训练的系统类同于多层感知机，难以学习Transformer擅长的联想任务。其依赖输入输出间双向信息流，但更复杂的非线性系统（如实现点积注意力所需乘法）会破坏反向流。

Method: 在双联（dyadic）电路中加入专门电路元件以显式恢复双向流；利用亚阈值MOSFET的指数电流律构造注意力机制；使用基于同一MOSFET子电路的新型浮置电路元件生成适用于交叉熵损失的nudges（扰动）；采用Lion优化器训练电阻，每个参数用一个电容存储过去梯度估计的局部记忆。

Result: 仿真表明该电路可被训练执行简单上下文学习任务，即使反向元件仅传递近似梯度；训练成功需使用交叉熵损失而非均方误差。

Conclusion: 通过电路设计恢复双向流并结合合适损失函数与优化器，可在物理系统中实现类注意力的上下文学习能力。

Abstract: Most systems trained by equilibrium propagation or coupled learning are in the same class as multi-layer perceptrons: while they may be universal function approximators, they struggle to learn associative tasks which are easy for transformers. Equilibrium propagation relies on a bidirectional flow of information through the physical system between input and output. The reverse flow is broken by more complex nonlinear systems, such as those performing multiplication which is needed to express dot-product attention. Here we explicitly restore this bidirectional flow by introducing extra circuit elements for this purpose into a double or dyadic circuit. We then use these ideas to construct an attention mechanism exploiting the exponential current law of sub-threshold MOSFET devices. We show that in simulations this circuit can be trained to perform a simple in-context learning task, despite using realistic reverse components which transmit only an approximate gradient. For this training to succeed we need cross-entropy loss (not mean squared error). We generate nudges appropriate for this loss using a novel floating circuit element, based on the same MOSFET sub-circuit used for softmax. We train the resistors in this circuit using the Lion optimiser, which can be implemented using one capacitor per parameter to store local memory of past gradient estimates.

</details>


### [218] [DiffusionART: Efficient, Stable and Scalable Reinforcement of Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12572)
*Zhenglin Wan,Jiayu Chen,Zhengfeiyang Zhang,Pengfei Zhou,Wangbo Zhao,Fangyuan Kong,Pengfei Wan,Kun Gai,Yang You*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 DiffusionART,一种基于奖励聚合的在线强化学习微调扩散/流模型方法,无需 EMA 调参,高效稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反向过程方法(如 Flow-GRPO)效率低(信用分配差),前向过程方法(如 DiffusionNFT)虽高效但不稳定,需精心调 EMA 离线策略训练。作者揭示 NFT 目标含隐藏的前向-反向一致性力,EMA 通过"恢复"而非离线策略起稳定作用。

Method: DiffusionART 将每个 prompt 的奖励聚合成共享的"奖励提升方向"用于反向过程状态,构造上消除一致性力;并加入 trust-region-masked 的第二次更新实现自适应漂移恢复,无需 EMA 调参;支持成对奖励模型(DiffusionART-Pairwise),无需可微奖励模型。

Result: 在 HunyuanVideo-13B 上,视觉与运动质量等权奖励下,DiffusionART 达到 DiffusionNFT 和 Flow-GRPO-Fast 的后期平均奖励水平,分别少用 12.02 倍和 11.72 倍 GPU 小时,平均训练奖励高 28.8% 和 53.0%。图像与视频生成上均高效稳定,每任务无需调参,且每 prompt 样本更少仍有效。

Conclusion: DiffusionART 通过奖励聚合消除前向-反向一致性力,并用信任域掩码更新实现漂移自适应恢复,大幅提升在线 RL 微调扩散模型的效率与稳定性,无需 EMA 调参。

Abstract: Online reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tunes diffusion models with black-box rewards, but reverse-process methods such as Flow-GRPO are limited in efficiency by poor credit assignment, while forward-process methods such as DiffusionNFT are efficient yet unstable without carefully tuned exponential-moving-average (EMA) off-policy training. We show that NFT-style objectives contain a hidden forward--reverse consistency force that joint positive--negative training cancels only partially, and that EMA stabilizes training through restoration rather than off-policy rollouts. We introduce DiffusionART (Diffusion Reinforcement with Aggregation-First Reward Tilting), which aggregates each prompt's rewards into a shared reward-improving direction for reverse-process states, removing the consistency force by construction, and adds a trust-region-masked second update for drift-adaptive restoration without EMA tuning. It requires no differentiable reward model, remains effective with fewer samples per prompt, and supports pairwise reward models (DiffusionART-Pairwise). Across image and video generation, DiffusionART trains efficiently and stably without per-task tuning. In particular, on HunyuanVideo-13B with equally weighted visual and motion quality rewards, DiffusionART reaches the late-stage mean reward levels of DiffusionNFT and Flow-GRPO-Fast with 12.02 and 11.72 times fewer GPU hours, respectively, while achieving 28.8% and 53.0% higher mean training rewards.

</details>


### [219] [Realism VS Accuracy: Event Sequence Forecasting from a Generative Modeling Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12586)
*Dmitry Osin,Egor Surkov,Petr Mokrov,Igor Udovichenko,Ivan Karpukhin,Evgeny Burnaev,Egor Shvetsov,Alexander Korotin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究事件序列的多步预测，将其视为条件生成建模问题，同时评估预测精度与分布真实性，并提出Wasserstein BaryBooster将扩散模型的真实性转化为预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件序列（由异构数值与类别特征组成的随机事件链）预测在金融、医疗、业务流程智能等领域广泛存在。现有研究往往只关注预测精度，忽视了分布真实性，且缺乏统一评估基准。

Method: 构建基准：包含衡量精度与真实性两方面的指标、强统计基线、从相邻领域适配的近期模型以及精心整理的real-world数据集。进一步提出Wasserstein BaryBooster，将真实性强的扩散模型样本聚合到最先进的预测器中。

Result: 细致评估发现没有任何方法能同时在精度和真实性上表现优异，揭示出两者之间的基本权衡；Wasserstein BaryBooster证明了分布真实性可转化为预测精度。

Conclusion: 多步事件序列预测存在精度与分布真实性的权衡，通过Wasserstein BaryBooster将扩散模型的真实性聚合进预测器可提升精度，为未来研究提供基准与方向。

Abstract: Event sequences are chains of random events, each described by heterogeneous (numerical and categorical) features. The problem of event sequence forecasting occurs in finance, healthcare, business process intelligence, and other fields. In this work, we study multi-horizon forecasting of event sequences as a conditional generative modeling problem. We evaluate forecasts not only for prediction accuracy, but also for distributional realism. To this end, we present a benchmark comprising metrics for both quality aspects, strong statistical baselines, recent models adapted from adjacent fields, and curated real-world datasets. Careful evaluation reveals that no method excels at both accuracy and realism, highlighting a fundamental trade-off between the two.
