Beyond theoretical formulation and complexity analysis, extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate Orthros's superiority across multiple dimensions. First, we validate its fundamental language modeling capabilities, demonstrating scalability across varying model sizes and strong competitiveness in comprehensive architectural comparisons. Second, Orthros exhibits exceptional conversion feasibility via a data-efficient Transformer-to-Orthros conversion, yielding performance that even surpasses the original Transformer. Finally, Orthros achieves a $21.9\times$ prefilling speedup over Transformers with end-to-end inference gains, while preserving long-context capabilities, as demonstrated by near-perfect 128K needle-in-a-haystack results and Transformer-level performance on real-world in-context recall tasks. Overall, these advantages in high performance, flexibility, and efficiency position Orthros as a promising candidate to succeed the Transformer in industrial applications.

</details>


### [329] [SafeDiSTL: Decomposing Joint Constraints for Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13737)
*Hongrui Zheng,Aditya Singh,Rahul Mangharam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SafeDiSTL：利用STL鲁棒性与可微动力学进行动作敏感度分配，实现联合约束下的多智能体信用分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协作多智能体任务常受共享目标或集体安全约束，但团队级违规代价函数无法区分哪些智能体的动作对违规影响最大，缺乏信用分配。

Method: 提出约束多智能体强化学习框架SafeDiSTL，用STL鲁棒性通过运行最大值代价增量度量回合级违规；借助平滑的全回合鲁棒性与可微动力学获取动作敏感度，在同一决策时刻将各代价增量分配给各智能体，并在加权分配时考虑延迟效应。

Result: 在协作负载运输、连通导航与网络化交通控制任务中验证：运输安全成功率提升1.6-5.1倍，导航安全成功提升11.1%，交通吞吐量提升50-68%，优于受限基线。

Conclusion: 结果表明该方法在学习策略处理共享约束方面有显著提升，同时保持无约束策略的性能。

Abstract: Cooperative multi-agent tasks often impose constraints on a shared objective or collective safety. A team level violation cost function can measure this constraint outcome, but does not distinguish which agents' actions most strongly influence that violation. We present SafeDiSTL, a constrained multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that allows for credit assignment even with joint constraint measurements. We use Signal Temporal Logic (STL) robustness to measure episode-level violation through running-maximum cost increments. Smooth full-episode robustness and differentiable dynamics provide action sensitivities, which allocate each cost increment across agents at the same decision time. These sensitivities account for delayed effects when weighting agents' shares of each cost increment. We study the framework in cooperative payload transport, connected navigation, and networked traffic control tasks. SafeDiSTL achieves 1.6-5.1x the safe-success rate in transport, improves navigation safe-success by 11.1%, and delivers 50-68% more throughput in traffic when compared to constrained baselines. Results demonstrate a strong improvement of the learned policy in dealing with shared constraint while retaining the performance of unconstrained policies.

</details>


### [330] [Studying the Effects of Task Diversity Using Small Mathematical Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13750)
*Emily Xia Meng,Xuanyu Yang,Junaid Hasan,Michael Ruofan Zeng,Henry Kvinge*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出IntWorld和PermWorld两个数学任务生态系统，用于研究任务多样性对模型内部表征的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究通常只关注单一数学任务，而现代语言模型需应对大量任务，因此需要能可控模拟任务多样性的实验环境，以理解任务多样性在训练中的作用。

Method: 构建基于整数和置换的两类数学任务生态系统IntWorld与PermWorld，由彼此相关但不同的任务组成；数据集程序化生成，可精确控制任务数量以分离任务多样性的影响。

Result: 初步结果表明，增加任务多样性可提升模型内部表征的丰富性。

Conclusion: 该工作提供可精确调控任务多样性的实验平台，并支持任务多样性促进内部表征丰富化的观点。

Abstract: Basic mathematical tasks like modular addition have been a valuable tool for illuminating aspects of neural network behavior that are challenging to see in noisy, unverifiable, large-scale, real-world settings. These studies have typically focused on a single task. However, modern language models are exposed to a vast number of tasks despite being trained with a next-token prediction objective. In this work, we introduce two mathematical task ecosystems, IntWorld and PermWorld, built from distinct but related tasks on integers and permutations. Both are designed to simulate task diversity within a cohesive mathematical 'world' where tasks are distinct but related. Because the datasets are procedurally generated, we can precisely vary the number of tasks, allowing us to begin to disentangle the role of task variety from other factors in training. After describing the datasets, we provide some initial results obtained from these datasets which support the idea that increasing task diversity increases the richness of a model's internal representations.

</details>


### [331] [Matched-Context Group Policy Optimization for LLM Agent Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13755)
*Chenxu Zhang,Yaorui Shi,Wenlong Zhang,Jianchao Tan,Zihan Wang,Yiming Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MCGPO，通过匹配上下文的成对偏好加权，从已有轨迹中构造动作比较，改进长程智能体信用分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程语言模型智能体训练需从稀疏终局反馈中为中间决策分配信用，而组内同级轨迹的有效动作比较依赖上下文、证据及证据进入学习的方式。

Method: MCGPO从已收集轨迹构建加权动作偏好：用动作前状态摘要与规则标注的评分进展定义比较上下文；用双动作支持选择有序精确或粗匹配规则；固定折叠分离候选决策与定向终局结果；支持相关证据权重缩放辅助成对目标，与共享GraphGPO任务学习并行，保持无评论家训练并复用原始历史。

Result: 在六个环境-骨干设置、三个随机种子下，MCGPO相对GraphGPO提升平均成功率：Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B在ALFWorld和WebShop提升0.47-1.46个百分点；Qwen3-4B/8B在WebShop提升3.96和5.16个百分点。ALFWorld基线超92%。集成成功率在四分之三Qwen2.5设置中提升。三种子因子控制支持反向折叠证据与证据加权；状态-评分联合匹配在四个表示控制设置中均值最高。

Conclusion: MCGPO通过匹配上下文与证据加权有效改进组策略优化，在多个设置下稳定提升成功率和集成表现，验证了比较上下文与证据设计的重要性。

Abstract: Training long-horizon language model agents requires assigning credit to intermediate decisions from sparse terminal feedback. Within a finite group of sibling rollouts, useful action comparisons depend on their context, evidence for both alternatives, and how that evidence enters learning. We propose Matched-Context Group Policy Optimization (MCGPO), a procedure for constructing weighted action preferences from already collected trajectories. MCGPO defines comparison contexts with pre-action state summaries and observed rubric progress, annotated by task rules. Two-action support selects among ordered exact and coarse matching rules. Fixed folds separate candidate decisions from the terminal outcomes used to orient their preferences, and support-dependent evidence weights scale an auxiliary pairwise objective alongside shared GraphGPO task learning. MCGPO reuses rollout data and each response's original history, preserving critic-free training. Across six environment-backbone settings with three training seeds each, MCGPO improves mean success over matched GraphGPO: by 0.47-1.46 percentage points on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B and 7B, and by 3.96 and 5.16 points on WebShop with Qwen3-4B and 8B. The ALFWorld gains build on baseline success above 92%, where remaining headroom is limited. Integrated success improves in three of four Qwen2.5 settings. Three-seed factorial controls support opposite-fold evidence and evidence weighting; joint state-rubric matching achieves the highest mean in all four representation-control settings.

</details>


### [332] [When Edge Independence Fails: Joint Graph Diffusion with Latent Sociability Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13765)
*Adarsh Jamadandi,Nicolas Keriven,Aline Roumy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出离散图扩散模型因终端先验必然是E-R随机图，导致GNN去噪器在大图极限下无法有效去噪；提出Latent Sociability Prior联合扩散过程解决该根本问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散图扩散模型通过独立边更新和马尔可夫噪声建模，结合输出分布的可交换性要求，终端先验必然是E-R随机图。这导致在大图极限下，任何GNN去噪器作用于E-R图后仍近似输出E-R图，去噪困难，生成图无法恢复有意义的节点异质性和高阶结构。已有模型引入专门节点特征来补偿，将其视为表达力问题，但忽视了先验的作用。

Method: 提出Latent Sociability Prior（LSP）及联合扩散过程，使潜在节点社性变量与图结构共同演化，在移除边独立性的同时保持可交换性。与现有潜在图扩散方法不同，社性机制无需复杂编码器，其唯一作用是引导边更新并在整个轨迹中保持节点异质性。

Result: 在多个图生成数据集上验证，所提框架在无节点特征条件下比基线方法更准确地捕捉图分布。

Conclusion: 从先验层面解决离散图扩散的根本问题，联合扩散机制在保持可交换性的同时实现有效去噪与图分布建模。

Abstract: Discrete graph diffusion models corrupt graph structure through independent edge updates with a Markovian noise model. Combined with the exchangeability requirement on the output distribution, the terminal prior is necessarily an Erdős--Rényi (E-R) random graph. This has a fundamental consequence for unconditional graph generation without node features: in the large graph limit, any GNN denoiser applied to an E-R graph approximately outputs an E-R graph, making effective denoising difficult. In practice, generated graphs fail to recover meaningful node heterogeneity and higher-order structure. Previous models introduced specialized node features to compensate, framing this as an expressivity problem, while the role of the prior remained unexamined. We instead address the root cause by introducing the Latent Sociability Prior (LSP) and a join} diffusion process that co-evolves latent node sociability variables and graph structure, removing edge independence while preserving exchangeability. Unlike existing latent graph diffusion methods, the sociability mechanism requires no complex encoder: its sole role is to guide edge updates and preserve node heterogeneity throughout the trajectory. We validate our approach on multiple graph generation datasets and show that the proposed framework more accurately captures graph distributions than baseline methods without node features.

</details>


### [333] [DualQuant: Dual-scale Calibration-free Weight-and-Activation Quantization for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13767)
*Mahsa Salmani,Sayeh Sharify,Hesham Mostafa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DUALQUANT：一种双尺度、免校准的PTQ框架，同时量化权重和激活，支持MX/NVFP4格式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低比特推理需同时量化权重和激活以获取全部吞吐收益，但激活量化更困难且通常需要校准数据。

Method: 将权重重构MSE最小化建模为非可微问题，用变量分裂和块坐标下降求解，各子问题有闭式解；由最小化权重重构误差得到的缩放因子直接用作激活重缩放。

Result: 在Llama和Qwen上（WikiText-2、C4及零样本任务）匹配或超越基于校准的SmoothQuant，显著优于免校准基线；RTX 4090上实现最高2.61x内存降低、2.46x吞吐加速。

Conclusion: 首个正式支持MX和NV块格式的双尺度方法，免校准即可实现高质量W4A4量化，接近伪量化精度。

Abstract: Low-bit inference on accelerators with native 4-bit support requires quantizing both weights and activations to realize the full throughput gains these formats provide. While post-training weight quantization has been extensively studied, activation quantization remains considerably more challenging and typically requires calibration data. In this work, we introduce DUALQUANT, a dual-scale, calibration-free post-training quantization framework that directly minimizes the weight-reconstruction Mean Squared Error (MSE) and, as an immediate by-product, yields per-channel activation rescalings prior to activation quantization. Our key observation is that the scaling factors obtained by minimizing weight-reconstruction error provide effective activation rescalings, enabling competitive activation quantization without calibration data. We formulate DUALQUANT as a non-differentiable weight-reconstruction problem and develop an efficient solver based on variable splitting and block coordinate descent, where each subproblem admits a closed-form update. DUALQUANT provides a unified algorithm supporting a wide range of formats, including the full MX family and NVFP4. To our knowledge, DUALQUANT is the first dual-scaling method to formally support MX and NV block formats. Across Llama and Qwen models evaluated on WikiText-2, C4, and zero-shot downstream tasks, DUALQUANT matches or exceeds the accuracy of calibration-based SmoothQuant across most models and formats, and substantially outperforms calibration-free baselines, with large gains for MX and NV block formats. We validate these gains with a real packed W4A4 inference path for Llama-3.1-8B on an RTX 4090. The resulting implementation closely matches the accuracy of fake quantization while delivering up to 2.61x memory reduction and up to 2.46x throughput speedup over BF16.

</details>


### [334] [ReplaySSM: Cache SSM Inputs, Not State](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13778)
*Ze-Wei Liou,Harris Nover,Amey Naik,Andrii Skliar,Igor Shovkun,Ido Shahaf,Tri Dao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ReplaySSM将SSM递推状态表示为一个检查点加上近期输入缓冲区,分离输出计算与检查点更新,从而减少状态读写、简化投机回滚并支持混合精度状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SSM维持固定大小的循环状态,但每个解码步都读写该状态会导致状态I/O巨大且算术强度低,使投机解码缺少廉价回滚,并让状态量化误差渗入后续递推更新。

Method: 展开递推,把状态表示为检查点加近期SSM输入缓冲区;输出计算与检查点更新分离,周期性更新检查点,减少大多数步的状态写并约减半主导状态内存流量;保留近期输入使投机回滚仅需缓冲区指针操作,并支持仅输出验证;允许低精度检查点用于输出、高精度检查点用于递推更新,避免低精度误差进入后续更新。

Result: 在vLLM中为Mamba-2与Gated DeltaNet实现;服务批大小256时,标准解码相比调优vLLM基线加速1.20–1.47倍,在两个120B级模型上吞吐约为vLLM投机解码的1.8倍;分离状态精度相比共享低精度检查点降低输出KL散度与下游精度损失。

Conclusion: 通过重放式检查点加输入缓冲的状态管理,ReplaySSM在大规模混合模型服务中同时提升标准与投机解码效率,并改善量化带来的精度损失。

Abstract: State-space models (SSMs) maintain a fixed-size recurrent state, but reading and writing it at every decoding step can bottleneck hybrid models. This eager state management causes large state I/O with low arithmetic intensity, leaves speculative decoding no cheap rollback, and feeds state quantization error into subsequent recurrent updates. We introduce ReplaySSM, which unrolls the recurrence to represent the state as a checkpoint and a buffer of recent SSM inputs. This separates output computation from checkpoint updates. By updating the checkpoint periodically, ReplaySSM avoids state writes on most steps and roughly halves the dominant state memory traffic. Keeping recent inputs also makes speculative rollback a buffer-pointer operation and enables output-only verification without materializing intermediate states. The same separation allows a low-precision checkpoint to serve output computation on most steps while a higher-precision checkpoint serves recurrent updates, so rounding error in the low-precision copy never enters later updates. We implement ReplaySSM in vLLM for Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet. At serving batch size 256, it accelerates standard decoding by $1.20$--$1.47\times$ over a tuned vLLM baseline across four hybrid models, and delivers about $1.8\times$ the throughput of vLLM's speculative decoding on the two 120B-class models. Separate state precisions also reduce output KL divergence and downstream accuracy losses compared with a shared low-precision checkpoint.

</details>


### [335] [Your Discrete Graph Diffusion Model is Secretly Memorizing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13786)
*Adarsh Jamadandi,Nicolas Keriven*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文首次揭示离散图扩散模型（GDM）存在记忆现象，称为"条件记忆"，仅在反向轨迹以受损训练图为条件时出现，且早于社区结构生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前研究认为在不含节点特征的无条件设定下，GDM训练于单图能生成新图且无明显记忆证据。本文挑战这一观点。

Method: 分析在两块随机块模型（SBM）上训练的GDM的反向扩散轨迹，比较模型对受损训练图与留出测试图的恢复能力。

Result: 模型几乎完美恢复受损训练图，而测试图恢复较差；训练损失改善同时留出损失恶化，形成无法通过早停缓解的泛化差距；记忆起始始终早于生成图中社区结构的出现，且在所有测试节点规模下均成立。

Conclusion: GDM确实存在记忆现象（条件记忆），该现象与泛化差距扩大相关，且记忆先于结构生成，早停无法缓解。

Abstract: Discrete graph diffusion models (GDMs) corrupt the graph structure by adding noise independently to nodes and edges under a Markovian noise model. In the unconditional setting without node features, an equivariant denoiser trained on a single graph is able to generate novel graphs and sample-level metrics such as edge overlap and WL kernel similarity find no evidence of memorization. In this work, we challenge this view and show for the first time that graph diffusion models indeed exhibit memorization. Analyzing the reverse diffusion trajectories of GDMs trained on two-block stochastic block models (SBMs), we find a strong train-data bias: the model recovers a corrupted training graph almost perfectly compared to a held-out test graph. We term this conditional memorization, as it surfaces only when the reverse trajectory is conditioned on a corrupted training graph and is not apparent during inference. It coincides with a growing generalization gap, where the training loss improves as the loss on held-out graphs degrades, and it cannot be mitigated by early stopping. The onset of memorization always precedes the emergence of community structure in the generated graphs, thus every checkpoint earlier produces structureless graphs. This behavior holds across all node sizes we test.

</details>


### [336] [Randomized Momentum Transport with Cheap Predictors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13789)
*El Mahdi Chayti,Martin Jaggi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出随机动量传输（randomized momentum transport）方法，以减少STORM等动量方法中每步额外的oracle调用成本。通过概率q评估修正并使用廉价预测和重要性加权保持条件均值，在多种假设下保持O(T^{-1/3})收敛，并在实验中显著提升效率与精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: STORM等动量方法通过传输修正跟踪梯度，但每次迭代需额外一次oracle调用，成本高。作者希望在尽量不损失收敛性的前提下降低该开销。

Method: 提出随机动量传输：以概率q计算修正，否则使用廉价预测；采用重要性加权保持条件均值，并将预测损失以(q^{-1}-1)倍加入方差。结合LMO更新（归一化、sign、Muon方向）与单梯度初始化，并引入在线对角预测器。

Result: 在传输偏差、二阶矩和残差控制假设下，对任意固定q>0保持O(T^{-1/3})平稳性界。对未归一化STORM，当梯度差噪声模超过光滑常数时，某q<1可降低梯度预算主系数，降幅最大约10%。约等oracle成本下，查询四分之一修正使MNIST1D最终训练损失降低18%–43%，CIFAR-10上Hessian-向量传输测试精度提高1.5个百分点。

Conclusion: 随机化传输修正可在基本保持理论收敛率的同时降低oracle成本，并在实际任务中带来损失与精度的显著改善，验证了方法的有效性与实用性。

Abstract: Momentum methods such as STORM and second-order momentum track the gradient by adding a transport correction to momentum, at the cost of an extra oracle call per iteration. We introduce randomized momentum transport, which evaluates the correction with probability $q$ and otherwise uses a cheap prediction, with importance weighting that preserves the conditional mean and adds $(q^{-1}-1)$ times the prediction loss to the variance. Under transport-bias, second-moment, and residual-control assumptions, linear minimization oracle (LMO) updates, including normalized, sign, and exact spectral (Muon) directions, retain an $O(T^{-1/3})$ stationarity bound for each fixed $q>0$ with a single-gradient initialization. For unnormalized STORM, some $q<1$ lowers the leading coefficient of our sufficient gradient budget if and only if the gradient-difference noise modulus exceeds the smoothness constant, by at most about $10\%$. An online diagonal predictor admits a regret-to-convergence guarantee. At approximately equal oracle cost, querying a quarter of the corrections lowers the final training loss by $18$ to $43\%$ on MNIST1D and raises the test accuracy of Hessian-vector transport on CIFAR-10 by $1.5$ points.

</details>


### [337] [FORTE: A Production Framework for Feature Evaluation and Deprecation in Industrial Recommender Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13806)
*Vishnu Arun,Adam Obeng,Tianyou Wang,Zilin Ren,Mukuntha Narayanan Sundararaman,Han Wang,Shivin Thukral,Zhixiang Wang,Saurabh Vishwas Joshi,Darren Reger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FORTE是一个模型无关的生产级框架，通过高效扰动、分组消融和血缘追踪来发现、验证并移除推荐系统中的冗余特征，在不造成线上指标退化的前提下实现降本增效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产推荐系统存在特征生命周期不对称：新增特征必须带来收益，而删除特征必须不使任何指标退化。但特征弃用难以优先处理，原因包括特征间交互、重要性日常变化、生产模型变更或数据漂移前无法评估、与其它上线争抢A/B测试资源、在线测试出现回归、以及多模型协调消费等。

Method: FORTE采用模型无关的生产框架：高效扰动实现支持每日特征评估；通过分组消融评估由所有低秩特征构建的候选特征集以处理交互；离线结果对在线A/B测试具备足够预测力；血缘追踪识别所有下游消费模型以充分节省移除特征带来的训练收益。

Result: 在两个大规模推荐系统上验证。搜索相关性模型上，FORTE得到32、48、59三个嵌套候选集，在线护栏拒绝最大集，最终弃用48特征集，移除43.3%的特征且无回归。大型排序模型上识别出8个可移除候选，重训与A/B测试确认无回归，可训练参数减少29.9%，服务吞吐提升19.8-25.5%，年训练成本节省数十万美元。

Conclusion: FORTE能有效识别不引起在线回归的可弃用特征集，提升效率的程度取决于模型特性，为生产推荐系统的特征弃用提供了可靠框架。

Abstract: Production recommender systems have feature-lifecycle asymmetry: adding new features must produce gains on some metric, while feature removal must not regress any metric. In practice, feature deprecation is hard to prioritize as a feature can fail to be removed if it interacts with other features, its importance changes daily, it cannot be evaluated before production models change or data drift occurs, it is in contention for A/B test space with other launches, it causes regressions in an online A/B test, or it is consumed by multiple models that need to coordinate its deprecation. We present FORTE, a model-agnostic production framework for discovering, validating, and removing features. Its efficient perturbation implementation allows daily feature evaluation. To account for interactions, it evaluates candidate feature sets constructed from all the low-rank features through grouped ablation and its offline results are sufficiently predictive of online A/B tests to allow deprecations to proceed to online testing with confidence. Lineage tracing identifies all downstream consumer models to realize the full savings of removing a feature from the training set. We validate FORTE over 2 large-scale recommender systems and find that it identifies deprecable feature sets which do not cause online regressions, while the impact on efficiency depends on model characteristics. On a search-relevance model, FORTE resulted in 3 nested candidate sets of 32, 48, and 59 features. Online guardrails rejected the largest treatment. The 48-feature set was selected for deprecation, removing 43.3% of the model's features. On a large ranking model, FORTE identified 8 candidates for removal. Retraining and A/B testing confirmed no regression. Its launch reduced the trainable parameters by 29.9%, improved serving throughput by 19.8-25.5%, and reduced annual training costs by hundreds of thousands of dollars.

</details>


### [338] [Spanning Diffusion and Flow-based Posterior Sampling via Exact Gaussian Conditioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13812)
*Teo Deveney,Lea Bogensperger,Hok Shing Wong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出β-Flow，一种通用即插即用方法，用相关参数β统一flow、diffusion和解相关先验，用置信参数κ控制路径分布约束，每步仅需一次网络前向加精确Kalman高斯条件更新，在7个逆问题、4个数据集上达SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有flow-matching与diffusion逆问题方法多针对特定轨迹先验定制；即插即用方法隐式解相关引导轨迹，导致先验过宽，数据稀疏时表现不佳。

Method: 提出β-Flow，通过相关参数β泛化flow、diffusion与解相关先验，置信参数κ控制路径分布约束强度。每步一次去噪网络前向，随后高斯条件步——不依赖网络梯度的精确Kalman更新。并证明许多现有引导采样器可视为其特例或近似，各自隐含不同轨迹先验与以Kalman增益替代的算子。

Result: 在4个数据集、7个逆问题上，PSNR与SSIM持续达到SOTA水平。并验证先验控制作用：观测信息少时高相关强先验（strict prior）最佳，观测信息多时低相关更优。

Conclusion: β-Flow统一了引导采样框架，揭示各方法的隐式偏差与假设；其先验-似然互补控制印证贝叶斯推断中二者互补作用，提供灵活有效的通用即插即用求解器。

Abstract: Flow-matching and diffusion models are increasingly used as priors for linear inverse problems, however, most methods are bespoke to one class of trajectory prior. Plug-and-play methods have been proposed, however these implicitly decorrelate the guided trajectory, resulting in broad priors that can struggle when data is sparse. This work proposes $β$-Flow: a general plug-and-play method indexed by a correlation parameter $β$ that generalises over flow, diffusion, and decorrelated priors, and a confidence parameter $κ$ that controls how strongly the path distribution is enforced. Each step requires only one forward evaluation of a denoising network, followed by a Gaussian conditioning step. This step is an exact Kalman update that is not dependent on network gradients. We show that many existing guided samplers can be interpreted as instances or approximations of our method, each implicitly using a different trajectory prior and operator in place of the Kalman gain. From this viewpoint, we provide a qualitative comparison of methods in terms of their implicit biases and assumptions. We demonstrate consistently state-of-the-art level performance across 7 inverse problems over 4 datasets in terms of PSNR and SSIM. Moreover, we demonstrate the utility of this prior control, by showing that confident high correlations (strict priors) work best when observations are less informative, while low correlation is preferred when observations are more informative, reflecting the complementary roles of the prior and likelihood in Bayesian inference.

</details>


### [339] [TabMF: Learning Dataset Representations with Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13818)
*Rafiq Kamel,Nicolas Atienza,Aziz Fouché,Nicola Cancedda,Josif Grabocka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TabMF 将预训练表格基础模型（TFM）复用为监督数据集编码器，通过架构感知的读出层和对比后训练获得数据集级表示，在六个真实数据集任务上取得最优综合性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有监督数据集表示方法依赖手工元特征或专门训练的数据集编码器，缺乏通用性与迁移能力。

Method: 为预测型 TFM 配备架构感知的数据集级读出层，并利用合成监督数据集随机视图进行端到端对比后训练；在 TabICLv2 与 TabPFN-2.5 上实例化。

Result: 简单冻结的 TFM 读出即具竞争力，说明预测预训练已诱导出数据集级结构；两个 TabMF 编码器在所学与经典表示中综合表现最强，在数据集检索、紧凑基准构建与分布漂移严重度评估上尤为突出。

Conclusion: 预测型表格基础模型可被高效复用为数据集表示编码器，TabMF 为数据集检索与分布漂移监控等任务提供了强基线。

Abstract: Representations of supervised datasets support higher-level machine-learning tasks such as dataset retrieval and distribution-shift monitoring. However, existing approaches typically rely either on hand-crafted meta-features or on dataset encoders trained specifically for representation learning. We introduce TabMF, a framework that repurposes pretrained tabular foundation models (TFMs) as encoders of supervised datasets. TabMF equips a predictive TFM with an architecture-aware dataset-level readout and adapts the model end-to-end using contrastive post-training on stochastic views of synthetic supervised datasets. We instantiate TabMF on TabICLv2 and TabPFN-2.5 and evaluate the resulting representations across six tasks on unseen real datasets. Simple frozen TFM readouts yield competitive representations, indicating that predictive pretraining already induces substantial dataset-level structure. The two TabMF encoders obtain the strongest aggregate performance among the evaluated learned and classical dataset representations, with particularly strong results in dataset retrieval, compact benchmark construction, and distribution-shift severity assessment.

</details>


### [340] [Shared Canonical Component Removal Beyond Expert Views](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13819)
*Jose Roberto Tello Ayala,Akl C. Fahed,Roy Perlis,Finale Doshi-Velez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SCCR审计框架，量化原始模型相对专家特征的额外预测信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床中专家先用专家特征决策，黑盒模型用原始输入可能更强，但原始模型到底利用了哪些超出专家视角的信号尚不清楚。

Method: 通过Shared Canonical Component Removal，仅移除学习到的原始与专家嵌入间强共享的方向，区别于标准残差化和概念擦除。

Result: 在合成数据、冠脉病检测、抗抑郁治疗脱落预测及SkinCon皮肤病变分类上验证有效。

Conclusion: SCCR能识别专家视角的不足，并恢复残余预测信号，同时最小化与专家视角的冗余。

Abstract: In clinical practice, experts often begin by converting raw inputs into a set of expert features before making a decision. While black-box models trained on raw input can outperform models trained on expert views, it remains unclear what predictive signal the raw model exploits beyond what the expert view captures. We introduce an audit framework to quantify this gap using Shared Canonical Component Removal (SCCR). Unlike standard residualization or concept erasure, SCCR selectively removes only those directions strongly shared between learned raw and expert embeddings.
  Evaluations on synthetic data, coronary artery disease (CAD) detection, antidepressant treatment dropout prediction, and skin lesion classification using SkinCon annotations show that SCCR identifies the ways in which expert views are insufficient and recovers residual predictive signal while minimizing redundancy with the expert view.

</details>


### [341] [On the Design Space of Continuous Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13834)
*Oscar Davis,Daan Roos,Alice Bizeul,Amitis Shidani,Victor Turrisi,Louis Béthune,Pierre Ablin,Marco Cuturi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究连续扩散语言模型(CDLM)中自条件(self-conditioning)与嵌入几何两个关键因素的作用机制，提出DoubleCat与SemiCat方法，以更低成本提升性能，在TinyGSM和1.7B规模上达到或超越离散扩散模型的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续扩散语言模型发展迅速、能力已接近离散扩散，但与图像/视频等连续模态不同，学界对训练CDLM时真正重要的设计要素理解仍然有限，亟需厘清关键杠杆及其背后机制。

Method: 聚焦自条件与嵌入几何两要素：证明自条件可纠正训练/推理不匹配；提出两级插值的DoubleCat，无需额外前向传播即可复现收益；针对token可识别性问题引入离散揭示，得到DoubleCat的变体SemiCat；并探索混合破坏过程、噪声调度（含异步调度）等选项。

Result: DoubleCat将TinyGSM准确率提升三倍以上；SemiCat在TinyGSM上达49.94%，达到离散扩散水平；在1.7B规模下，SemiCat在六项基于似然的评测中四项超越离散扩散，并在无条件生成上超过one-hot流；交叉熵驱动嵌入趋向其解码错误率与one-hot相近的几何。

Conclusion: 通过揭示自条件与嵌入几何的机制，提出更廉价有效的设计，帮助社区更好地理解和推进连续扩散语言模型的设计空间。

Abstract: Continuous diffusion language models (CDLMs) promise to bring the benefits of continuous flow modelling to language, including accelerated sampling and controllable generation. The field has grown rapidly, and the capabilities of CDLMs have begun to rival those of discrete diffusion. Yet, unlike for continuous modalities such as images or videos, our grasp of the levers that matter when training CDLMs remains limited. In this work, we focus on two of these levers, namely self-conditioning and embedding geometry, and shed light on some of the mechanisms behind them, which in turn suggest cheaper and more effective designs. We begin by showing that self-conditioning corrects a train/inference mismatch by exposing the model to inference-like states that are otherwise rare during training. These gains can be recovered without an extra forward pass by a two-level interpolant, coined $\mathrm{DoubleCat}$, which improves TinyGSM accuracy more than threefold. Self-conditioning also aids in recognising tokens dominated by large-norm Gaussians$\unicode{x2013}$an issue known as token identifiability. To address it directly, we introduce discrete reveals to $\mathrm{DoubleCat}$, yielding $\mathrm{SemiCat}$, which achieves discrete diffusion-level performance on TinyGSM, reaching $49.94\%$ with standard training hyperparameters and a tuned sampler. At the $1.7$B scale, $\mathrm{SemiCat}$ outperforms discrete diffusion on four of six likelihood-based evaluations, and surpasses one-hot flows on unconditional generation. On embedded spaces, we find that cross-entropy drives embeddings towards a geometry whose decoding error rate closely matches the one-hot one. We briefly explore a range of further options, such as hybrid corruption processes and noise schedules, including asynchronous ones. We believe this exploration can help the community better understand and advance the design space of CDLMs.

</details>


### [342] [Specialists Learn Faster: Knowledge Organization in Pre-training Shapes Knowledge Update Efficiency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13835)
*Sheng Zhao,Yuhao Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究预训练阶段时变知识的组织方式如何影响后续知识更新的效率，发现按时间顺序训练的"专家"模型比随机打乱的"通才"模型更新成本更低，并据此提出优化数据组织策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作主要关注训练完成后的高效知识更新，但忽略了预训练阶段时间知识的组织方式对后续更新效率的影响。

Method: 对比按时间顺序训练（专家）与随机打乱训练（通才）的模型；从第一性原理推导更新成本与优化动态关系的定律；设计兼顾稳定历史知识与高效更新当前知识的数据组织策略。

Result: 专家模型更新所需步骤远少于通才模型；推导出的定律可紧密预测实验结果；提出的数据组织策略有效，且优势可推广到真实预训练模型和现有更新工具。

Conclusion: 预训练数据的时间组织方式显著影响后续知识更新效率，为高效知识更新提供了新的设计思路。

Abstract: An ideal (language) model must continually update its knowledge. Existing work largely focuses on making these updates efficient after training. We investigate how the organization of time-varying knowledge during pre-training shapes the efficiency of subsequent updates. Models trained on chronologically ordered knowledge specialize in the most recently encountered knowledge; we call them specialists. In contrast, models trained on the same knowledge in randomly shuffled order perform well across all represented time periods; we call them generalists. Surprisingly, specialists require far fewer update steps than generalists to acquire new knowledge. To explain this advantage, we derive a law from first principles that relates update cost to the model's optimization dynamics and that closely predicts empirical results. Guided by these findings, we design a strategy for organizing pre-training data that preserves stable historical knowledge while enabling efficient updates to current knowledge. We also show that the benefits of temporal knowledge organization extend to real-world pre-trained models and existing knowledge update tools, and generalize to other knowledge orderings. Project page: https://horizon-lab.org/specialist/

</details>


### [343] [Inference-Time Steering Across Scaffolds and Epitopes for Sample-Efficient De Novo Nanobody Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13844)
*Mason Minot,Simon Friedensohn,Cédric R. Weber*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将生成式分子设计中的条件选择重新定义为推理时资源分配问题，提出两种动态预算分配器（Global SMC 与 BaSE），在纳米抗体设计中以每 GPU 小时产出提高近 5 倍且不牺牲多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式分子设计常依赖过采样加事后过滤；推理时引导方法（如 FK steering）虽能通过偏置轨迹提升效率，但只在单一固定配置内优化。在 de novo 纳米抗体设计中，预先确定支架身份或靶表位等条件会形成瓶颈，而不同条件产率差异大，导致在不理想设置上浪费算力。

Method: 将生成条件选择建模为推理时资源分配问题，提出两种动态预算分配器：一是联合式 Global Sequential Monte Carlo（SMC），同时跨配置进行引导与算力分配；二是解耦式方法，改编 Batched Successive Elimination（BaSE）。

Result: 在多个不同治疗靶点和生成配置下，动态分配器将每 GPU 小时可设计候选产率提升近 5 倍，同时保持多样性。

Conclusion: 推理时资源分配是提升生成式分子设计效率的有效框架，动态分配算力优于固定配置下的单一引导。

Abstract: Generative molecular design typically relies on over-generation and post-hoc filtering. Inference-time steering methods like Feynman-Kac (FK) steering improve efficiency by biasing trajectories toward high-reward candidates, yet they optimize within a single fixed configuration. In de novo nanobody design, upfront commitment to conditioning choices like scaffold identity or target epitope creates a bottleneck. Since yield varies across these conditions, steering unpromising setups wastes compute. We recast generative condition selection as an inference-time resource-allocation problem. We propose two dynamic budget allocators: a joint Global Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) formulation that steers and allocates compute across configurations concurrently, and a decoupled approach adapting Batched Successive Elimination (BaSE). Empirically, these dynamic allocators increase the yield of designable candidates per GPU-hour nearly 5$\times$ without sacrificing diversity across distinct therapeutic targets and generative configurations.

</details>


### [344] [Partially Informed Stochastic Optimization via Zeroth-Order Residual Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13871)
*El Mahdi Chayti,Alireza Mirrokni,Martin Jaggi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PISO 是一种部分知情随机优化方法，结合已知梯度分量与残差在线估计，实现高效收敛与低函数评估复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多优化问题只能获得部分梯度，剩余部分需通过函数评估推断，如表演性预测、表演性强化学习及黑盒下层双级优化。现有方法依赖不可用梯度分量的均匀界，限制实用性。

Method: PISO 将可用梯度分量与残差的运行估计结合，通过将每次零阶观测中心化于该估计，使随机探测方差取决于跟踪误差而非残差幅度；形成带显式收缩机制的随机草图迭代，并赋予动量原则性解释。

Result: 对光滑非凸目标，收敛保证依赖残差变化与初始幅度，无需不可用梯度分量的均匀界。独立采样与高斯/球面探测下，Lipschitz 梯度达 O(d²ε⁻⁶)，额外 Lipschitz-Hessian 假设下达 O(d²ε⁻⁵)；每次更新仅需一个探测方向、两次函数采样和一个已知分量采样。分析量化批量对部署次数的权衡。在五种设置中，PISO 变体在三种中优于基线，双级路由中更快达到可比解，表演性强化学习中最优。

Conclusion: PISO 为部分知情随机优化提供理论保证与高效复杂度，在多种场景下性能优越，且仅需有限 oracle 访问。

Abstract: Many optimization problems provide direct access to only part of the gradient, while the remaining component must be inferred from function evaluations. This structure arises in performative prediction, performative reinforcement learning, and bilevel optimization with a black-box lower level. We introduce Partially Informed Stochastic Optimization (PISO), which combines the available gradient component with a running estimate of the residual. By centring each zeroth-order observation on this estimate, PISO makes the variance due to random probing depend on the tracking error rather than the residual's magnitude. This yields a randomized sketch iteration with an explicit contraction mechanism and a principled interpretation of momentum. For smooth nonconvex objectives, we establish convergence guarantees that depend on the residual's variation and initial magnitude, without requiring a uniform bound on the unavailable gradient component. With independently sampled function evaluations and Gaussian or spherical probes, PISO attains leading function-evaluation complexities of \(O(d^{2}\varepsilon^{-6})\) under Lipschitz gradients and \(O(d^{2}\varepsilon^{-5})\) under an additional Lipschitz-Hessian assumption. These rates require only one probe direction, two function samples, and one known-component sample per update. The analysis also quantifies how batching trades observations for fewer deployments. Across five settings, PISO variants improve on the tested baselines with comparable oracle access in three, reach a comparable solution faster in bilevel routing, and perform best among methods without response-model derivatives in performative reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [345] [Revisiting Tabular Deep Regression: Objectives and the Limits of Global Early Stopping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13909)
*Danil Rudenko,Georgii Bulgakov,Nikolay Kartashev,Ivan Rubachev,Daniil Krasylnikov,Artem Babenko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统重评估表格数据深度学习回归目标函数，发现分位数损失较MSE稳定更优，并提出异方差感知的分位数损失扩展以改进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格数据深度学习的回归目标函数研究不足，已有MSE替代方案因数据集、骨干网络和评估协议差异难以公平比较。

Method: 在大量成熟表格数据集和多种神经骨干网络上系统重评估回归目标函数；进一步识别不同噪声区域最优停止时间不一致的问题，并提出基于输入依赖标签平滑的异方差感知分位数损失扩展。

Result: 多数所提目标函数相较调优后的MSE基线提升有限或不一致；分位数损失在测试骨干网络上一致优于MSE；异方差感知扩展在多个骨干网络上优于分位数损失。

Conclusion: 为表格深度学习回归目标提供了现代实证图景，并指出不同不确定性区域最优停止时间差异会限制全局早停的有效性。

Abstract: While deep learning models for tabular data have recently received significant research attention, the choice of objective functions for regression tasks remains an understudied degree of freedom. Several lines of research offer alternatives to the standard Mean Squared Error (MSE), but differences in datasets, backbones, and evaluation protocols make their practical benefits difficult to compare. In this work, we address this gap by performing a systematic re-evaluation of regression objectives across a broad collection of established tabular datasets and multiple neural backbones. Our comparison reveals that many proposed objectives provide limited or inconsistent gains over a properly tuned MSE baseline, while quantile loss yields consistent aggregate improvements over MSE across the tested backbones. We then identify a limitation that remains even with this strong objective: regions with different levels of target noise can reach their best predictive performance at different training epochs. Consequently, a single global early-stopping checkpoint can impose a compromise between uncertainty regions, even when the objective can represent heteroskedastic target distributions. Motivated by this limitation, we introduce a heteroskedasticity-aware extension of quantile loss that uses input-dependent label smoothing as a potential remedy and improves over quantile loss on several backbones. Overall, our results provide a modern empirical picture of regression objectives for tabular deep learning and highlight how differences in optimal stopping times across uncertainty regions can limit the effectiveness of global early stopping. The code is available at https://github.com/yandex-research/tabular-regression.

</details>


### [346] [Prediction Is Not a Sufficient Memory State](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13881)
*Robert Jenkinson Alvarez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文刻画了"精确累积学习"与"注意力"中记忆状态的本质区别：当前预测正确并不等于保留了继续学习所需的信息。对光滑凸残差损失，固定维连续循环状态存在当且仅当损失为多项式；次数D需r=binomial(d+D,D)-1维状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 记忆若只复现当前预测，可能已遗忘如何从下一次观测中学习。作者希望严格刻画"能预测"与"能继续学习"这一区分，即确定精确累积学习所需的隐藏状态维度。

Method: 针对光滑凸残差损失（无限制实特征与标签），分析固定维连续循环状态的存在性与最小维度；对岭回归识别隐藏证据为设计矩阵；用B位压缩分析一级更新误差；并对核注意力给出第二个精确闭包分类。

Result: 多项式损失下状态存在，次数D需r=binomial(d+D,D)-1个坐标；即使固定当前预测器，仍需r-d个坐标。非多项式损失需求无界。岭回归精确状态代价为dp+d(d+1)/2（预测器仅dp）。良条件零预测族上最优B位压缩平均单步误差约为d^{-1}2^{-2B/s_d}，s_d=d(d+1)/2，即使随机编码也无法改善。

Conclusion: 结果揭示了未来更新所暴露的信息，而非提出新回归算法或声称训练模型增益；同时为注意力给出精确闭包分类。

Abstract: A memory that reproduces every current prediction may still have forgotten how to learn from the next observation. We characterize this distinction for exact cumulative learning and attention. For smooth convex residual losses with unrestricted real features and labels, a continuous recurrent state of fixed dimension exists exactly when the loss is polynomial. With ordinary, unweighted observations, degree $D$ requires precisely $r=\binom{d+D}{D}-1$ coordinates; even among histories with one fixed current predictor, exactly $r-d$ coordinates can remain necessary for continuation. Nonpolynomial losses have unbounded requirements on such equal-prediction histories. Bounded scalar logistic examples retain this obstruction after fixing any finite derivative jet. For ridge regression, the hidden evidence is the design matrix: the exact state costs $dp+d(d+1)/2$, versus $dp$ for the predictor. On a well-conditioned zero-prediction family, optimal $B$-bit compression has average one-update error of order $d^{-1}2^{-2B/s_d}$, $s_d=d(d+1)/2$, even with arbitrary randomized codes. Kernel attention gives a second exact closure classification. The results identify what future updates reveal, rather than proposing a new regression algorithm or asserting trained-model gains.

</details>


### [347] [Designing Protein Structures from Natural Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13917)
*Joseph Lee,Yanjing Li,Bo Qiang,Gregory Lau,Allyson Ettinger,Noah A. Smith,Rory Donovan-Maiye,David Baker,Hanna Hajishirzi,Pang Wei Koh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Prompteina 是首个支持自然语言指定设计目标的 all-atom 蛋白质结构生成模型，构建了 170 万结构/5000 万+ 描述的文本-蛋白配对数据集，在多类设计任务上超越基线并经实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有蛋白质设计模型通常需要为每种目标属性提供专用输入表示，限制了可支持的设计目标范围，亟需一种更通用、灵活的调控接口。

Method: 构建 Prompteina-Data（1.8M 结构、50M+ 描述全局与残基级别属性的文本-结构配对数据）；基于 Proteina-Complexa 预训练结构生成模型，通过文本条件预训练与微调，将残基与对应文本对齐。

Result: 在 18 项结构属性中的 15 项优于基线；生成蛋白更符合功能描述。Binder 设计中在 20 个靶点中至少 13 个领先，界面置信度较最强基线提升 14%；在最难靶点上迭代反馈带来的增益比次优基线大 57%；实验验证 GM2A 靶点，鉴定出 9 个 binders，最强表观 KD 为 107 nM。

Conclusion: 自然语言可作为蛋白质结构生成的有效且强大的条件接口，实现更广泛的设计目标。

Abstract: A central challenge in de novo protein design is generating proteins with desired structural and functional properties. Existing design models typically require a dedicated input representation for each property, limiting the design objectives they support. We develop Prompteina, the first all-atom structure generation model that supports new and broader design objectives specified in natural language, analogous to text-to-image generation. To train Prompteina, we construct Prompteina-Data, a paired text--protein structure dataset of 1.8M structures and 50M+ captions describing global and residue-specific structural and functional properties. We adapt Proteina-Complexa, a pretrained structure generation model, through text-conditioned pretraining and finetuning that aligns residues with their corresponding text. Prompteina outperforms baselines on 15 of 18 structural properties and generates proteins that more closely match descriptions of their intended functions. In binder design, it leads baselines on at least 13 of 20 targets and improves interface confidence by 14\% over the strongest baseline. With iterative in silico feedback, Prompteina's gain over non-iterative generation is 57\% larger than the next-best baseline on the hardest targets. Finally, we experimentally validate Prompteina designs against GM2A, a target with no reported de novo binders. We identify nine binders, with the strongest at an apparent $K_{\mathrm{D}}$ of 107 nM. These results establish natural language as an effective and powerful conditioning interface for protein structure generation.

</details>


### [348] [KL Before and After Mixing: A Round-Complexity Separation in Parallel Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13924)
*Tianyi Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文比较并行采样器在两种KL散度准则下的最小轮数/代价：schedule-averaged divergence 与 output-law divergence，并针对特定目标证明二者存在双对数级别的分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并行采样器可随机选择同时生成的坐标，但其"随机调度"应对哪一KL准则优化尚不清楚。文中区分 schedule-averaged divergence 与 output-law divergence，探究两者在最优轮数上的差异。

Method: 研究每轮冻结精确条件边缘、从有限调度混合中采样调度、每轮计费的因果随机策略；对偶数长度 n、含 n/2 个 1 的二元串均匀分布，用 count-state 递推刻画每轮上限下精确最小 output divergence。

Result: 对偶数长度平衡目标：第一准则下固定容差 ε 的最小期望轮数为 Θ_ε((log n)^2)，第二准则下为 (e^{-ε}+o(1))log_2 ln n，且该双对数阶可每次运行同轮数达到。分离还推广至有界权重比的固定计数目标及 Beta(1,1)-Bernoulli 目标，后者代价为 (e^{-ε}/2+o(1))log_2 log_2 n。

Conclusion: 调度平均准则与输出律准则在并行采样最优代价上可相差巨大（多项式对双对数）；模型可精确分析并推广到多类目标。

Abstract: A parallel sampler can choose at random which coordinates to generate together. For a target $p$ and the output law $q_U$ of a schedule $U$ drawn afresh for each output, we compare the schedule-averaged divergence $\mathbb{E}_U D_{\mathrm{KL}}(p\|q_U)$ with the output-law divergence $D_{\mathrm{KL}}(p\|\mathbb{E}_U q_U)$, in nats. Rounds commit independent draws from exact conditional marginals frozen at the round's start, each output's schedule is drawn before sampling from a finite mixture of schedules, and every scheduled round is charged. For the uniform distribution on binary strings of even length $n$ with $n/2$ ones, the least expected number of rounds at a fixed tolerance $\varepsilon>0$ is $Θ_\varepsilon((\log n)^2)$ under the first criterion but $(e^{-\varepsilon}+o(1))\log_2\ln n$ under the second, and the double-logarithmic order is attainable with the same round count on every run. For this target, a count-state recursion gives the exact least output divergence at every round cap over all causal randomized policies. The separation extends to weighted fixed-count targets with bounded weight ratios and quota fractions bounded away from zero and one, without permutation symmetry, and to the full-support Beta$(1,1)$--Bernoulli target, where the sharp expected cost under the output-law criterion is $(e^{-\varepsilon}/2+o(1))\log_2\log_2n$, attained with rare $n$-round runs. Prior work implies the order of the schedule-averaged cost on the balanced target and its $O_\varepsilon((\log n)^2)$ upper bounds on both extensions.

</details>


### [349] [AI Models Can Provably Hide Arbitrary Capabilities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13928)
*Andis Draguns,Sumeet Ramesh Motwani,Raymond Douglas,Christian Schroeder de Witt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过在模型权重中嵌入加密神经网络构建后门攻击，证明在对抗条件下隐藏能力无法被可靠地激发，从而揭示了基于激发的模型能力审计的固有局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 能力评估旨在部署前发现模型的危险行为，但其可靠性依赖于"隐藏能力可被激发"这一假设。作者试图检验该假设在对抗条件下是否成立。

Method: 利用数字储物柜（digital lockers）将加密神经网络嵌入宿主模型权重，仅在收到秘密触发器时解密并执行；在PyTorch中实现概念验证，并针对化学反预测任务（CBRN相关能力的代理）测试微调、权重加噪、梯度触发器搜索和潜对抗训练等激发手段。

Result: 隐藏电路在密码学假设下即便拥有完整权重访问也难以被激发和解释，且实验结果证明其对多种激发方法具有抵抗力。

Conclusion: 基于激发的模型能力审计存在根本性局限，作者公开模型以支持防御方法的改进。

Abstract: Capability evaluations aim to surface dangerous model behaviors before deployment, but their reliability depends on the assumption that hidden capabilities can be elicited. We show this assumption does not hold under adversarial conditions by constructing backdoor attacks that embed encrypted neural networks within host model weights, decrypting and executing them only upon receiving a secret trigger. Using digital lockers, these hidden circuits remain provably hard to elicit and interpret under cryptographic assumptions, even given full access to model weights, extending prior work from hiding fixed strings to arbitrary computations. We implement our proof of concept constructions in PyTorch and evaluate elicitation through fine-tuning, weight noising, gradient-based trigger search, and latent adversarial training on a small chemical reaction prediction task - a proxy for CBRN-relevant capabilities. Our results demonstrate resistance to these methods and, together with our cryptographic guarantees, reveal a limit of elicitation-based capability audits. We release our models to support the improvement of defenses.

</details>


<div id='cs.GT'></div>

# cs.GT [[Back]](#toc)

### [350] [Game Petri Nets: Compositional Modeling and Analysis of Large-Scale Strategic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12779)
*Quanyan Zhu*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 论文提出"结果驱动的组合博弈Petri网"(OCGPN)，将局部博弈附加于着色Petri网的位置，通过博弈-令牌接口将博弈结果转化为令牌以启用/同步/阻断后续博弈，用于建模和分析大规模策略系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 维护工作流、网络攻击战役、多智能体AI流水线等大规模策略系统由大量交互构成，某交互的结果决定了后续哪些交互可行、参与者与资源。现有方法难以同时刻画并发结构依赖与博弈论激励。

Method: 将局部博弈附着在着色Petri网的位置上，用game-to-token接口把每个已解博弈转换为带类型令牌，从而启用、同步或阻断后续博弈。对一般并发网给出操作语义及基于不变量和Farkas证书的结构理论；对顺序网导出在博弈位置上的随机博弈，并做基于强连通分量的逐位置值分解。

Result: 证明全局均衡恰为局部博弈均衡加上延续值的集合；刻画了下游博弈改变上游行为的前瞻枢轴性(successor-level pivotality)；值可按位置计算，代价关于局部博弈规模为可加；给出基于位置融合的组合演算以跨子网拼接证书并用入口值概括下游子网。维护工作流与源自多分辨率网络防御博弈的入侵战役两个实例验证了理论。

Conclusion: OCGPN为结果驱动的组合策略系统提供了兼具并发结构分析与博弈均衡分析的统一框架，其证书与值分解带来可组合、可扩展的分析能力，并以网络防御场景展示了新攻击情形与既有战役组合的应用潜力。

Abstract: Large-scale strategic systems, such as maintenance workflows, cyber campaigns, and multi-agent AI pipelines, consist of many interactions whose outcomes determine which later interactions become possible, who takes part, and with what resources. We introduce game Petri nets, formalized as outcome-driven compositional game Petri nets (OCGPNs), to model and analyze such systems. Local games are attached to places of a colored Petri net, and a game-to-token interface converts each resolved game into typed tokens that enable, synchronize, or block subsequent games. For general, concurrent nets, we give an operational semantics and a structural theory based on invariants and Farkas certificates, which shows that guards can certify unreachability whereas incentive instruments can only change values. For sequential nets, the net induces a stochastic game on its game places. We prove that global equilibria are exactly collections of equilibria of local games augmented by continuation values, characterize through successor-level pivotality when downstream games change upstream behavior, and compute values place by place via a decomposition into strongly connected components, at a cost additive in local game sizes. A composition calculus based on place fusion glues certificates across subnets and summarizes downstream subnets by their entry values. Two running examples, a maintenance workflow and an intrusion campaign derived from multi-resolution cyber-defense games, illustrate the theory, including the composition of a newly discovered attack scenario with an existing campaign.

</details>


### [351] [The False Allure of "Security by Obscurity": A Game-Theoretic Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12858)
*In-Uck Park,Sunoo Park*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该论文首次对"隐蔽安全"进行严格建模，证明在现实模型条件下，隐蔽系统的均衡攻击成功率高于开放系统，为安全界长期共识提供理论支撑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: "隐蔽安全"在安全界长期声誉不佳，但其直觉吸引力不减并反复出现。争论核心在于：开放审查利于发现问题，但过度开放可能为攻击者提供路线图。这本质上是关于攻击者与善意研究者真实行为的"人"的问题。专家立场基于数十年经验，但领域缺乏经验或理论基础来支撑这些长期信念。

Method: 首次对"隐蔽安全"进行严格建模，刻画理性行为者在易出错系统中如何对开放或隐蔽作出响应。

Result: 证明在现实模型条件下的均衡中，"隐蔽"系统比"开放"系统更易遭受成功攻击。

Conclusion: 为安全界"开放优于隐蔽"的长期共识建立了理论支持。

Abstract: "Security by obscurity," or the idea that hiding how a system works helps protect it from adversaries, has long been poorly regarded in the security community. Yet its intuitive appeal persists, and it has resurfaced repeatedly in industry practices and public debates over the years. The logic, on the one hand, is that open scrutiny of systems is the best way to find and respond to problems; and on the other hand, that too much openness can increase risk by giving adversaries a roadmap for attack. This isn't purely a technical question, but a human one: it's about how attackers and good-faith security researchers respond to openness in the real world. As such, security experts base their stance on decades of community experience; however, the field lacks empirical or theoretical foundations to back up these long-standing beliefs. We provide the first rigorous modeling of "security by obscurity," aiming to capture how rational actors will respond to openness or obscurity in fallible systems. We prove that in equilibrium under realistic model conditions, "obscured" systems are more likely to suffer successful attacks than "open" systems --- establishing theoretical support for the longstanding received wisdom.

</details>


### [352] [Network Topology Shapes AI Intervention Effectiveness on Deception: Truth-Telling vs. Investigative Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12931)
*Zhao Song,Stefan Sarkadi,The Anh Han*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文用演化博弈模型研究在结构化网络中部署固定策略的AI代理（zealots）对欺骗动力学的影响，发现被动真话代理反而放大适应性欺骗，而主动调查代理能提升真话，且干预效果随部署密度非单调并依赖网络拓扑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在人机混合社会中，部署AI代理对抗不诚实沟通是直觉性方案，但在真实网络化环境下其有效性尚不明确，尤其缺乏对被动与主动干预策略差异及拓扑影响的理解。

Method: 将Deceiver's Game扩展至结构化网络，代理可采取欺骗、说真话和调查三种策略；引入固定为说真话或调查策略的承诺型AI代理（zealots），在三种网络拓扑上进行基于代理的仿真。

Result: (1) 被动承诺说真话代理通过制造可被利用的诚实伙伴而放大适应性欺骗，调查代理则在振荡机制中提升适应性说真话；(2) 干预效应随部署密度非单调，因为承诺代理重塑而非简单抑制振荡动力学；(3)响应峰值依赖拓扑，采样的无标度群体呈尖锐低密度响应，全连接群体需更大承诺比例。

Conclusion: 使用承诺代理影响网络化欺骗动力学时，必须区分被动说真话与主动调查策略，二者效应差异显著且受部署密度与网络拓扑共同调控。

Abstract: Deploying AI agents to combat dishonest communication is an intuitive response to deception in hybrid human-AI societies. However, the efficacy of such interventions in realistic networked settings remains unclear. We study this problem using an evolutionary game-theoretic model of the Deceiver's Game by extending it to structured networks, where agents can adopt deception, truth-telling, and investigation strategies. We introduce committed AI agents (zealots) fixed to either truth-telling or investigative strategies and conduct agent-based simulations across three network topologies. Our key findings are: (1) passive committed truth-telling agents can amplify adaptive deception by creating exploitable honest partners, whereas investigative agents increase adaptive truth-telling in the oscillatory regime; (2) intervention effects are non-monotonic in deployment density because committed agents reshape rather than simply suppress the underlying oscillatory dynamics; and (3) response peaks depend on topology, with sampled scale-free populations showing sharp low-density responses and fully connected populations requiring larger committed fractions. Overall, the results highlight the need to distinguish passive truth-telling from active investigation when using committed agents to influence networked deception dynamics.

</details>


### [353] [Limit-sure Winning in Team Games without Shared Randomness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13569)
*Léonard Brice,Thomas A. Henzinger,Alipasha Montaseri,Ali Shafiee,K. S. Thejaswini*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究团队与对抗环境博弈，agent仅有独立随机源时reachability极限确保问题NP完全，safety极限确保=几乎确保(P)，并推出IR-ATL定性片段模型检测为P^NP完全。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文献中常见假设agent可共享随机源，从而将博弈简化为双人博弈，但这不符合真实系统。本文考虑agent仅有独立随机源的更现实设定。

Method: 研究并发随机博弈，agent团队对抗对抗性环境，仅有各自独立的随机源，需满足reachability或safety目标；分析limit-sure winning问题。

Result: reachability目标下limit-sure问题为NP完全；safety目标下limit-sure winning等价于almost-sure winning，属于P。推论：Individually Randomised ATL定性片段模型检测为P^NP完全。

Conclusion: 摒弃共享随机源假设后得到新的复杂度刻画，并确定IR-ATL定性片段模型检测的精确复杂度。

Abstract: We study concurrent stochastic games in which a team of agents plays against an adversarial environment. If the agents could access a shared source of randomness, then these games reduce to two-player games. Despite being common in the literature on coalition games, this assumption does not accurately model real-world systems. In this paper, we consider the setting where the agents only have access to individual sources of randomness, and must satisfy a given reachability or safety objective. The limit-sure problem asks whether the team can ensure that the objective is satisfied with probability at least $1-λ$ for every $λ>0$. For reachability objectives, we show that this problem is $\mathsf{NP}$-complete. For safety objectives, we show that limit-sure winning coincides with almost-sure winning, which is known to lie in $\mathsf{P}$. As a corollary of these results, we conclude that model checking of the qualitative fragment of the logic Individually Randomised ATL -- introduced in the recent work of Brice et al. -- is $\mathsf{P}^{\mathsf{NP}}$-complete.

</details>


### [354] [Complexity of Autobidding Equilibria in GSP Sponsored Shopping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13716)
*Kristoffer Arnsfelt Hansen,Yuhao Li,Xinhao Nie*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究GSP赞助购物拍卖中自动出价均衡的存在性与计算复杂度，证明均衡总存在且具多项式规模支持，并给出精确/近似均衡的复杂度刻画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Dütting等最近提出并研究了GSP赞助购物拍卖中的自动出价均衡，但其存在性与计算复杂度尚不完整，本文旨在系统刻画这些问题。

Method: 从存在性角度分析预算约束(ABE-B)与投资回报约束(ABE-R)下的均衡；从计算角度用FIXP、PPAD等复杂度类对精确与近似均衡进行归约与刻画。

Result: ABE-B与ABE-R均衡总存在且总有多项式规模支持的均衡；计算精确均衡属于FIXP，计算近似均衡属于PPAD，且对ABE-B和ABE-R近似均衡计算均为PPAD-hard。

Conclusion: 上述结果较全面地刻画了GSP赞助购物拍卖中自动出价均衡的计算复杂度。

Abstract: We revisit autobidding equilibria in GSP sponsored shopping auctions, recently proposed and studied in Dütting et al. On the existence side, we show that autobidding equilibria under both budget constraints (ABE-B) and return-on-investment constraints (ABE-R) always exist and, moreover, always admit equilibria with polynomial-size support over the allocation space. On the computational side, we show that computing an exact equilibrium is in FIXP, and that computing an approximate equilibrium is in PPAD. We also prove that computing an approximate equilibrium is PPAD-hard for both ABE-B and ABE-R. Together, these results provide a fairly comprehensive picture of the computational complexity of autobidding equilibria in GSP sponsored shopping auctions.

</details>


### [355] [The Distortion of Threshold Approval Multiwinner Voting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13725)
*Mohamad Latifian,Marzieh Nilipour,Alexandros A. Voudouris*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究在选民仅提供由t个效用阈值诱导的粗粒度信息下，多赢家投票的委员会选择问题，针对归一化单调对称范数效用，给出deterministic与randomized规则的distortion上下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 选民实际只能提供有限、粗粒度的偏好信息（如approval集合），而目标效用常以多种社会福利范数衡量；需研究在信息受限下能否仍选出近似最优委员会。

Method: 将选民偏好建模为t个效用阈值划分候选人为若干approval集合；委员会效用采用归一化单调对称范数统一刻画（含additive welfare、best-representative、top-r、ℓ_p、OWA等）；设计deterministic规则和randomized规则并分析distortion。

Result: deterministic规则distortion至多2(2m)^{1/t}；randomized规则distortion至多2min{m^{1/(t+1)}, m/k}；单阈值时deterministic为O(m)、randomized为O(√m)，O(log m)个阈值可达常数distortion；并给出在常数委员会规模（含单赢家）下渐近匹配的范数相关下界。

Conclusion: 在粗粒度阈值偏好下，少量阈值即可显著降低distortion；所提规则对任意委员会规模和该范数框架普遍有效，且上下界在重要情形下匹配。

Abstract: We study multiwinner voting with $n$ voters and $m$ candidates, where the goal is to select a committee of size $k$. Voters have unit-sum cardinal utilities but report only coarse information induced by $t$ utility thresholds. In particular, each voter partitions the candidates into approval sets, with the utilities of all candidates in the same set lying between the same pair of consecutive thresholds. We model the utility of each voter for a committee as a normalized monotone symmetric norm, capturing, among others, additive welfare, best-representative utility, top-$r$ welfare, $\ell_p$ welfare, and normalized non-increasing ordered weighted averages. We design a deterministic rule with distortion at most $2(2m)^{1/t}$ and a randomized rule with distortion at most $2\min\{m^{1/(t+1)},m/k\}$. These guarantees hold for every committee size $k$ and every norm in our framework. Consequently, a single threshold yields distortion $O(m)$ for deterministic rules and $O(\sqrt{m})$ for randomized rules, while $O(\log m)$ thresholds suffice for constant distortion. We complement these results with norm-dependent lower bounds that asymptotically match our upper bounds for constant committee sizes, including the single-winner case.

</details>


### [356] [Asymmetric Information in Dynamic Lending Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13759)
*Kristijan Atanasov,Frederik Mallmann-Trenn,Carmine Ventre*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究动态放贷博弈中信息揭示（竞争对手供给信息）如何影响贷款人收益，发现不对称揭示可在总放贷量不变下提高总收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 借贷平台需决定是否向贷款人披露竞争对手的供给信息，但该信息披露对收益与费用影响机制不明，尤其需求与供给相对变化时。

Method: 构建动态放贷博弈模型：借款人到达与贷款时长随机，需求按"最便宜优先"分配并受可用供给约束；比较贷款人仅知自身供给、或兼知对手总供给等不同（对称/不对称/无）信息揭示情景。

Result: 不对称信息揭示下总收益可增加而总放贷量不变，并识别其成立的数学条件；需求较低时仅告知较大贷款人可提高总收益，需求较高时仅告知较小贷款人可最大化总收益。

Conclusion: 信息揭示可改变借款人支付费用而不改变放贷量；更广泛的信息获取不必然降低费用，效果取决于信息接收者及供需平衡。

Abstract: We study a dynamic lending game with limited but reusable supply. Borrower arrivals and loan durations are stochastic. Demand is allocated cheapest-first, subject to available supply, so a lender's quote affects both its current payoff and its ability to serve future borrowers. Motivated by industry practice, we study this problem through the lens of information disclosure: Lenders observe either only their own available supply or also their rivals' aggregate available supply. We ask how providing this information to all, some or none of the lenders affects payoffs as demand varies relative to supply, and how these effects change when a fixed total supply is divided among different numbers of lenders. Interestingly, in the case of asymmetric information disclosure, total payoffs can increase, while total lending remains the same. We identify sufficient mathematical regimes in which this phenomenon occurs. Who receives supply information matters differently as demand rises. For the case of two lenders, informing only the larger lender yields higher total lender payoff at lower demand, while informing only the smaller lender can yield the highest total lender payoff at higher demand. For a platform deciding which lenders can observe rival supply, the results suggest that disclosure can change the fees paid by borrowers without changing how much is lent. Wider access to supply information need not lower those fees: its effect depends on who receives the information and the balance between demand and supply.

</details>


### [357] [A $1/2$-Approximation for Pandora's Problem with Deadlines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13775)
*Shenyu Qin,Chihao Zhang,Yuhao Zhang,Zixuan Zhu*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究带截止时间的 Pandora 问题，提出简单阈值策略，将最优期望效用的近似比从 0.158 提升到 1/2。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Pandora 问题是顺序搜索的基础模型，每个盒子的打开需付出成本。带截止时间的变体中，每个盒子的打开和选择都有公开已知的截止时间限制，此前 Berger 等人（AAAI 2024）的近似保证仅为 (e-1)/(4e)≈0.158，存在较大提升空间。

Method: 针对带截止时间的 Pandora 问题，设计并分析了一种简单的阈值策略（threshold strategy）。

Result: 所提出的阈值策略达到了最优期望效用的 1/2 近似，显著优于此前 (e-1)/(4e)≈0.158 的保证。

Conclusion: 简单的阈值策略即可在带截止时间的 Pandora 问题中实现 1/2 近似，大幅改进了现有最优结果。

Abstract: Pandora's problem is a fundamental model of sequential search in which opening each box incurs a cost. We study the variant with deadlines, where each box has a publicly known deadline for both opening and selection. We prove that a simple threshold strategy achieves a $1/2$-approximation to the optimal expected utility, improving the previous guarantee of $(e-1)/(4e)\approx0.158$ due to Berger et al. (AAAI 2024).

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [358] [Faithfulness Without Anchors: A Position Paper on the Structural Misalignments of Explainable AI Faithfulness Metrics for Feature Importance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12493)
*Marco Zullich,Emily Schiller,Ivan Gentile,David Dembinsky,Adriano Lucieri,Kilian Göller,Steffen Seitz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，指出现有可解释AI（XAI）工具未实现提升信任的目标，反而导致过度依赖与算法厌恶，其核心问题在于解释的不忠实性。作者总结当前忠实度度量的五大缺陷，并提出四个研究方向以提升其可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: XAI工具本应通过让模型更易理解来增加信任，但十年证据显示其整体失败，反而助长对错误预测的过度依赖并引发算法厌恶。核心原因是XAI方法过度简化模型内部机制，导致解释与模型不匹配（不忠实/不忠实性）。严格量化忠实度可衡量解释可信度的一个要素，但现有度量存在重大局限，使量化不可行或计算昂贵。

Method: 立场论文（position paper）。作者基于对现有文献的梳理，归纳当前忠实度（faithfulness）度量的五大主要缺陷，并据此提出四个可能的研究方向以增强其可靠性。

Result: 论文识别出当前忠实度度量的五项主要缺陷，并提出四条研究路径。摘要未给出具体实验或定量结果。

Conclusion: XAI提升信任的目标基本落空，其作用更接近于调试工具。忠实度是解释可信度的重要维度，但现有度量不可靠。作者呼吁通过所提四个研究方向改进忠实度度量，从而更严谨地量化解释的可信度。

Abstract: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) tools have often been presented as methods to increase trust in machine learning models by making aspects of their algorithms more human-understandable. However, evidence accumulated over the last decade points to an overall failure of this objective, instead promoting overreliance on incorrect predictions, which can subsequently lead to algorithmic aversion. Rather, XAI appears to function primarily as a debugging tool, useful for obtaining anecdotal insights into, for example, features learned by the model. One of the main issues underlying this limitation is that XAI methods often oversimplify the inner workings of the model, resulting in misalignment between the explanation and the model itself - a behavior referred to as unfaithfulness or infidelity. Faithfulness can be interpreted as the degree of approximation between an explanation and the model. Computing faithfulness in a rigorous manner would thus make it possible to quantify one of the various elements of trustworthiness of an explanation. However, existing metrics present significant limitations, making this quantification either infeasible or computationally expensive. In this position paper, we outline five major shortcomings of current faithfulness metrics and propose four possible avenues for research to bolster their reliability.

</details>


### [359] [EliteTable: Self-Improving Program Search for Executable Control Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12536)
*Stuart Farmer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EliteTable是一种由LLM引导的自改进程序搜索算法，通过维护高分解表指导新方案生成与编辑。在六个Gymnasium控制任务上评估，多数任务搜索分数中位数提升，但相对性能和组件贡献尚待验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 利用大语言模型引导程序搜索，并通过固定容量高分解表来指导新方案生成、现有方案编辑及多方案混合，从而提升搜索质量。

Method: 维护固定容量的高分解表，引导LLM进行新提案、解编辑和多解remix；在六个Gymnasium控制任务上评估，每任务10代、每代50候选槽、10次独立初始化搜索。

Result: 六个任务中候选分数中位数均提升，五个任务选中胜者分数中位数提升；CartPole-v1在全部10次搜索第一代即达上限。六任务中四个的十个配对held-out端点全部改善。BipedalWalker-v3和CarRacing-v3有改善但未达标。Acrobot-v1十次搜索中六次held-out下降，配对变化中位数为负。

Conclusion: 结果证明了程序搜索过程中的改进，以及部分任务中选中胜者增益向新episode的迁移。仍需对比实验和消融研究以确定EliteTable的相对性能及各组件贡献。

Abstract: EliteTable is a self-improving program-search algorithm guided by large language models (LLMs) that uses a fixed-capacity table of high-scoring solutions to guide new proposals, edits of existing solutions, and remixes of several solutions. Performance was evaluated across six Gymnasium control tasks, each with ten generations and fifty candidate slots per generation. Each task was evaluated across ten independently initialized searches. Candidate-score medians rose between the first and final generations in all six tasks, and selected-winner search-score medians rose in five. In CartPole-v1, the selected winner reached the search-score ceiling in the first generation of all ten searches. All ten paired held-out endpoints improved in four of the six tasks. BipedalWalker-v3 and CarRacing-v3 improved without reaching their reporting targets. Six of ten Acrobot-v1 searches declined on held-out episodes, and the median paired change was negative. The results document improvement during program search and the transfer of selected-winner gains to new episodes in some tasks. Comparisons and ablations are needed to establish EliteTable's relative performance and the contributions of its components.

</details>


### [360] [Equal-Budget Monte Carlo Tree Search versus Randomized-Restart List Scheduling for DAG Workflows: A Controlled Equal-Budget Computational Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12542)
*Yuyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在受控协议下以相同搜索预算比较MCTS与简单随机重启列表调度器，MCTS反而差2.88%，差异非预算不足所致，改为教科书UCT后差距大幅缩小但不反转；结论限于受控合成域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MCTS调度DAG工作流的研究多未做可能证伪自身的对照——即让更简单方法获得同等搜索努力。作者要补上这一比较。

Method: 控制协议、预算对齐的比较：所有臂获得相同候选调度数与评估量。主臂为预注册的MCTS调度方法；对照为无搜索树的随机重启列表调度器；后续注册臂为教科书UCT MCTS。分析计划在数据收集前锁定，独立核查员验证768个确认阶段调度均有效且完工时间正确。

Result: 主预算2048次评估调度下，MCTS比重启差2.88%（95% CI [-3.62%,-2.15%]）；96个留存实例中72个有正的相对基线空间。探索池上重启自我改进1.85%而MCTS仅0.24%；MCTS首结果720个中700个就是其被给予的暖启动。选择规则确定性锁定首个扩展子节点，使试验相关；与makespan的因果关联仅为推断。结构性地图：稀疏不规则工作流重启胜，规则分层无可检测差异，密集无改进空间。改用教科书UCT后差距大部分消除（-0.26%，95% CI [-0.71%,+0.23%]）但不反转符号。

Conclusion: 在受控合成域（N∈{8,16,32}任务、2-8处理器、预算至2048）内，MCTS相对简单重启方法无优势甚至更差；差距主因归结于选择规则的确定性锁定而非预算不足。作者不对更大预算或真实场景作任何主张。

Abstract: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) is often proposed for scheduling directed-acyclic-graph (DAG) workflows, yet most studies never run the comparison that could refute it - giving a much simpler method the same search effort. We run that comparison under a controlled protocol. All arms receive an identical budget - the same number of candidate schedules built and evaluated: an MCTS scheduling method, preregistered as the main arm; a randomized-restart list scheduler with no search tree as the control; and a textbook-UCT MCTS arm as a registered follow-up on the same domain. The analysis plan was locked before data collection; an independent checker confirmed all 768 confirmation-stage schedules valid with correct finish times. At the main budget of 2048 evaluated schedules, MCTS is 2.88% worse than the restarts (95% CI [-3.62%,-2.15%]; the 72 of 96 held-out instances with positive baseline-relative headroom). The deficit is not budget starvation: on the separate exploration pool restarts self-improve by 1.85% where MCTS gains 0.24%, and 700 of 720 of MCTS's first results are merely the warm start it was handed. The studied selection rule locks deterministically onto the first-expanded child, keeping its trials correlated while restarts draw gains from the tails; the causal link to makespan remains an inference. A structural map locates where the tree stops paying: restarts win on sparse irregular workflows, no difference is detectable on regular layered ones, and dense ones leave no room to improve. Swapping the rule for textbook UCT removes most of the deficit (-0.26%, 95% CI [-0.71%,+0.23%]) without reversing its sign. Results are confined to a controlled synthetic domain (N in {8,16,32} tasks, 2-8 processors, budgets up to 2048); we make no claim about larger budgets.

</details>


### [361] [Locate, Judge, Read: Role-Specialized Tool Agents over a Knowledge-Point Index for Open-Domain Multimodal Document QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13128)
*Wenlin Lin,Fanzhe Wei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: KnowForge 将检索与阅读拆分给不同专职 Agent（Locator 只搜索、Deep Reader 只阅读），配合代码调度的二跳桥接与类型化证据池，在异构文档问答基准上显著超越现有 RAG/GraphRAG 系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前检索增强 Agent 让同一模型同时掌握检索与阅读工具并自行调度，导致模型倾向持续搜索而非阅读，制约了大规模异构文档集合上的问答表现。

Method: 提出按职责分离的流水线：混合检索的知识点索引；只能搜索的 Locator Agent；强制补全第二跳的代码调度桥接判定器；合并每次搜索排名的有界类型化证据池；只能阅读文本/图像/表格的 Deep Reader Agent；以及带格式检查的合成器。

Result: 自托管 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 下 M3DocVQA F1 达 47.5（比 M3DocRAG +11.0），DeepSeek-V4-Flash 下 53.5；MultiHop-RAG 准确率 73.5 超最强已发表结果 71.2；MMLongBench-Doc 从 34.8 提升到 47.0。消融显示 Deep Reader 在三个语料分别贡献 3.8/9.8/0 分；合并两 Agent 反而损失 1.9 F1；四轮 Locator 后收益饱和。

Conclusion: 按职责分离检索与阅读的流水线设计有效提升异构文档问答性能，代价随模型调用而非语料规模增长；论文开放三个索引基准及全部提示与运行代码。

Abstract: Question answering over large heterogeneous document collections requires first finding the right passages and then reading them, yet current retrieval-augmented agents give one model both kinds of tools and let it schedule itself. We present KnowForge, a pipeline separated by job: a hybrid-retrieval knowledge-point index; a Locator agent that can only search; a code-scheduled bridge judge that forces the missing second hop; a typed, size-bounded evidence pool that merges every search's ranking; a Deep Reader agent that can only read text, images and tables; and a synthesizer with a format checker. With a self-hosted Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (3B active), KnowForge reaches F1 47.5 on the full open-domain M3DocVQA (2,441 questions, 3,368 PDFs), +11.0 over the published M3DocRAG system and +7.1 over one-shot retrieve-and-answer on the same index and model, and 53.5 with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. On MultiHop-RAG it reaches 73.5 accuracy, above the strongest published RAG and GraphRAG results (71.2); on the single-document MMLongBench-Doc it lifts the same model from 34.8 to 47.0, level with GPT-4o reading page images (46.3). Per-job ablations on the full benchmarks attribute the gain: the Deep Reader is worth 3.8, 9.8 and 0 points on the three corpora, tracking how visual each is; merging both agents into one with all tools and twice the rounds loses 1.9 F1 because it keeps searching instead of reading; a round-budget sweep shows a step at four Locator rounds and a plateau beyond; query latency scales with model calls rather than corpus size. We serve the three indexed benchmarks as read-only knowledge bases (free registration) and release all prompts and the runner code: https://github.com/metask-ai/knowforge-bench

</details>


### [362] [Know What You Don't Know: Agentic Data Synthesis by Evolving Generation Space for Closed-Loop Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12593)
*Wei Yang,Qing Ping,Youzhi Luo,Yawei Wang,Abhishek Kumar,Panpan Xu,Jun Huan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 EvoSyn——一种学习反馈驱动的多智能体合成框架，通过可修订状态弥合"反馈到决策"鸿沟，在 τ²-Bench 与 CAR-Bench 上平均任务成功率较最强基线提升 13.3 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型对合成经验的依赖日益增强，但面向交互智能体的有效数据合成不仅需要可执行、可验证的轨迹，还需对当前任务智能体具有学习价值。现有方法虽引入环境反馈、数据验证或学习失败信息，仍存在"反馈到决策"鸿沟：观察到的弱点无法直接指明未来合成应如何调整，也无法判断这些弱点能否被当前合成空间表示。

Method: EvoSyn 以"可修订状态"为核心组织合成过程，明确哪些交互因素可被刻意生成、合成努力应分配到何处。系统采用角色专门化的多智能体架构：将学习反馈转化为合成修订；Designer 负责分配合成方向；Planner 将其落地为可执行经验。该流程支持两类机制——空间内自适应（偏向薄弱或覆盖不足区域）与合成空间扩展（将新发现的因素提升为显式生成控制）。

Result: 在 τ²-Bench 与 CAR-Bench 上，EvoSyn 相较最强合成基线平均任务成功率提升 13.3 个百分点，同时生成质量更高、结构更广的合成经验，并发现无学习反馈时被遗漏的可控因素。

Conclusion: 以学习反馈驱动、可修订状态为枢纽的多智能体合成框架，能有效将智能体弱点转化为可执行的合成决策，兼顾合成空间内的适配与扩展，显著提升交互智能体的训练数据质量与任务表现。

Abstract: The continued improvement of large language models increasingly depends on synthetic experience, yet effective data synthesis for interactive agents requires not only executable and verifiable trajectories, but also interactions that provide learning value for the current task agent. Existing methods increasingly incorporate environment feedback, data validation, or learner failures, but still face a feedback-to-decision gap: observed weaknesses do not directly specify how future synthesis should change, or whether they can be represented by the current synthesis space. To address this gap, we propose EvoSyn, a learning-feedback-driven multi-agent framework that organizes synthesis around a revisable state specifying what interaction factors can be deliberately generated and where synthesis effort should be allocated. A role-specialized multi-agent system translates learner feedback into synthesis revisions, while a Designer allocates synthesis directions and a Planner grounds them into executable experience. This process enables within-space adaptation toward weak or under-covered regions and synthesis-space expansion that promotes newly discovered factors into explicit generation controls. Experiments on $τ^2$-Bench and CAR-Bench show that EvoSyn improves average task success by 13.3 points over the strongest synthesis baseline, while producing higher-quality and structurally broader synthetic experience and discovering controllable factors missed without learner feedback.

</details>


### [363] [Web$hell: A Unified Interface for Agentic Web Access](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13416)
*Sunghwan Kim,Deogyong Kim,Sangam Lee,Donguk Kwon,Dongha Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 Web$hell，一种统一网络访问接口，通过 WebCompiler、WebContract 和 WebCache 将实时网页编译为可寻址的信息与动作对象，并共享操作集，使 LLM 智能体能够一致、可操作、持久地访问网络，在搜索、导航和深度研究任务中实现更优性能和更低成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体正直接使用开放网络，面对长程、端到端任务时需要同时完成广泛信息收集、浏览器操作与证据回溯。现有搜索增强、浏览器和文件系统等访问模型多只支持信息收集或浏览器交互之一，组合能力成本高且存在性能权衡。

Method: 提出 Web$hell：统一网络访问接口。WebContract 定义公共 schema，WebCompiler 将实时网页编译为可寻址的信息对象和动作对象，WebCache 维护这些对象，并通过共享操作集进行处理，为智能体提供一致、可操作且持久化的网络访问。

Result: 在网络搜索、网络导航和深度研究基准上的大量实验表明，Web$hell 能以更低成本取得较强的任务性能，并显示接口设计对有效网络访问的重要性。

Conclusion: Web$hell 为 LLM 智能体在网络上实现更强能力和更高效率提供了新可能，说明统一访问模型与接口设计是有效网络访问的关键方向。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are becoming direct users of the open web. As they take on increasingly complex and information-intensive tasks, effective web access is becoming a core capability for agentic problem solving. Existing approaches have advanced agentic web access through different access models, including search-augmented agents, browser-based agents, and, more recently, filesystem-based agents. Nevertheless, as users expect agents to complete long-horizon, end-to-end tasks, they increasingly need to conduct broad information gathering, perform browser actions, and revisit acquired evidence within a single trajectory. Yet our preliminary analyses reveal that existing access models struggle to meet these demands. They primarily support either information gathering or browser interaction, while combining their capabilities can involve substantial costs or performance trade-offs. To this end, we present Web\$hell, an interface that unifies web access under a single access model. Using a common schema defined by WebContract, WebCompiler compiles live webpages into addressable information and action objects. These objects are maintained in WebCache and handled through a shared set of operations, providing agents with consistent, operable, and persistent web access. Through extensive experiments across web search, web navigation, and deep research benchmarks, we show that Web\$hell achieves strong task performance at lower cost. Our results further indicate the importance of interface design for effective web access, with Web\$hell opening new possibilities for more capable and efficient LLM agents on the web.

</details>


### [364] [SpireBench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Strategic Play of Agentic Models with Slay the Spire](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12596)
*Scott C. Lowe,Sander W. Keemink*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 SpireBench，用完整《杀戮尖塔》评测 LLM 的长时程策略推理，发现顶尖模型仅达普通玩家水平，远逊专家，且随回合变长差距扩大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 agent 基准多为短时程、情节式任务，难以拆解长时程策略推理中知识、推理与运气的贡献；长任务表现难以定位失败原因。

Method: 构建 SpireBench，让模型玩完整商业卡牌构筑游戏《杀戮尖塔》（最高难度）；测试 20 个 LLM，与启发式基线、普通及专家人类对比；通过全面一致的术语重命名检验先验知识作用，并考察跨局记忆利用。

Result: 前沿模型超过启发式基线、接近普通玩家，但远落后专家；差距随游戏进程拉大——最强模型第一幕胜率与专家相当，之后落后。强弱差异主要在每场战斗的打法；所有模型对整局风险评估失误，偏向保血而非以血换成长；术语重命名显示部分性能依赖游戏先验知识；模型无法从自己（常错误、过度保守）的跨局记忆中改进。

Conclusion: SpireBench 是首个让模型玩完整原版游戏的测试框架，并与其他框架对比；提供了一个未饱和的长时程基准及定位失败原因的工具。

Abstract: Agentic large language models now tackle complex tasks, yet strategic reasoning over long horizons is under-studied: most agentic benchmarks are short and episodic, and performance on long tasks is hard to dissect into stored knowledge, reasoning and luck. We introduce SpireBench, in which models play the complete commercial deck-builder Slay the Spire (StS), where early decisions decide long-term success. Across 20 large language models (LLMs) at the game's highest difficulty, frontier models beat heuristic baselines and match the average human player but remain far behind experts. This gap widens as the run lengthens: the strongest models win the first act as often as experts, then fall behind. What separates strong models from weak is how well they play each fight; all of them misjudge risk over a run, preserving health rather than spending it to grow stronger. A comprehensive, self-consistent renaming of every game term shows that part of their performance rests on prior knowledge of the game, and models do not improve from the memories they write across runs, which are often wrong and overly cautious. Our harness is the first to give a model the complete original game, and we compare it with existing harnesses. Overall, SpireBench offers an unsaturated long-horizon benchmark with tools to locate where and why agents fail.

</details>


### [365] [A Multi-Agent LLM System for Automated Tuning of Specialized Neural Network Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13663)
*Ivan Moloshnikov,Dmitry Kunitsyn,Alexander Sboev,Maksim Skorokhodov,Roman Rybka,Yuanchao Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一个多智能体LLM框架（分析师、编码者、记录者），自动调优机器学习中指定的关键组件，在脉冲神经网络分类和PINN求解微分方程等五类任务上显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多机器学习方法是两层次的：专家选定一类方法后，其关键组件的选择通常靠人工，既关键又费时。论文希望实现这些组件的自动调优，并提出一个可跨不同性质模型迁移的框架。

Method: 构建多智能体LLM框架，包含分析师、编码者、记录者三种角色，配备实验日志和沙箱执行环境。不同于优化整个ML脚本或在离散空间搜索架构的方法，该框架在一个开放但语义狭窄的空间内运作：智能体只针对指定组件生成代码，保持整体网络结构不变。

Result: 在五个任务上超越基线：脉冲分类MNIST准确率高13个百分点、Digits高6个百分点；对解析单孤子解误差约降低2491倍；GNLSE高斯扰动运行中不变量守恒误差约降低325倍，重复初始化下平均降低超100倍；KS问题质量漂移降低14倍。

Conclusion: 该框架能在不改变自身内部结构的情况下，为不同性质的任务自动调优关键组件，验证了其跨模型迁移能力。

Abstract: Many machine learning approaches are two-level: an expert selects a class of methods, within this class the choice of key components is critical and usually manual. This paper addresses the automatic tuning of these components and proposes a framework transferable across models of different nature. The multi-agent large language model (LLM) framework has three roles---analyst, coder, and recorder~---with an experiment log and a sandboxed execution environment. Unlike systems that optimize the entire ML script or search architectures in a discrete space, the framework operates over an open but semantically narrow space: the agent generates code only for the specified components, leaving the overall network structure unchanged.
